2024-s-0116.summary: After Manhattan prosecutors charged six supporters of Eric Adam in a straw donor conspiracy last July, THE CITY’s reporters immediately began looking to see if they could detect similar schemes, building on their prior reporting. THE CITY had already acquired thousands of campaign finance records, both through public databases and through Freedom of Information Law requests, and accelerated efforts to acquire complete data and identify suspicious patterns. Using data reporting techniques, they isolated a cluster of donations that campaign finance experts later told THE CITY were red flags.
2024-s-0116.impact: Since the first story was published, the Manhattan District Attorney’s Office disclosed to THE CITY that it has begun investigating several of the straw contributions identified by the team of reporters. The investigation also led THE CITY, in a separate investigation spearheaded by Yoav Gonen, to scrutinize one of the mayor's most trusted advisors and leading fundraisers. The city’s Department of Investigation has since opened an official inquiry into her behavior.
2024-s-0116.authors: GEORGE JOSEPH, BIANCA PALLARO, HAIDEE CHU, KATIE HONAN, TOM ROBBINS AND APRIL XU
2024-s-0116.summaryJa: マンハッタン州の検察官は昨年7月にエリック・アダムの支持者6人を草の寄付者陰謀で起訴した後,先の報告に基づいて THE CITYの記者らはすぐに同様の計画を発見できるかどうか調べ始めました. THE CITYは既に公的なデータベースと情報の自由法要求を通じて何千もの選挙資金記録を取得し,完全なデータと疑わしいパターンを特定するための努力を加速しました. 選挙資金の専門家が THE CITY に後に赤い旗だと言った寄付を隔離した.
2024-s-0116.impactJa: ニュースの公開後,マンハッタン地方検察局は,記者団が確認した多くの吸塵の貢献について調査を開始したことを THE CITYに明らかにした.調査は,YOav Gonenが率いる別の調査で,市長の最も信頼できる助言者および主要な資金調達者の1人を徹底的に調査するよう導いた.その後,市の調査局は彼女の行動について公式な調査を開始した.

2024-s-0117.summary: In Pakistan's Sindh, a province grappling with extreme climate events under a single political party's rule for three consecutive terms, we investigated the government's role in mitigating the aftermath. Our findings were perplexing. Over 16 years, the Sindh Government allocated more funds for a flyover and underpass project in a small Karachi town than for the entire disaster management budget of the province most prone to climate change disasters. The cumulative 16-year Sindh Climate Budget expenditure of PKR 20.200 billion is eclipsed by the cost of an Expressway, a controversial mega road project valued at PKR 27.5 billion.
2024-s-0117.impact: Despite being published in a low-scale media outlet, our project gained widespread recognition among climate activists, academia, and the development sector. It was featured among the [top 10 data-driven](https://gijn.org/stories/data-journalism-top-10-israel-hamas-war-breathing-machine-defects-loneliness-epidemic-and-nobel-prize-winners/) stories for September and October 2023 by the Global Investigative Journalism Network and other major international media outlets. The same network later declared it one of the top [investigative stories in Pakistan](https://gijn.org/stories/2023-best-investigative-stories-pakistan/) for 2023, and the Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism Newsletter acknowledged the story in November 2023. Following the project's launch on the website, media development organizations requested our assistance in training journalists on interpreting government budget books. We conducted [two training ](https://www.instagram.com/p/C010JbkMIGl/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link) sessions and are currently developing a module in response to high demand from the journalistic community. Beyond journalists, political parties, mainly from the opposition, are reaching out to us for training on budget book analysis. The project has ignited a debate in academia, politics, and the development sector on flawed development policies causing harm to vulnerable communities during climate change phenomena.
2024-s-0117.tools: AI/Machine learning, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, OpenStreetMap
2024-s-0117.summaryJa: パキスタンのシンジには,連続 3 期に単一政党の支配下で極端な気候出来事に直面している省で,その影響を緩和するに関する政府の役割を調査しました.我々の結論は戸惑いのものでした.16 年期間にシンジ州省は,気候変化に最も容易な省の災害管理予算全体により,小さなカーチの都市で飛行橋や地下橋のプロジェクトにより多くの資金を割り当てました. 16年間のシンドの気候予算の総支出は20200億ドルで,PKR27.5億ドルで議論の余地のあるメガロードプロジェクトである高速道路のコストが覆われている.
2024-s-0117.impactJa: 低規模メディアで公開されたにもかかわらず,我々のプロジェクトは気候変動活動家,学術界,開発部門の間で広く認識を得ました.このプロジェクトは,Global Investigative Journalism Networkおよび他の主要な国際メディアによって2023年9月と10月の[トップ10のデータ主導] (https://gijn.org/stories/data-journalism-top-10-israel-hamas-war-breathing-machine-defects-loneliness-epidemic-and-nobel-prize-winners/) の記事に掲載されました. 同ネットワークは後に2023年のトップの[パキスタンにおける調査物語]の1つと宣言し,ロイタージャーナリズム研究研究所ニュースレターが2023年11月にこの記事を承認した.このプロジェクトがウェブサイトで開始された後,メディア開発機関は,政府の予算書を解釈するジャーナリストの訓練に我々の協力を要請した. ジャーナリストの高い需要に応えて,現在,モジュールを開発しています. ジャーナリスト以外にも,主要的に反対派政党も予算簿分析の訓練のために,私たちへ連絡を寄せています. このプロジェクトは,気候変動現象で脆弱な地域社会に害を及ぼす欠陥のある開発政策について学術界,政治,開発部門で議論を招いた.

2024-s-0118.summary: “Destabilized” exposed an ongoing crisis of housing affordability and homelessness in New York: tens of thousands of apartments with rents capped under the state’s rent regulation law sit vacant, held off the market by landlords. Combining investigative data analysis with in-person reporting, we examined evidence landlords are intentionally keeping apartments empty — with as many as 88,000 vacant at one point in 2021 — after a 2019 state overhaul of tenant laws strictly limited rent increases.
2024-s-0118.impact: THE CITY created an interactive map that lets readers search by address and see every apartment unit that was registered with the state as rent-stabilized in 2019 but no longer is. THE CITY also published a guide on how a tenant can look up their rent history. The interactive map uses a unique dataset created by the nonprofit group JustFix, which extracted information from property tax bills for 2019, 2020, and 2021. This dataset included details on 45,000 buildings with rent-stabilized units. During fact-checking, THE CITY identified and helped fix an error that affected nearly 500 records in the dataset. Further sample checks were conducted to verify the data's credibility. After the app was published, renters contacted THE CITY to share their rental histories and inconsistencies in their rent payments. An email from housing advocacy group West Bronx Housing and Neighborhood Resource Center Executive Director said, “I just wanted to reach out and share an example of a building where the landlord is flagrantly deregulating the units, which we found using your map of deregulated units tool. We're going to be investigating the other building he owns. See attached, and thank you so much for this wonderful tool.”
2024-s-0118.authors: Sam Rabiyah, Suhail Bhat, Scott Klein
2024-s-0118.summaryJa: 安定化ニューヨーカーにおける住宅価格の危機とホームレスという危機を暴露しました賃貸規制法の下で賃貸制限を課した数十万のアパートが空きまま土地所有者が市場から取り除きました調査データ分析と個人報告を組み合わせて,我々は,賃貸者法律の2019年の改革の後,賃貸の厳格な制限の増額により,2021年に1つの時点で88,000人ほど空きアパートを意図的に空き屋にしている証拠を調査しました.
2024-s-0118.impactJa: THE CITY は,読者が住所別で検索し,2019年に州で登録されたアパートの1棟をレンタル安定化として確認できるインタラクティブな地図を作成した.また,賃貸者がレンタル履歴をどのように調べることができるのかについてのガイドも公開した.インタラクティブな地図は,非営利団体JustFixが作成したユニークなデータセットを使用しています.このサイトは,2019,2020,2021年の不動産税請求書から情報を抽出した. このデータセットには,賃貸安定したユニットを持つ45,000棟の詳細が含まれていた.事実チェック中に,The Cityはデータセットの500件近くに影響を与えたエラーを特定し,修正するのに役立ちました.データの信頼性を確認するために,さらなるサンプルチェックが行われた.アプリが公開された後,賃貸者は THE CITYに連絡し,賃貸の履歴と賃貸支払いの不一致を共有しました. ウェスト・ブロンクス・ハウジング・アンド・ネバーハード・リソース・センターのエグゼクティブ・ディレクターから送られたメールでは",土地主がユニットを暴然と規制解除している建物の一例を紹介したいのですが,この素晴らしいツールのために感謝します.

2024-s-0119.summary: Indonesia is approaching another presidential election in 2024. With that, we feel obliged to provide the information the voters would need in the ballot. This information ranges from the multiple candidates' background, political track record, controversies, oligarchic support, and, ultimately, their views on issues the voters deem important. These issues are divided to topics, namely economics, law, social welfare, environment, national security, and international relations. As politics can be a heavy issue for some, we're presenting this information in a game format where readers can interact directly with our content and even give their own ratings on the candidates' views.
2024-s-0119.impact: Two months after its release, the page has helped more than k views getting to know more of their presidential candidates. It has also been used as a reference for young voters in Indonesia, which would dominate this election by more than 50%.
2024-s-0119.tools: Json, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, Figma (UI/UX tool), React JS (programming language)
2024-s-0119.authors: Aria W. Yudhistira (ed), Amelia Yesidora, Reza Pahlevi, Puja Pratama, Leoni Susanto, Vika Azkiya Dihni, Andrea Lidwina, Sorta Tobing (ed), Amosella, Lambok Hutabarat, Firman Firdaus, Mhd. Fadly, Biworo Manunggal, Farizan Kazhimi
2024-s-0119.summaryJa: インドネシアは 2024年の大統領選挙に迫っています. そのことで,私たちは投票で有権者が必要とする情報を提供する必要性を感じています. この情報は複数の候補者の背景,政治的記録,論争,寡頭支持,そして,最終的に,有権者が重要だと考える問題に対する彼らの見解から始まります. これらの問題は経済,法律,社会福祉,環境,国家安全保障,国際関係などに区切られています政治は多くの人にとって重大な課題になりうるので視聴者がコンテンツと直接関わり候補者の意見に自らの評価を与えることができるゲーム形式で情報を提示しています
2024-s-0119.impactJa: 公開後2ヶ月後,このページはKより多くのビューが大統領候補について知り合うのを助けました.また,インドネシアの若い投票者への参考として使用されました.

2024-s-0120.summary: On March 23, THE CITY published a story and forensic video investigation offering a behind-the-scenes look at how two NYPD chiefs intervened in the case of a retired cop who was arrested for allegedly menacing three youths with a gun. Yoav Gonen obtained video from 36 body-worn, neighborhood and precinct house cameras. Through a painstaking video investigation, THE CITY was able to piece together the clearest account of what happened on a Thanksgiving eve in Brownsville, when an ex-cop allegedly menaced three youths with a gun — and one of the top-ranked officers in the NYPD intervened to have him released.
2024-s-0120.impact: Following THE CITY’s story, regional station Hot 97 interviewed the three boys about their ordeal, further raising awareness of the incident and Maddrey’s intervention on behalf of the officer who chased the boys. Our video investigation single-handedly reignited interest in a 2021 police incident in which a retired cop allegedly menaced youths with a gun and then had his arrest voided after the intervention of Chief Jeffrey Maddrey, one of the highest ranking officers in the NYPD. After our video was released, public demonstrations were held in front of City Hall and elected officials began to side with the youths. Then, in a stunning and unprecedented decision against such a high-ranking officer, a civilian review board ruled in April that Maddrey had abused his authority, and in May the police commissioner, who had previously rejected hundreds of review board rulings, levied the maximum penalty against Maddrey, who is fighting the decision. Shortly afterward, the department’s first woman and third Black commissioner abruptly announced her departure from the NYPD. A source close to Sewell told THE CITY that in making the decision to discipline Maddrey, the commissioner “knew her days were numbered.”
2024-s-0120.summaryJa: 3月23日,The Cityは,ニューヨーク警察局の2人の警察長が,銃で3人の若者を脅かす容疑で逮捕された退役警察官の事件に幕後介入した方法を紹介するニュースと法医のビデオ調査を発表した. 徹底したビデオ調査を通じて THE CITYはブラウンズビルで感謝祭の夜に起きたことの最も明確な説明をまとめました元警察官が銃で3人の若者を脅かすと
2024-s-0120.impactJa: THE CITYの話を続き,地域放送Hot 97は3人の少年を彼らの試練についてインタビューし,事件と少年を追った警官の代りにマドリーの介入についてさらに意識を高めました. ビデオ調査は,単独で2021年の警察事件に関心を再開し,退職した警察官が若者を銃で脅迫した事件で,NYPDの最高級の警察官であるジェフリー・マドリー長官の介入後,逮捕を無効させた. その後,このような高級官に対して,驚くべきかつ前例のない決定で,民間の審査委員会が4月にマドリーが権限を乱用したと判断し,5月に警察委員は,以前に数百件の審査委員会判決を拒絶した.この決定と闘っているマドリーに対して最大限の罰金を課した.直後,部門の最初の女性と第三の黒人委員は,ニューヨーク警察局を急に退去することを発表した. シーウェルの親しい情報源は THE CITYにマドリーを懲戒する決断を下す際に委員長は <unk>彼女の日が数値であることを知っていました

2024-s-0121.summary: "El aquelarre", commissioned by the Duchess of Osuna to Goya in the 18th century, is a work that criticizes superstition against women. In the center, a goat symbolizes the devil, surrounded by witches who worship him and offer babies, reflecting female stigmas. Goya deals with the persecution of women accused of witchcraft, showing them old and ugly, distorting reality. The night scene, with demonic elements and bats, accentuates the tenebrous. The Duchess of Osuna, a woman ahead of her time, chooses this social criticism instead of conforming to the stereotype of the nobility.
2024-s-0121.impact: The impact of the article on Goya's "El aquelarre" has been significant, especially in the readers' appreciation of descriptive pieces of artwork. The detailed exploration of the painting, providing historical context and critical analysis, has generated positive interest. Readers value the revelation of the symbolic and social layers in the work, as well as the connection to the innovative figure of the Duchess of Osuna. The combination of descriptive elements and in-depth analysis has captured the attention and appreciation of the audience, highlighting the importance of exploring art from an informative and contextual perspective.
2024-s-0121.authors: Ana Marcos , Jacob Vicente López, Mariano Zafra
2024-s-0121.summaryJa: "The aquelarre"は18世紀にオスナ公主からゴヤに委託されたもので,女性に対する迷信を批判する作品です.中央では,羊は悪魔を象徴し,彼を崇拝し赤ちゃんを捧げる魔女に囲まれています. オスナ公爵夫人は時代を先行した女性で優位性のステレオタイプに服従する代わりにこの社会批判を選びました
2024-s-0121.impactJa: 画画の詳細な探索は,歴史的文脈と批判的な分析を提供して,ポジティブな関心を生み出しました. 読者は,作品における象徴的および社会的層の開示,そしてオズーナ公爵夫人の革新的な形象とのつながりを評価しています. 記述要素と深入分析の組み合わせは聴衆の注意と評価を集め情報と文脈の観点から芸術を探求する重要性を強調しました

2024-s-0122.summary: This article explores the demographic dynamics between India and China, highlighting how India is overtaking China in population after more than a century of Chinese leadership. While China faces a demographic decline due to an aging population and restrictive birth control policies, India is experiencing a population explosion driven by a young population. Birth control strategies, wealth disparities and rapid urbanization in India, where megacities such as Delhi are projected to become the most populous in the world, are examined. In addition, the phenomenon of rural exodus and ongoing urbanization is highlighted.
2024-s-0122.impact: The impact of the demographic project in India has been remarkable, marking a historic milestone by surpassing China in population. The population explosion, driven by a steadily growing young population, projects significant consequences for the Indian economy in the coming years. This population increase presents economic opportunities, as the expanding labor force can contribute to economic development. However, it also poses challenges, such as the need to create jobs, improve infrastructure and address socioeconomic inequalities. Strategic planning will be crucial to take advantage of the "population momentum" and ensure equitable and sustainable development.
2024-s-0122.tools: Animation, 3D modeling, Scraping, QGIS, Adobe Creative Suite, R, Svelte
2024-s-0122.authors: Laura Navarro , Jacob Vicente López, Jorge Marzo Arauzo
2024-s-0122.summaryJa: この記事はインドと中国の人口動態を調査し,中国の指導率100年以上後にインドが中国を人口に上回っていることを強調しています. 中国が高齢化人口と制限的な出生管理政策により人口減少に直面している一方で,インドは若い人口によって人口爆発を経験しています. 生まれつき制御戦略,富の格差,そしてインドの急速な都市化について調べられ,デリーのような都市が世界で最も人口が多い都市になるという予測がされています.
2024-s-0122.impactJa: 人口増加は,人口増加によって中国を上回る歴史的なマイルストーンを記録し,インドの人口増加は,今後数年でインド経済に大きな影響を及ぼす. 人口増加は,拡大する労働力が経済発展に貢献できるため,経済的機会を提示する. しかし,雇用創出,インフラ整備,社会経済格差に対処する必要性なども課題を提示する.

2024-s-0123.summary: This article reveals the shocking reality facing Ukraine since the beginning of the war with Russia. Through more than 15,000 anti-aircraft alarms, the population lives in constant fear of bombings. The story details how, in the face of danger, people seek shelter in basements and subway stations, with average alert periods of 60 minutes. Despite adaptation to the siren routine, disobedience to the alerts has had deadly consequences. The article also highlights the diminished reaction of the population to the alarms and the evolution of the situation throughout the conflict.
2024-s-0123.impact: The impact of the project, represented in the article, has been significant and has generated a strong response from both critics and readers. The piece has been praised for its ability to convey the stark reality in Ukraine, specifically highlighting the more than 15,000 anti-aircraft alarms that have marked the daily lives of the population. The hopelessness is accentuated by observing the passivity of the population in the face of the bombs, revealing a shocking adaptation to a dangerous routine. This narrative moves readers, raising awareness of the difficult situation facing the country and provoking a profound reflection on resilience and human adaptation in the midst of conflict.
2024-s-0123.tools: Scraping, QGIS, Adobe Creative Suite, R, Svelte
2024-s-0123.authors: Laura Navarro Soler, Jacob Vicente López, Montse Hidalgo Pérez
2024-s-0123.summaryJa: この記事では,ロシアとの戦争開始以来ウクライナが直面している衝撃的な現実を明らかにしています. 15,000以上の防空警報によって,人々は爆弾攻撃を絶えず恐れています.この話では,危険に直面して,人々が地下室や地下鉄駅に避難所を探し,平均的な警戒期間は60分です.サイレンの日常に適応したにもかかわらず,警告への不服従は致命的な結果をもたらしています. 記事ではまた警報に対する人口の反応が減少し紛争中における状況の変化も強調されています
2024-s-0123.impactJa: この記事に示されたプロジェクトの影響は,重要であり,批評家と読者の強い反応を生み出しました.この作品はウクライナの厳しい現実を伝える能力のために称賛され,特に人口の日常生活に特徴を及ぼした15,000以上の防空警報を強調しています. 絶望は,爆弾に直面する人々の被動性を観察することで加強され,危険なルーチンに衝撃的な適応を明らかにします.この物語は読者を動かす.この物語は,国の困難な状況に対する認識を高め,紛争の真ん中に回復力と人間の適応について深い反省を促します.

2024-s-0124.summary: The article highlights the advantages of the Leopard 2 tank in the Ukrainian conflict. With advanced German technology, NATO-standard 120 mm ammunition and armored compartments, it offers superior defense to Russian tanks. Its mobility and attack-on-the-move capability are outstanding, along with protection against anti-tank ordnance. Rapid deployment, supported by 15 European countries, is considered crucial. Compared to Russian tanks, the Leopard 2 prioritizes crew safety. Conceived in the 1970s, its evolution shows superiority in quality and armor. In short, it is a tactically advanced and versatile tank.
2024-s-0124.impact: The article on the Leopard 2 tank has generated a significant impact. It has been positively received by both specialized critics and readers, who find it extremely interesting. The focus is on the detailed advantages of the Leopard 2 in the Ukrainian conflict, highlighting its advanced technology, superior defense, tactical mobility and precise strike capabilities. Information on the rapid deployment supported by 15 European countries has also generated interest. In summary, the project has succeeded in providing an informative and well-received analysis on a topic relevant in the current context.
2024-s-0124.tools: 3D modeling, QGIS, Adobe Creative Suite, R, Svelte
2024-s-0124.summaryJa: 記事では,ウクライナ紛争におけるLeopard 2戦車の優位性を強調する.先進ドイツ技術,NATO標準の120mm弾薬と装甲用コンパートメントにより,ロシア戦車に対する優れた防御を提供している.その移動性と攻撃-オン-the-move能力は,反戦車弾薬に対する保護とともに顕著である.15の欧州諸国によって支援された急速な展開は,重要なと考えられている.ロシア戦車と比較して,Leopard 2は乗組員の安全を優先している. 1970年代に設計されたこの戦車は質量と装甲の優位性を示しています
2024-s-0124.impactJa: ウクライナ戦車におけるレオパード2の詳細な利点に焦点を当て,その先進技術,優れた防衛,戦術移動力,精密な攻撃能力を強調している.15の欧州諸国によって支援された急速な展開に関する情報も関心を寄せている. 概して,このプロジェクトは,現在の文脈で関連のある話題について,情報提供し,よく受け取りの分析を成功させました.

2024-s-0125.summary: New Yorkers went to the polls last yeah to elect a new City Council. The November general election followed the city’s June primaries where every one of New York’s 51 City Council seats was up for grabs — in newly redrawn districts. Some districts were almost unrecognizable, while others may have lost an airport, or gained a large housing complex full of voting-age adults. To help our readers understand their local district, we’ve created a guide to give them key information about their district’s candidates, demographics, and voting patterns.
2024-s-0125.impact: The project proved useful and popular. In the days leading up to the June primaries, the guide was viewed more times than the number of people who participated in early voting. By the end of early voting, Know Your District garnered 100,000 page views, while the number of early votes was 65,000.
2024-s-0125.authors: Rachel Holliday Smith, Ari Ephraim Feldman, Sam Rabiyah, Suhail Bhat, Scott Klein
2024-s-0125.summaryJa: ニューヨーク市議会は,新市議会の選挙で選出した.ニューヨーク市議会の51席のうち,各席が新たに再編された地区で選出され,11月の総選挙は6月の市議会初選の後に行われた.一部の地区はほとんど認識できないが,他の地区は空港を失ったり,投票年齢の成人に満たされた大きな住宅複合施設を獲得した. 地域住民の地域を理解するために,私たちは彼らの地域住民の候補者,人口統計,投票パターンに関する重要な情報を提供するガイドを作成しました.
2024-s-0125.impactJa: 選挙の開始前には,そのガイドは早期投票に参加した人数よりも多く閲覧された.早期投票終了までに,あなたの地区を知って100,000ページビューを獲得し,早期投票者数は65,000でした.

2024-s-0126.summary: When homeowners die without a will, speculators scoop up shares from unsuspecting heirs in a scheme that destroys generational wealth in Black & Latino communities.
2024-s-0126.impact: Historically, this phenomenon of speculative acquisition of fractional property interests took place in the rural south. THE CITY’s series documented the scheme for the first time in an urban or northern context. The speculators' candid descriptions of their business model, published in Joseph and Maldonado's first investigative piece in April, generated immediate outrage from lawmakers and community leaders. A second investigation has since catalyzed widespread demands for legal protections for homeowners and reform of agencies overseeing asset distribution. Joseph and Maldonado also detailed the legal loopholes and lack of oversight that makes such schemes possible — and THE CITY published the names of the LLCs the speculators hid behind. After THE CITY’s investigation, city and state legislators have vowed to introduce bills aimed at curbing fractional deed speculation by informing heirs of the value of their inheritances and providing them with legal resources. Likewise, federal and county law enforcement have told THE CITY they are investigating the two rings of speculators our series profiled.
2024-s-0126.summaryJa: 投機者は無意識の相続者から財産を回収し黒人・ラテン系コミュニティの世代を破壊する計画です
2024-s-0126.impactJa: 歴史的に,この現象は,小規模な財産権の投機的な取得が南部の農村部で行われた.都市シリーズでは,都市または北部の文脈でこの計画を初めて記録した.投機者の彼らのビジネスモデルについての率直な記述は,ジョセフとマルドナドの最初の調査論文で4月に発表された. 第二次調査は,住宅所有者に対する法的保護と資産分配を監督する機関改革を求める広範な要求を催化した.ジョセフとマルドナドは,そのような計画を実現する法的漏洞と監督の欠如を詳細に説明した. 都市調査の後,都市と州議会は,相続人の遺産の価値を知らせ,法律資源を提供することで,分割された財産の投機を抑制する法案を導入すると約束した.同様に,連邦と郡の法執行当局は,我々のシリーズで紹介された投機者の2つの輪を調査していると都市に伝えた.

2024-s-0127.summary: This project comprehensively investigated bail reform efforts in Cuyahoga County, Ohio, where the use of cash bail has dropped significantly. But instead of implementing more controversial or sweeping reforms — changes to state laws, formal court rules or an expensive overhaul of the county’s pretrial services — county justice officials told us they changed their culture and practices. It involved an in-depth analysis of felony cases, highlighting the impacts of bail system changes on public safety, racial disparities, and jail populations. The package also included a historical timeline of bail reform efforts and an explainer on Ohio's bail bond system.
2024-s-0127.impact: The criminal justice system — and especially the court system — is resistant to systemic change. At the same time, our story focuses on reform. We think that makes it a unique and necessary type of investigation that’s part of a bigger effort to shine a light on Cleveland’s court system. Our investigation shows how a major reform came to be and what could challenge it in the future. We’ve heard from judges and policy makers that our work offers an important and clear-eyed perspective on a critical topic. At the same time, we wanted to give audiences news they could use about a system that still affects thousands of people every year. Our explainer on the basics of bail in Ohio is about the least flashy piece of content one could imagine, but it’s the top result on Google and the source Google uses to answer search questions about bail in the state. Soon, the explainer will be distributed as a printed flier in justice-affected communities.

2024-s-0127.summaryJa: このプロジェクトは,オハイオ州キュアホガ郡における保釈改革の取り組みを全面的に調査した.現金保釈の使用が大幅に減少した.しかし,より論争の的または徹底的な改革を実施する代わりに,州法,公式裁判所規則の変更,または郡の裁判事前サービスの高価な改革を县司法当局は,自分たちの文化と慣行を変えたと告げた. 事件の詳細な分析を伴う.このパッケージは,公共の安全,人種差異,刑務所人口に対する保釈制度変更の影響を強調した.また,保釈改革の歴史的なタイムラインとオハイオ州保釈債制度についての説明も含まれていた.
2024-s-0127.impactJa: 刑事司法制度は,特に裁判所制度は,制度変化に抵抗しています.同時に,私たちの物語は改革に焦点を当てています.私たちはそれがクリーブランドの裁判所制度を明るくするより大きな取り組みの一環として,ユニークな必要性のある調査の種類だと考えています.私たちの調査は,大規模な改革がどのように実現し,将来何がそれを挑戦できるかを示しています. 裁判官や政策立案者からは,私たちの研究は重要なテーマについて重要な目光で明確な視点を提供することを聞いた.同時に,私たちは,毎年何千人もの人々に影響を与えるシステムについて,利用できるニュースを提供したいと考えました.オハイオ州における保釈の基本についての説明は,想像できる内容の最も不具合的な内容についてです.しかし,それはGoogleのトップ結果であり,Googleが州内の保釈に関する検索質問に答えるために使用するソースです. すぐには説明書が公正に影響を受ける地域では印刷されたプレッシャーとして配布されます

2024-s-0128.summary: My project was a data feature that looked at how Americans felt about artificial intelligence-produced entertainment and whether it would have a negative or positive impact in the industry and on the world. For the feature, I surveyed thousands of Americans about whether they would watch entertainment (film, TV shows, or books) created by AI. I also explored Americans' (and the entertainment industry's) concerns about deepfakes given that the likeness of some popular actors and figures have already been used in nefarious images and videos. I interviewed screenwriters, directors, a Hollywood agent, and CEOs for the story.
2024-s-0128.impact: When I worked on my story in early 2023 and published it in April of last year, it was before artificial intelligence was being talked about in Hollywood and entertainment industry. I also published the story ahead of the WGA and SAG-AFTRA strike, which ended up being timely given that AI was such an important talking point when it came to negotiations. While other trade publications like Variety and The Hollywood Reporter started some reporting about AI around this time, I'm confident my piece was one of the first that featured data and insight in-depth on how Americans feel about the future of AI and how it impacts their entertainment.

2024-s-0128.impactJa: 私は2023年初頭に自分の記事を執筆し去年の4月に公開したときハリウッドやエンターテインメント業界で人工知能が話題になる前にでした WGAとSAG-AFTRAのストライキの前にも記事を公開しましたこれは交渉時に AIが重要な話題だったことを考えるとタイミングが良かったのです他の雑誌やヴァライティーやハリウッド・レポーターなどの雑誌はこの頃 AIについて報道を始めたが私の作品は AIの将来や娯楽に影響を及ぼす影響についてアメリカ人がどう感じているか詳細なデータと洞察を掲載した最初の記事の一つだと確信しています

2024-s-0129.summary: _Nuestro Dinero_ es una plataforma que ofrece a los ciudadanos herramientas para entender, analizar y vigilar el uso de recursos públicos en México, en especial en sus dos facetas más importantes: el gasto del presupuesto, así como los contratos y compras del gobierno. El sitio ofrece instrumentos para que los ciudadanos conozcan y dominen las fuentes de información de primera mano. Al mismo tiempo, trimestralmente publicamos análisis con los últimos datos disponibles, en donde identificamos y denunciamos patrones anómalos, corrupción, violaciones a la ley y otras irregularidades, para que autoridades y ciudadanos puedan aprovechar nuestros hallazgos y propuestas.
2024-s-0129.impact: Además de más de 25 mil visitas únicas en el último año, la plataforma de Nuestro Dinero se ha convertido en un referente para periodistas, académicos y ciudadanos interesados en el combate a la corrupción, pues cada nueva entrega es replicada ampliamente en medios de comunicación y redes sociales, a la vez que provoca reacciones en las autoridades (así sea solo para responder o atacar los hallazgos). Así hemos podido incidir para recuperar información pérdida, que se detengan procesos riesgosos de contratación o se revierta un ajuste presupuestal indeseado. Con las herramientas de Nuestro Dinero también hemos dado talleres a otras organizaciones nacionales y estatales, permitiendo que más personas puedan vigilar el uso de recursos públicos y se sumen a nuestra batalla por ser un contrapeso ciudadano al poder. Estamos trabajando para ampliar Nuestro Dinero para integrar análisis de los gobiernos locales. El proyecto también tiene una vertiente comunicativa muy importante, pues generamos infografías, cómics, videos, pódcasts, TikToks y contenido multimedia para acercar la información a públicos cada vez más amplios, con un alcance de más de 1.3 millones de espectadores. La plataforma fue premiada por el Instituto Nacional de Transparencia (INAI) en su "Certamen de Innovación en Transparencia 2023".

2024-s-0129.summaryJa: 市民がメキシコの公共資源の利用を理解し,分析し,監視するためのツールを提供するプラットフォームです. 特にその2つの最も重要な側面は予算支出,政府による契約や購入です. また,我々は3ヶ月ごとに最新のデータで分析を公表し,異常なパターン,腐敗,法違反,その他の不正を特定し,報告しています.
2024-s-0129.impactJa: 過去1年間で25000件以上の訪問に加えて,Nusestro Dineroのプラットフォームは,腐敗対策に関心のあるジャーナリスト,学術家,市民の参考になりました. 新品の配信はメディアやソーシャルメディアで広く複製され,当局の反応を引き起こしています. 資金調達のリスクは減り,不必要な予算調整が逆転し,また,我々の金銭のツールによって,他の国家・州機関にワークショップを設け,より多くの人々が公共資源の使用を監視し,権力に対する市民の対重であるために我々の戦いに加わるようにしました. 地方政府からの分析を統合するために私たちのお金の拡大に取り組んでいます. このプロジェクトは非常に重要なコミュニケーション側面もあります. 私たちは情報やコミック,ビデオ,ポッドキャスト,TikToks,およびマルチメディアコンテンツを生成し,情報をより広範な観客に届けます 1.3百万以上の視聴者. プラットフォームは"2023年の透明性のイノベーション調査"で,国家透明研究所 (INAI) により賞を受賞しました.

2024-s-0130.summary: A reportagem investigativa trouxe à luz relações societárias que suscitam dúvidas quanto à imparcialidade do diagnóstico dos danos provocados pela petroquímica Braskem na cidade de Maceió após a atividade de mineração da empresa causar o afundamento do solo, a desocupação de cinco bairros e o deslocamento de cerca de 60 mil pessoas. Após decisão judicial determinar que a empresa financiasse um diagnóstico independente, servindo como referência para ações de mitigação de danos, as consultorias Diagonal e Tetra Tech foram contratadas para conduzir o estudo. Mas tanto a população afetada quanto pesquisadores apontam fragilidades metodológicas e condescendência em relação à petroquímica.
2024-s-0130.impact: A reportagem teve cerca de 7.500 visualizações em nosso site, no entanto o impacto real foi muito maior. O conteúdo foi repercutido ou reproduzido em diversos veículos de comunicação locais e regionais. Entre eles, o Jornal de Alagoas, a Marco Zero Conteúdo, Tribuna Hoje, Correio dos Municípios e Correio do Sertão. A audiência destes veículos, somada, supera 1 milhão de leitores mensais.(https://tribunahoje.com/noticias/cidades/2023/06/13/121880-ligacoes-entre-braskem-e-empresas-contratadas-levantam-suspeitas-sobre-diagnostico-socioambiental-em-maceio; https://tribunadosertao.com.br/noticias/2023/06/13/437794-ligacoes-entre-braskem-e-empresas-contratadas-levantam-suspeitas-sobre-diagnostico-socioambiental-em-maceio; https://marcozero.org/as-taticas-de-desinformacao-a-favor-da-empresa-que-causou-o-afundamento-de-cinco-bairros-de-maceio/) Após a publicação da reportagem, moradores e pesquisadores pediram anulação dos diagnósticos, questionando a transparência e a independência das consultorias, inclusive em audiência pública no Senado Federal. O Ministério Público Federal prometeu investigar as ligações (https://www.mpf.mp.br/al/sala-de-imprensa/noticias-al/encontro-virtual-com-mpf-mpal-e-municipio-de-maceio-discute-ajustes-no-diagnostico-tecnico-participativo-apos-escutas-publicas), enquanto a Braskem seguiu negando possuir qualquer relação com as empresas, embora a conexão esteja muito bem documentada.
2024-s-0130.summaryJa: 調査報告は,企業関係が明らかになったが,その調査結果では,Braskemの石油化学の被害の診断が公正であるかどうか疑われ,その鉱業が地没を招き,5つの街区が失業し,約6万人以上が避難した. 裁判所が判断した後会社は独立診断を資金提供し損害緩和の基準として診断を担当したため診断とテトラテクの診療所は試験を遂行するために雇われた. しかし影響を受けた人々と研究者は石油化学に対する方法論的な脆弱性と寛容性を指摘しています.
2024-s-0130.impactJa: ニュースには7,500件ほど視聴者がいたが,実際の影響ははるかに大きい. 内容は,アラゴアス新聞,マルコゼロコンテンツ,トリビューナ・今日,市政郵便局,セルタン郵便局など,様々な地域および地域メディアに流出または再生された. 自動車の視聴者は1百万人を超えています.https://tribunahoje.com/news/city/2023/06/13/121880-inter-braskem-e-企業-契約者-起床-疑惑者-診断-社会環境-機械; https://tribunadosertao.com.br/noticias/2023/06/13/437794-inter-braskem-e-企業-契約者-起床-診断-社会環境-疑惑者-企業-企業-企業-雇用; https://marcozero.org/as-des-notification-to-facts-of-the-company-e-commerce; https://marcozero.org/as-des-notification-to-facts-of-the-company-work-over-the-marcozero.org 報告が公表された後,住民と研究者は診断をキャンセルするよう求めた. 連邦上院での公聴会でも,診療所の透明性と独立性を問及した. 連邦検察は,リンクを調査することを約束した (https://www.mpf.mp.br/al/press-room/news-al/virtual-meeting-with-mpf-mpal-e-municipality-maceio-dispute-adjustments-no-diagnostic-technical-participative-after-public-hearsing),一方, Braskemは,企業との関係性を否定した.

2024-s-0131.summary: This project is about conducting an analysis for the data being available on forest fires of Morocco. The investigation (Edited in Arabic) reveals that Morocco has lost approximately one million and 406 thousand hectares of its forests between 2016 and 2022. In contrast, the National Agency for Water and Forests, a government agency, claims that the degradation of forest-cover is estimated at only 17 thousand hectares annually! The investigation questions the government about the management of fire prevention programs, and doubts the credibility of forest management statements exposing the encroachment of cement towards the burned forests.
2024-s-0131.impact: 1- The Moroccan government has been exposed parliamentary scrutiny regarding the findings of the investigation, especially concerning the loss of approximately one million and 406 thousand hectares of forests between 2016 and 2022. The National Agency for Water and Forests claims that the deterioration of forest cover is only estimated at 17 thousand hectares annually. The alarming level of forest degradation in Morocco prompted a parliamentary inquiry directed at the Minister of Agriculture and Rural Development who is expected to respond in the coming days. 2- The National Agency for Water and Forests, has halted the daily update of the dynamic map that has been monitoring the kingdom's forest fires for over 11 years. This map was among the data sources used to support the investigation's hypothesis. However, immediately after submitting a request for clarifications regarding the data analysis results, the updating of fire data, ceased since July 20, 2023. 3- The Royal Academy of Arts in The Hague (KABK) chose the investigative on forest fires and transformed it into a visual narrative (artistic presentation) in collaboration with the (ARIJ) network. The innovative presentation of the investigation was showcased at the ARIJ conference in Amman and also at (COP29).
2024-s-0131.tools: Animation, 3D modeling, Json, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV
2024-s-0131.authors: (ARIJ), Artists from the Royal Academy of Art (KABK).
2024-s-0131.summaryJa: このプロジェクトではモロッコの森林火災に関するデータに関する分析を行います.調査 (アラビア語で編集) は,モロッコが2016年から2022年の間に約10万406千ヘクタール森林を失ってしまったことを明らかにしています. 捜査は政府に対し,火災予防プログラムの管理について疑問を呈し,燃えた森林への水泥の侵入を暴露する森林管理の声明の信頼性を疑っています.
2024-s-0131.impactJa: 1-モロッコ政府は調査の発見について,特に2016年から2022年の間に約10万406千ヘクタールの森林の損失について,議会による審査を受けています. モロッコの森林劣化が気になるレベルは,農業と農村開発大臣に宛てられた議会調査を促した. 2- 国民水と森林庁は,11年以上もの間,王国森林火災を監視してきた動態地図の毎日更新を停止した. この地図は調査の仮説を支持するために使用されたデータ源のうちでした. 3 ザ・Royal Academy of Arts in The Hague (KABK) は,森林火災に関する調査を選択し, (ARIJ) ネットワークと協力して視覚的叙述 (芸術的プレゼンテーション) に変身した.調査の革新的なプレゼンテーションは,AMMANのARIJ会議で展示された.

2024-s-0134.summary: As the pandemic upended our understanding of education’s role in society, one point became remarkably clear: schools are the first line of defense for student mental health support. But what isn’t always apparent is what help is available to the city’s nearly 900,000 public school students — and how outcomes can vary depending on the resources schools provide. We tracked dozens of data points on mental health support in NYC public schools. Do they call 911 on students in crisis? Are there enough social workers and guidance counselors? Readers can enter their school name below to find out.
2024-s-0134.impact: THE CITY teamed up with the nonprofit education news project Chalkbeat to create an interactive news application that allows parents to compare schools’ arrest statistics. Our lookup tool, which continues to be updated, collected data on over 1,500 public schools, from the number of guidance counselors and social workers to demographic data and educational outcomes. We also published a guide with Chalkbeat that walked parents through how they can advocate for more resources. The release of the app was followed by a panel discussion at the Brooklyn Public Library, featuring parents, parent advocates and students who discussed their experiences accessing mental health resources for children and the challenges they face.
2024-s-0134.authors: Sam Rabiyah, Suhail Bhat, Scott Klein, Amy Zimmer
2024-s-0134.summaryJa: 疫情が社会における教育の役割についての理解を変化させると,一つのポイントは顕著に明らかになりました.学校は学生の精神衛生支援の第一防衛線です.しかし,必ずしも明らかではないのは,市内の近9億人の公立学校生徒にどのような支援が提供されているか,そして学校が提供するリソースによって結果がどのように変化するかをです. NYC公立学校における精神衛生支援に関する数十のデータポイントを追跡しました. 危機状態にある学生に1111電話をかけますか? 社会福祉士や指導カウンセラーが十分ですか? 読者は,その学校名を下記に入力して調べることができます.
2024-s-0134.impactJa: ザ・シティは非営利教育ニュースプロジェクトチャールクビートと連携して,親が学校<unk>逮捕統計を比較できるようにするインタラクティブなニュースアプリを作成しました.継続的に更新されている私たちの検索ツールでは,指導カウンセラーや社会ワーカーの数から人口統計データ,教育結果まで,1500以上の公立学校に関するデータを収集しました.また,チャールクビートで親により多くのリソースをどのように擁護できるかを案内するガイドも公開しました. ブルックリン公立図書館でのパネルディスカッションが続いて両親や親の弁護者や生徒が子どもたちの精神衛生資源へのアクセスを経験し直面する課題について話し合った.

2024-s-0135.summary: Despite international sanctions imposed against Russia since the 2014 annexation of Crimea and the 2022 invasion of Ukraine, in mid-2023 President Putin launched the first part of a massive new Liquefied Natural Gas project in the far north of Siberia – built using expertise, technology and finance from Europe, Asia and the US. This data-driven investigation revealed how two European companies, Technip S.A. of France and Linde PLC, founded in Germany but headquartered in Ireland, played an integral role in Arctic LNG 2 from the start – and delivered materials right until, or even after, EU sanctions came into force.
2024-s-0135.impact: After publication, Technip’s share price plummeted 22%, wiping hundreds of millions of Euros from the company’s value. In the following weeks, the US State Department announced new sanctions targeting Arctic LNG 2. These were followed with US sanctions against Russian companies linked to Linde. The international investors in Arctic LNG 2 then reportedly suspended their involvement, and Samsung stopped building ships for the project, putting the future of the entire facility in doubt. Construction is not yet complete on two thirds of Arctic LNG 2. The investigation may therefore have mitigated environmental damage in the region and prevented hundreds of millions of tonnes of CO2 emissions. Ukrainian civil society organizations and the Ukrainian government’s anti-corruption agency welcomed the investigation, publicly called for new EU sanctions to target Russia’s lucrative energy sector and the companies involved in its expansion, and raised the investigation in their conversations with diplomats. The UK government created a new agency to crack down on companies skirting Russian sanctions. This appears partly linked to previous investigations by the team into UK-based companies supplying key components to Arctic LNG 2.
2024-s-0135.authors: Sam Leon, Louis Goddard, Sophia Baumann, Claus Hecking, Hans Koberstein, Nathan Niedermeier, Jérémie Baruch, Adrien Sénécat, Arthur Carpentier, Solène Reveney
2024-s-0135.summaryJa: 2014年のクリミア併合と2022年のウクライナ侵攻以来,ロシアに対する国際制裁にもかかわらず,2023年中旬にプーチン大統領は,ヨーロッパ,アジア,米国からの専門知識,技術,金融を使用して建設された巨大な新しい液化天然ガスプロジェクトの第1部分を立ち上げましたこのデータ駆動調査は,欧州の2つの企業,テクニップ S.A. フランスのLinde PLCはドイツで設立され,アイルランドに本部を置くが,EU制裁が生效するまで,またはそれ以降まで,直ぐに,ARctic LNG2に不可欠な役割を果たした.
2024-s-0135.impactJa: 公開後,Technip<unk>の株価は22%低下し,会社の価値から何百万人ものユーロを消した.その後数週間,米国国務省は北極LNG2を標的にする新たな制裁を発表. 報告によると,Arctic LNG2の国際投資家は,そのプロジェクトへの関与を中止し,三星はプロジェクトのための船舶を建設することを停止し,施設全体の将来を疑い込めた.この施設の2/3の建設はまだ完了していない.この調査は,この地域における環境被害を軽減し,何百万人ものトンのCO2排出を防ぐ可能性がある. ウクライナ市民社会組織とウクライナ政府による反腐敗機関が調査を歓迎し,ロシアが利益を得ているエネルギー部門とその拡大に関与する企業を標的にするEU制裁を公然に呼び,外交官との会話で調査を提起した. これは,アルクトックLNG2に重要な部品を供給する英国を拠点とする企業に関する研究に部分的に関連している.

2024-s-0136.summary: As members of The Trust Project and AijoProject.com, we are committed to improve our newsroom Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) ratio. We have developed two key initiatives: 'How Do I Say It?' - a public online tool designed to assist journalists and editors in finding the best wording when referring to specific topics or communities. 'Genie' - an internal tool designed to track our gender gap, providing metrics on female, male, and non-binary sources and quotes included in our original reporting. Both initiatives were launched in 2023, and we believe they represent innovative ideas that will significantly contribute to advancing the field.
2024-s-0136.impact: We launched both projects on March 8th for the international women day with a published article online and print edition. // How do I say it? The public site had more than 20.000 queries since its launch. We made marketing campaigns in social media and our own cable TV channel. We were invited to present the project in conferences (national and international) plus a special presentation to Mercado Libre UX department (big tech latin american unicorn) We made the project with a Google News Initiative grant and now Google is mentioning the tool when training journalists. // Genie (gender gap tracker) From June 2021 to date, more than 66,381 articles have been processed and approximately 136,000 people have been identified by gender, including 101 non-binary gender. Editorial sections trained to work with the tool include Community, World, Society, Ideas, Culture, Cars/Mobility, Property, and Wellbeing. More sections will be added in 2024. They don’t have specific metric goals yet, but they have been trained and are committed to achieving the best possible results on a best effort basis.
2024-s-0136.tools: AI/Machine learning, Json, Google Sheets, Python, NLP, Spacy, scikit-learn, Pandas, Python, FastAPI, GCP Compute Engine, AWS Sagemaker, pysentimiento
2024-s-0136.authors: Catalina Alvarez, Catalina Villazuela, Cecilia Zolezzi, Delfina Arambillet, Fernando Torres Ullmer, Florencia Abd, Florencia Bietti, Florencia Coelho, Félix Ramallo, Gabriel Alonso, Gabriela Bouret, Gabriela Miño, José Falvo, Lautaro Royan, Lucas Vélez, Lucila Mundani, María Inés Arán, María Paula Pilijos, Martín Pascua, Melanie Prokopiec, Melisa Vera Chavez, Natalia Louzau, Pablo Arellano, Pablo Loscri, Paula Silva Montes de Oca, Tobías González, Victoria Achinelli
2024-s-0136.summaryJa: The Trust ProjectとAijoProject.comのメンバーとして,私たちはニュースルームの多様性,公平性,および包摂 (DEI) 率を向上させることにコミットしています. 我々は2つの主要な取り組みを開発しました. 'How Do I Say It?' - 特定のトピックやコミュニティを参照する際にジャーナリストや編集者に最良の語文を見つけるのに役立つための公共オンラインツールです. 'Genie' - 私たちのオリジナルレポートに含まれている女性,男性,および非バイナリソースのメトリックと引用を提供し,ジェンダーギャップを追跡するために設計された内部ツールです. 両イニシアチブも2023年に開始され,この分野を前進させるための革新的なアイデアを代表すると考えています.
2024-s-0136.impactJa: 私たちは3月8日に国際女性デーのために,オンラインおよび印刷版で記事を公開した両方のプロジェクトを立ち上げました. // How do I say it? 私たちはGoogleニュースイニシアチブの助成金でプロジェクトを立ち上げましたそして,Googleはジャーナリストの訓練のツールについて言及しています. // Genie (gender gap tracker) 2021年6月以降,66,381件以上の記事が処理され,約136,000人が性別によって識別され,包括101件が非バイナリージェンダーである.このツールで働く訓練を受けた編集部には,Community, World, Society, Ideas, Culture, Cars/Mobility, Property, and Wellbeingが含まれます. 彼らはまだ具体的なメトリック目標を持っていませんが,彼らは訓練を受け,ベストエッセイに基づいて最高の結果を達成することにコミットしています.

2024-s-0137.summary: The Path to the Sea is a large interactive project in which journalists reconstructed the Russian defense line in the south of Ukraine. This line secures for Russia the corridor to Crimea. How did the Russians do it, how do they have everything arranged? TEXTY showed it in the data project, where you can see the defense lines from a bird's eye view, move and zoom the map, study the location of enemy trenches. Authors provide schemes of trenches and fortifications, so users while flying under the frontline, can easily imagine the constructions.
2024-s-0137.impact: The interactive project perfectly illustrates the challenge facing Ukrainian soldiers in the southern direction. Ukraine’s defenders were able to penetrate some minefields and the fortifications and to breach the main line of defense in a number of places. It is in front of the first line and between its fortifications that the largest minefields in Europe since the World War I have been laid. The project was published in partnership with Channel24 and Espresso media from TOP-10 in Ukraine. Satelite images were provided exclusively by Planet.
2024-s-0137.authors: Author: Denys Hubashov Design: Nadja Kelm
2024-s-0137.summaryJa: The Path to the Seaは,ジャーナリストがウクライナ南部でロシア防衛線を再構築した大規模なインタラクティブプロジェクトです. この線はロシアにクリミアへの廊下を確保します. ロシアはどのようにそれをしたのですか,どのように彼らはすべてを整理したのですか. Authors provide schemes of trenches and fortifications, so users while flying under the frontline, can easily imagine the constructions. 筆者は,前線下を飛行する際に,建設を容易に想像できるように,
2024-s-0137.impactJa: インタラクティブプロジェクトでは,ウクライナ兵士が南向きに直面する課題を完璧に説明しています.ウクライナの防衛隊は,いくつかの地雷場や砦を突破し,いくつかの場所で主線を突破することができました. プロジェクトはChannel24とEspresso media from TOP-10 in Ukraineとの提携で公開された.

2024-s-0138.summary: Every river carries billions of grains of sand and silt that eventually reach the coasts – but nowadays, almost everywhere on the planet, the sediments get trapped in reservoirs. This has devastating global effects: Electric turbines are threatening to halt, freshwater reserves are shrinking, and coastal towns are being taken over by the ever-advancing oceans. An extensive analysis of 40 years of satellite images shows the profound changes in coastlines and substantial land loss globally due to human infrastructure. This report offers readers an in-depth look at the situation through on-the-ground reporting and an interactive world map to explore the findings.
2024-s-0138.impact: This project represents a pioneering investigative effort, uniquely illuminating a global crisis that had not been covered extensively before. It comprehensively unveils the devastating impact of reservoirs on global ecosystems, especially highlighting the damages of coastal lines and river deltas. The project employs 40 years of satellite imagery analysis and on-the-ground reporting from various regions to reveal how human interference in natural sediment flow has led to widespread environmental and cultural damage. By integrating data, stories, and algorithm-powered detection, it not only educates readers but also confronts responsible entities, showcasing a groundbreaking approach in data journalism.
2024-s-0138.tools: AI/Machine learning, Personalisation, D3.js, QGIS, CSV, R, RStudio, OpenStreetMap, Python
2024-s-0138.authors: Tobias Landwehr, Christoph von Eichhorn, Elisa von Grafenstein, Jonas Jetzig, Markus Hametner, Stefan Kloiber, Isabel Kronenberger, Sören Müller-Hansen, Malte Hornbergs
2024-s-0138.summaryJa: 砂と泥の粒子が何十億ドルも運ばれ最終的に海岸に到達しますしかし現在,地球上のほぼあらゆる場所では,沈没物が貯水池に閉じ込められていますこれは破壊的な世界的な影響を及ぼします電気タービンが停止し,淡水資源が縮小し,沿岸都市は常に進歩する海洋によって取り上げられています 40年衛星画像の広範な分析は,人間のインフラによる海岸線における深い変化と地球規模での土地損失を明らかにしていますこのレポートは,読者に,現場での報告やインタラクティブな世界地図を通じて,発見を深入に観察することを提供します.
2024-s-0138.impactJa: このプロジェクトは,これまで広く報道されていない世界的な危機を独創的に明るみに出した革新的な調査を代表するものです. 貯水池が地球生態系に及ぼす破壊的な影響を,特に沿岸線と川デルタがもたらす被害を強調するプロジェクトです. このプロジェクトは40年間の衛星画像分析と様々な地域からの現場報告を活用し自然沉積物流への人間の干渉が広範な環境・文化被害をもたらしたかを明らかにしますデータ,ストーリー,およびアルゴリズム駆動の検出を統合することで読者を教育するだけでなく,責任ある団体にも対峙し,データジャーナリズムにおける groundbreakingアプローチを展示します

2024-s-0139.summary: The "Silent Money" investigation uncovers the complex financial moves of Belarusian businessman Anatoly Ternavskiy, linked to the Lukashenko. It reveals offshore deals and avoiding sanctions. Ternavskiy thrived in oil dealings, especially thanks to the trade with the state-owned Belarusian Oil Company, making over $2 billion with Medesoil Trading Limited. His Belarusian companies built a school for Lukashenko's mistress and catered to officials. Swiss citizen Stephan Brunner played a role, managing Ternavskiy's assets. The findings expose Ternavskiy's financial strategies and raise concerns about enforcing sanctions. The use of offshore structures prompts a call for better regulations to prevent abuse and evasion.
2024-s-0139.impact: The impact of "Silent Money" investigation has reverberated across multiple platforms, sparking significant reactions and responses. Notably, the human rights organization Respect-Protect-Fulfill seized upon our findings, prompting them to petition both the US State Department and the US Treasury Department to include Ternavskiy on the sanctions list. This marks a critical step toward holding accountable those implicated in the investigation. The platforms of Belarusian Investigative Center played a pivotal role in amplifying the story. Across platforms, the audience engagement has been profound: 335 thousand. Our story was republished in reputable media outlets. Notable publications on OCCRP, Belsat, Radio Svaboda/Radio Free/Radio Liberty, The Insider, Ukrainian Vedomosti, Nasha Niva, Current Time and others have collectively reached thousands of additional viewers and readers. We counted at least 30 republications. The investigative report has become a focal point of discussions on Twitter, Telegram, and other social media channels. The diverse range of republications, including articles, podcasts, and videos, demonstrates the multi-faceted impact of our investigation. This widespread coverage shows the investigation's resonance and its crucial role in highlighting financial malpractices within political circles in Belarus, where the government is continuing the repressions and support of Russia's aggression against Ukraine.
2024-s-0139.summaryJa: "Silent Money"の調査は,ベラルーシのビジネスマンアナトリー・テラヴスキーが,ルカシェンコと関連している複雑な金融動きを明らかにする.それはオフショア取引と制裁を回避することを明らかにする.テラヴスキーが石油取引で繁栄した.特に,国有ベラルーシア石油会社との取引のおかげで,Medesoil Trading Limitedで200億ドル以上稼ぎました.彼のベラルーシア企業は,ルカシェンコの愛女のために学校を建て,官僚に提供した. スイス市民のスティーファン・ブルンナーが,テルノブスキー氏の資産を管理する役割を果たした.この発見はテルノブスキー氏の金融戦略を暴露し,制裁の執行に関する懸念を醸し出している.オフショア構造の利用は,虐待と回避を防ぐためのより良い規制の呼びかけを促している.
2024-s-0139.impactJa: "Silent Money"の調査の影響は複数のプラットフォームで反響を及ぼし人権団体Respect-Protect-Fulfillが我々の調査結果を把握し,米国国務省と財務省の両方にTernavskiyを制裁名簿に載せることを請願するよう促した. これは調査に関与した人々を責任者に導く重要な一歩を標的にしています. プラットフォームを通じて,観客の関与は深遠だった: 335千.Our storyは評判のメディアで再刊された.OCCRP,Belsat,Radio Svaboda/Radio Free/Radio Liberty,The Insider,Ukrainian Vedomosti,Nasha Niva, Current Time等で注目された出版物は,集団的に数千人の追加視聴者および読者を獲得した. 報告書はTwitter,テレグラム,その他のソーシャルメディアの話題の焦点となっています記事やポッドキャスト,ビデオを含む様々な共和文書は私たちの調査の多面的な影響を示していますこの広範囲の報道は,ロシアのウクライナに対する侵略に対する抑圧と支援を継続しているベラルーシの政治圏内の金融不正を明らかにする調査の共鳴と重要な役割を示しています.

2024-s-0140.summary: Investigation uncovs the sophisticated evasion of EU sanctions by Grodno Azot, a sanctioned Belarusian company. Despite being on the EU sanctions list, Grodno Azot allegedly misrepresented urea fertilizers as originating from Uzbekistan through intricate schemes involving straw companies. The investigation raised concerns about the efficacy of sanctions enforcement and called for stricter measures to curb circumvention.
2024-s-0140.impact: The coverage of the Grodno Azot investigation on the Belarusian Investigation Center's platforms reached 249,075 views, with an additional 422,485 views from reprints on third-party sites. The investigation's impact was evident in Lithuanian media reports on tightened cargo inspections and calls for stricter sanctions on Belarus. This widespread coverage demonstrates the investigation's societal resonance and its contribution to shedding light on deceptive practices affecting international trade.
2024-s-0140.summaryJa: 捜査は,EUの制裁リストに含まれるにもかかわらず,ストロウ企業を含む複雑な計画を通じて,ウエリア肥料をウエゼキスタンから生じたと誤った表現した.調査は,制裁執行の有効性について懸念を喚起し,回避を抑制するより厳しい措置を要求した.
2024-s-0140.impactJa: ベルルーシアインベーラシアインベーラシアセンターのプラットフォームでグロドノアゾト調査の報道は249,075ビューに達し,第三者サイトで再印刷された追加で422,485ビューに達した.調査の影響は,ベラルーシに対する加密な貨物検査に関するリトアニアメディアの報告や厳しい制裁を求める中で明らかになった. この広範囲の報道は捜査の社会的な共鳴と国際貿易に影響を与える欺瞞的な慣行を明らかにする貢献を示しています

2024-s-0141.summary: Our cover story for The Economist Newspaper, “Why did 250,000 Britons die sooner than expected?” broke new ground in examining the decline in life expectancy in Britain. I, James Fransham, worked with Georgia Banjo, our health-care correspondent, to fuse original quantitative analysis with shoe-leather reporting. We showed that the stalling of life expectancy had been more pronounced in Britain than almost any other country, and that this had been driven almost entirely by plummeting life expectancy among the poor. The digital version of the article presented our original data with compelling interactive content from our graphics team.
2024-s-0141.impact: The piece certainly started a debate. On the morning of publication, Amol Rajan, the BBC Radio 4 presenter, singled out the article for praise on the Today Programme. The leader article was re-posted on X / Twitter 2m times (see: https://x.com/TheEconomist/status/1646406769910898692?s=20); posted and re-posted by plenty of other journalists (ie, Robert Peston: https://x.com/Peston/status/1634309447202795520); along with numerous health experts, too.

2024-s-0142.summary: Russia and Hungary publicly demonstrate mutual support. Hungarian officials regularly stand up for Russia, criticizing sanctions and international agreements against the Kremlin. Russia relays this, showing that it has a loyal ally and that there is a major ideological split in the EU. We analyzed over 15,000 publications in Hungarian and Russian state-affiliated media to find which narratives propaganda in both countries construct in attempts to justify the full-scale invasion of Ukraine. We also gathered public polling data, voting results on EU sanctions and UN resolutions – to match the media narratives with public perception and actual foreign policy.
2024-s-0142.impact: The project was selected for an Honorary Mention in Philip Meyer Journalism Award from IRE. It was also featured in GIJN's best data journalism roundup in May 2023. Part of the team was invited to paticipate in ZEG International Storytelling Festival to present our work. This article is also shown to university journalism and data students.
2024-s-0142.tools: Scraping, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Python, Datawrapper, AI to HTML, GDELT Global Graph database, BERTopic library, Tableau Public
2024-s-0142.authors: Maiia Guseva, Aziza Raimberdieva, Dora Nemeth, Balint Szalai, Olga Serebryanaya, Kristina Zakurdaeva, Liubov Moiseenko, Karina Merkuryeva
2024-s-0142.summaryJa: ロシアとハンガリーは公に相互支持を示している.ハンガリー当局は定期的にロシアを擁護し,クレムリンに対する制裁と国際協定を批判している.ロシアはこれを伝え,忠実な同盟国があることを示すこと,そしてEUで大きな思想的分裂があることを示す. ウクライナへの全面的な侵略を正当化しようとするため,両国の宣伝の物語が作られていることを調べるためにハンガリーとロシアの政府関連メディアの15,000以上の出版物を分析しました. また,公衆の投票データ,EU制裁や国連決議に関する投票結果も集めて,メディアの物語が,公衆の認識と実際の外交政策と一致するようにしました.
2024-s-0142.impactJa: このプロジェクトは,IREからフィリップ・メイヤージャーナリズム賞の名誉言及に選ばれました. また,2023年5月に GIJNのベストデータジャーナリズムラウンドアップにも登場しました. チームの一部は,ZEG国際物語フェスティバルで私たちの仕事を紹介するために参加するよう招待されました. この記事は,大学ジャーナリズムとデータ学生にも展示されています.

2024-s-0143.summary: According to the data over the past five years, 2022 was a record year for the number of laws passed in Russia. Current Time (part of RFERL) examined thousands of bills. We found that, since January 2022, every bill introduced in the State Duma, the lower chamber of Parliament, had been passed -- almost unanimously. Also, 10 laws adopted the fastest were about the annexation of Ukrainian territories occupied by Russia, in some cases it took less than a single day from submission of bills to adoption as official laws. Additionally, legislation becomes more and more repressive.
2024-s-0143.impact: The project was welcomed well in a data-community. It was featured in GIJN's best data journalism in March 2023. The project team was also invited to paticipate in ZEG International Storytelling Festival to present our work. Additionally, it is presented in a few universities as an example for journalism and data students.
2024-s-0143.tools: Scraping, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Python, Datawrapper, AI to HTML script

2024-s-0144.summary: We knew Philadelphia’s crowded 2023 mayoral primary would be defined by fissures among the city's Democrats, so we decided to quantify and map them. To define these "voting blocs," we clustered all the city's 1703 precincts into one of six groups, according to past voting history in Democratic primaries. We found that like much else in Philadelphia, preferences even among Democrats are strikingly divided by class and ethnicity. We also discovered an electoral divide within similar-seeming Black neighborhoods. Three stories resulted: - An explainer - A description of each cluster's voting power - A post-mortem showing how the clusters mapped to electoral results
2024-s-0144.impact: A key part of good political journalism is explaining how elections work and how the electorate moves in predictable or unpredictable ways. This series set the stage for analysis on key themes that we continue to explore, namely which constituencies wield political power and how politicians pitch themselves to different audiences in America's sixth-largest city. In explanatory terms, the primary results vindicated the soundness of the clusters. Of the six clusters we identified, three were majority-white, two majority-Black, and one plurality-Hispanic. We found we could neatly describe the winning candidate's coalition by showing how she united the three majority-minority clusters. Meanwhile, each of the majority-white clusters voted for different candidates, splitting along sometimes-subtle but still quantifiable socioeconomic lines. It was clear the story resonated. It ranked among the top 5% of the Inquirer's stories in local readership for 2023, and among the top 1% for driving new subscriptions. A class of Philadelphia politicos was particularly appreciative. More than one campaign operative told us that our schema was insightful, quantified some hunches they had long had about the geographic dimensions of voter behavior, and served as an appropriate template for understanding the factionalism within Democratic politics in the city.
2024-s-0144.tools: AI/Machine learning, Scraping, D3.js, QGIS, Google Sheets, CSV, Python
2024-s-0144.authors: Aseem Shukla (data reporter) Julia Terruso (political reporter) Jonathan Lai (data editor) Ariella Cohen (assistant managing editor, news)
2024-s-0144.summaryJa: フィリデフィアの2023年の市長選挙は,市内民主党の間で裂け目によって定義されるだろうと考えたので,それを定量化して地図化することにしました.これらの"投票区"を定義するために,私たちは市内の1703の区を6つのグループに分類しました.民主党の初選挙の投票の歴史によると.我々はフィラデルフィアの他の多くの地域と同様に,民主党の間でさえも,階級と民族によって顕著に分割されていることがわかりました. 選挙区の格差も発見しました似たような黒人地域では3つの物語が出来ました - 説明者 - 各集団の投票権の説明 - 集団が選挙結果に映し出された方法を示すポストモートム
2024-s-0144.impactJa: 選挙の仕組みと選挙人が予測可能か予測不可能かでどのように動き出るかについての説明は,良い政治ジャーナリズムの一つの重要な部分である.このシリーズは,我々が引き続き探求する,すなわちどの選挙区が政治力を行使する,そして政治家たちがアメリカの6番目に大きな都市で異なる観客にどのように自分を投じるかに関する重要なテーマの分析のための舞台を設定した.説明的な観点から,最初の結果は,クラスターの健全性を正当化した. 選出した6つの集団のうち3つは白人多数派,2つは黒人多数派,1つはヒスパニック系多数派でした. 選出候補者の連合を正確に記述できるのは,3つの多数派少数派集団をどのように統合したか示すことででした. 一方,多数派白人集団はそれぞれ異なる候補者を投票し,時には微妙なものの,まだ定量化可能な社会経済線に沿って分裂しました. フィリデビアの政治家は特に感謝した.選挙運動の1人以上の担当者は,我々の計画は洞察力のあること,選挙人の行動の地理的次元について長い間抱いていた予感を定量化し,市内の民主党政治における派閥主義を理解するための適切なテンプレートとして機能した.

2024-s-0145.summary: Desmatamento na floresta amazônica é uma notícia frequente no noticiário brasileiro: a quantidade de hectares devastados, assim como a variação percentual em relação ao ano anterior, são informações amplamente divulgadas na imprensa. Ainda assim, é difícil compreender a dimensão da crise. Esse projeto busca trazer os dados de desmatamento para o cotidiano do leitor. A ferramenta permite a comparação com os arredores de sua residência ou outra localização de preferência.
2024-s-0145.impact: A reportagem auxilia o leitor a mensurar o impacto do desmatamento na Amazônia e traz análises detalhadas inéditas, realizadas a partir de dados públicos. O leitor consegue, agora, ter uma escala comparativa para compreender o real tamanho da devastação, além de entender com mais clareza os fatores políticos e econômicos por trás dessa destruição.
2024-s-0145.tools: Personalisation, QGIS, Json, Adobe Creative Suite, Google Sheets, CSV, R, RStudio, OpenStreetMap, Python, Node.js, JavaScript (Astro Build, React, MapLibre, ProtonMaps, TurfJS), Figma, Geolocalização

2024-s-0145.summaryJa: アマゾン森林の伐採はブラジル新聞に頻繁に報じられるニュースです. 荒廃したヘクタールの数量と前年と比較した割合の変化は,マスコミで広範囲に広められている情報です. それでも危機の規模を理解することは難しい. このプロジェクトは,読者の日常生活に伐採データを届けようとしています. ツールでは,あなたの居住地の周辺や他の好みの場所と比較することができます.
2024-s-0145.impactJa: このレポートは読者にアマゾンにおける森林破壊の影響を測定するのに役立つもので,公的なデータから実施された未曾有の詳細な分析を提示しています.読者は,破壊の本当の規模を理解し,破壊の背後にある政治的・経済的要因をより明確に理解するために,比較スケールを得ることができます.

2024-s-0146.summary: Generative AI exists because of the transformer. But how does it actually work? In a stepped-through visual explainer we answered this question, using visual metaphors, interactive graphics and interviews with experts to unpick a topic that could transform our lives in ways not seen since the mass adoption of the internet. Creating a story that was informative for the layperson and scientifically sound was a major challenge, and the project involved discussions with numerous researchers — including the team behind _Attention Is All You Need_, the paper that kick-started the generative AI era.
2024-s-0146.impact: The impact has been widespread and ongoing. It was one of the best read stories on the entirety of FT.com in 2023 and subscribers loved it, with the comments from readers almost unanimously positive. One of the most liked comments said “Amazing job guys. I do this for a living and love how you’ve conveyed LLMs so concisely and effectively”. Beyond the FT, almost 20 per cent of our page views came from social media. This is almost seven times higher than the social visits to a typical FT story. This reflects the way the story has been shared organically — and struck a chord with those attempting to understand one of the most significant technological breakthroughs of our time. The CEO of Shopify, Tobi Lutke, shared a link to his 300,000+ followers saying “This is incredible work by the @FT. Visual storytelling is what the open web is unbeatable at”. Jakob Uszkoreit, one of the authors of the original transformers paper, described the project as “by far the best explanation for non-practitioners I've seen”.
2024-s-0146.authors: Madhumita Murgia, Dan Clark, Sam Learner, Irene de la Torre Arenas, Sam Joiner, Eade Hemingway and Oliver Hawkins.
2024-s-0146.summaryJa: 創意AIはトランスフォーマーのおかげで存在しますでも実際どのように機能するのでしょうか? 視覚的な説明書でこの質問に答えました視覚的比喩やインタラクティブなグラフィックや専門家とのインタビューを使ってインターネットが普及して以来目に付かなかったような形で私たちの生活を変えてくれるテーマを選択しました知識人にとって情報提供的で科学的に健全なストーリーを作成することは大きな課題でありプロジェクトには多くの研究者と議論が含まれました開発のAI時代をスタートさせた論文である _Attention Is All You Need_ のチームを含む
2024-s-0146.impactJa: 影響は広範囲で継続しています.この記事は2023年に FT.com全体で最もよく読まれた記事の一つであり,読者のコメントはほぼ一致で肯定的な内容でした.最も気に入ったコメントの一つは"すごい仕事の人たち.私はこれを生計のためにやります.そしてあなたが LLMを簡潔で効果的に伝達した方法を愛しています. FTを超えて,私たちのページビューの約20%はソーシャルメディアから来ました. これは典型的なFTのストーリーへのソーシャル訪問の約7倍です. これは,ストーリーが有機的に共有された方法を反映し,私たちの時代の最も重要な技術革新の一つを理解しようと試みている人々と合図を打った.ShopifyのCEOトビ・ルトケは,彼の300,000人以上のフォロワーへのリンクを共有し, @FTによる信じられないような仕事です.視覚的なストーリーテリングはオープンウェブが勝てないものです. プロジェクトを <unk>これまで見た非実践者にとって最も優れた説明だと説明した.

2024-s-0147.summary: A cross-border team of eight journalists confirmed the existence of 1,015 unmarked graves of migrants buried in 65 cemeteries over the past decade across Spain, Italy, Greece, Malta, Poland, Lithuania, France, and Croatia. Each unmarked grave represents a person who lost their life en route to Europe, and a fate that will remain forever unknown to their loved ones. This nine-months-long investigation shows, in immense detail, how Europe’s migration policies have failed more than a thousand people who have died in transit and the families who survive them.
2024-s-0147.impact: The findings of the Border Graves Investigation team were published in text, video, radio, and podcast form in Spain, Italy, Greece, Poland, Lithuania, Germany, and Croatia in many languages (English, Spanish, Italian, Greek, Lithuanian, German, Croatian/Bosnian/Serbian). In Lithuania, it sparked conversation among the Lithuanian parliament, referred to as “that unfortunate article about the border.” The publication in the Guardian reached 500,000 views in the first week, and was cited in a later op-ed by the Guardian about the need to uphold migrant rights as the UK debates its domestic policies regarding an increase of migrants arriving via the English channel. Our team has subsequently been invited to share our findings on radio interviews in Canada, Italy, and Croatia. Our data finding of 1000 unmarked graves was re-reported by Reuters, after which many regional news also continued to report on the finding, including countries we hadn’t originally published in such as Bulgaria, and pushed the conversation into new countries and contexts in the region. Starting from a complete absence of regional data on unmarked graves of migrants in the EU, we have established an iron-clad figure showing the indisputable violation of the rights of migrants and their families.
2024-s-0147.tools: 360, Drone, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, OpenStreetMap
2024-s-0147.authors: The project was initiated by eight journalists, the majority of whom are independent freelancers: Tina Xu (coordinator, Germany), Danai Maragoudaki (Solomon, Greece), Daphne Tolis (Greece), Gabriele Cruciata (Italy), Leah Pattem (Spain), Eoghan Gilmartin (Spain), Barbara Matejčić (Croatia, Serbia, Bosnia), and Gabriela Ramirez (Unbias the News, Poland, Lithuania). We came together for the project through funding by IJ4EU and JournalismFund. In the final four months of the project, we teamed up with the investigation team at Süddeutsche Zeitung, working with Kristiana Ludwig and Ben Heubl, and The Guardian, working with deputy investigations editor Rachel Oldroyd, and journalists Felicity Lawrence, Ashifa Kassam, Lorenzo Tondo, Manisha Ganguly, and Pamela Duncan.

2024-s-0147.impactJa: Border Graves Investigation teamの発見は,多くの言語 (英語,スペイン,イタリア,ギリシャ,リトアニア,ドイツ,ドイツ,ドイツ,ポーランド) でテキスト,ビデオ,ラジオ,そしてポッドキャスト形式で公開されました. リリートニアでは,リトアニア議会の間で会話が起こりました. <unk>that unfortunate article about the border.<unk> The publication in the Guardianは最初の週間に5万件の視聴率に達し,英国が英語チャンネルを通じて移民の到着を増加させる国内政策を議論しているため,移民の権利を擁護する必要性について後期のガーディアンによる意見で引用されました. その後,私たちのチームはカナダ,イタリア,クロアチアでのラジオインタビューに関する我々の発見を共有するよう招待されました. 1000件の未記号墓のデータ発見はロイターによって再報告されました. その後,多くの地域ニュースも発見について報告し続けました. ブルガリアなどの最初に公表しなかった国を含む. そして,この会話を新しい国や地域の文脈に押し込みました. 地域データがないことから,EUにおける移民の遺跡の無印に記載された遺跡に関する地域データがないことから,我々は移民とその家族に対する権利の無論な侵害を示す鉄の形状を確立しました.

2024-s-0148.summary: The suicide rate for African American males age 10-24 in Virginia has tripled over the past 10 years – with a sharp increase since the Covid-19 pandemic. They are now more likely than other demographic groups in Virginia and nationwide to die by suicide. Our story was the first to reveal this trend. The article put a human face to the issue, focusing on a Black teenager who had tried to kill himself with a gun. Experts say adolescent males turn to self-harm because society often discourages them from expressing their emotions.
2024-s-0148.impact: We don't know of any additional reporting that came from our work, but some of our sources did see impact from this story: * The family at the center of the story [received additional donations](https://www.gofundme.com/f/z7hux5-the-road-to-recovery) to support their child's recovery from an attempted suicide. * A community organizer was able to add additional community mental health events in response to increased interest.
2024-s-0148.summaryJa: ヴァージニア州では10〜24歳のアフリカ系アメリカ人男性による自殺率は過去10年間で3倍になった. コヴィッド-19の流行以来急激に増加している.現在,ヴァージニア州および全国各地で他の人口集団よりも自殺率が高い.この傾向を明らかにしたのは私たちの物語です.記事では,銃で自殺しようとした黒人ティーンエイジャーに焦点を当て,人間の顔を問題にしました. 専門家は青少年の男子は自分を傷つけることに慣れているのはなぜですか.社会はしばしば自分の感情を表現することを妨げています.
2024-s-0148.impactJa: 物語の中心にある家族 (さらに寄付を受けた) は,子どもの自殺未遂から回復を支援するために (https://www.gofundme.com/f/z7hux5-the-road-to-recovery) 支援をしていました. * コミュニティの組織者は,関心が高まったため,コミュニティの精神衛生上のイベントを追加することができました.

2024-s-0149.summary: ‘El Var para los Candidatos a la Gobernación del Cesar’, fue una apuesta periodística del medio de comunicación El Periódico ubicado en Valledupar - Colombia, buscando contribuir a la democracia desde las regiones; revelamos los detalles ocultos de cada aspirantes al primer cargo del departamento del Cesar (2024-2027) entre las revelaciones periodísticas se encuentran las alianzas políticas, empresariales, relaciones de familiares con contratitas del estado, procesos judiciales por actos de corrupción y la relación con grupos al margen de la ley. Combinamos las nuevas narrativas digitales e innovación para generar un mayor alcance, apuntuándole a las nuevas generaciones.
2024-s-0149.impact: En Colombia el 29 de octubre de 2023 se llevaron a cabo las elecciones regionales del país, (donde se elige; gobernadores, alcaldes, diputados, concejales y ediles). El departamento del Cesar con 53 años de historia, está ubicado en la costa norte colombiana. Con EL VAR PARA LOS CANDIDATOS A LA GOBERNACIÓN DEL CESAR, se logró 1. Garantizar el acceso a la información y lograr que la ciudadanía estuviera informada y escogiera de manera consciente quien regiría los destinos del departamento en los próximos cuatro años. 2. Promover el control social y fomentar la trasparencia en los procesos democráticos desde las regiones del país. Revelar la información nunca antes contada de cada uno de los candidatos. 3. Impactar en las nuevas generaciones a través de la combinación del periodismo de investigación y las nuevas narrativas digitales 4. Este proyecto obtuvo el premio regional de periodismo en la categoría Narrativas Digitales otorgado por el Círculo de Periodistas de Valledupar - CPV.

2024-s-0150.summary: This groundbreaking analysis revealed, for the first time, how colonial rule shifts historical responsibility for climate change. It sheds new light on the complex but vital question of who is responsible for global warming, which lies at the heart of climate justice. For example, taking colonial rule into account, the UK’s share of historical emissions nearly doubles and that of the Netherlands nearly triples. The analysis is based on two large datasets, combined in a novel way, and brought to life through unique dataviz and compelling storytelling. It received global media coverage and is already being used for academic research.
2024-s-0150.impact: Our analysis was covered internationally in several national exclusives – on the print frontpage of [NRC](https://www.nrc.nl/nieuws/2023/11/26/co2-uitstoot-in-voormalige-kolonien-maakt-van-nederland-een-van-de-grootste-mondiale-klimaatvervuilers-a4182337) in the Netherlands and in print editions of the [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2023/nov/26/british-empire-past-emissions-double-uk-climate-responsibility-data-shows) in the UK and the [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/accounting-for-colonial-rule-reduces-india-s-climate-role-by-15-101701059104857.html) in India. Follow-up coverage came from Sri Lanka’s [Sunday Times](https://www.sundaytimes.lk/231210/plus/cop28-and-the-garden-city-irony-541242.html), India’s [GroundReport](https://groundreport.in/5-countries-that-have-emitted-most-carbon-dioxide-in-the-world/#google_vignette), Spanish daily [La Vanguardia](https://www.lavanguardia.com/natural/20231206/9425015/mejor-grafico-historia-origen-paises-emisiones-cambiando-clima.html), French publication [Reporterre](https://reporterre.net/En-considerant-nos-anciennes-colonies-la-France-voit-ses-emissions-de-CO2-augmenter-de-50), Belgium’s [De Staandard](https://www.standaard.be/cnt/dmf20231127_95715339), Brazilian site Globo’s [Planeta](https://umsoplaneta.globo.com/clima/noticia/2023/11/26/emissoes-da-epoca-do-imperio-britanico-dobram-responsabilidade-do-reino-unido-pela-crise-climatica-aponta-novo-estudo.ghtml), the [Heated](https://heated.world/) climate newsletter, [Sky News](https://news.sky.com/story/cop28-rishi-sunak-boasts-about-the-uks-climate-credentials-but-our-colonial-past-has-a-lot-to-answer-for-13020622), [BusinessGreen](https://www.businessgreen.com/news/4150639/real-scandal-uae-presidency-accused-cop-meetings-lobby-fossil-fuel-deals) and a [Guardian editorial](https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2023/dec/03/the-guardian-view-on-a-non-proliferation-treaty-fossil-fuels-are-weapons-of-mass-destruction). Nature’s [Anthropocene newsletter](https://www.nature.com/briefing/anthropocene) featured our analysis as its infographic of the week. Our analysis triggered strong pushback from climate-sceptic columnists at right-leaning UK publications including Richard Littlejohn in the [Daily Mail](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/debate/article-12797373/RICHARD-LITTLEJOHN-Working-home-Money-gas-bills-FREE.html), Ross Clark in the [Spectator](https://www.spectator.co.uk/article/climate-reparations-are-an-awful-idea/) and Michael Deacon in the [Daily Telegraph](https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2023/11/28/queen-camilla-wokery-gender-veganism-omid-scobie-endgame/). Author Simon Evans was interviewed about the analysis on [BBC World Service](https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/w3ct4sd9), [Himal Southasian](https://www.himalmag.com/cop28-dubai-climate-change-net-zero-simon-evans/) and Canadian Indigenous current affairs podcast [Media Indigena](https://pod.link/1092220986). The analysis was selected among the “best environmental journalism of 2023” by [Greenpeace’s Unearthed](https://unearthed.greenpeace.org/2023/12/26/best-of-climate-journalism-2023/), which said it “ma[de] the idea of climate justice and the question of who bears responsibility for the current crisis more tangible”. [Covering Climate Now]https://www.einnews.com/pr_news/675136109/what-cop28-means-for-climate-coverage) listed it among “our favourite work on climate change” in 2023. It has also been shared widely on social media, including by Greta Thunberg.
