2024-s-0151.summary: O Sudeste do Brasil viveu ondas de calor extremas em 2023, motivadas pela crise climática e pelo El Niño. Na tentativa de embasar o debate público sobre urbanismo e clima, em vigor na Casa Legislativa de São Paulo, a reportagem investigou a alteração térmica entre bairros ricos e pobres, concluindo que regiões mais vulneráveis têm ilhas de calor com temperaturas de solo até 4°C mais altas. A metodologia envolveu extenso trabalho de tratamento de imagens de satélite e cruzamento de bases de dados de renda e de temperatura.
2024-s-0151.impact: O projeto foi destaque no jornal Folha de S.Paulo e no site do UOL, um dos líderes de audiência no Brasil. A conclusão baseada em dados serve hoje de embasamento para o debate político acerca das necessidades de adaptação da cidade a temperaturas extremas.
2024-s-0151.tools: QGIS, Adobe Creative Suite, Google Sheets, R, RStudio
2024-s-0151.authors: Daniel Mariani, Nicholas Pretto, Clayton Castelani
2024-s-0151.summaryJa: ブラジル南東部では2023年に気候変動危機とエルニノによって引き起こされた極端な熱波が起こりましたサンパウロ州議会で実施されている都市計画と気候に関する公共議論を基盤にするために,報告書は裕福な街区と貧しい街区間の熱変化を調査し,最も脆弱な地域が4°C以上高温の温島を持つ熱島であると結論付けました方法論は,衛星画像処理と温度と収入データベースの交差を広範囲にわたる作業を伴う.
2024-s-0151.impactJa: このプロジェクトは,S.Pauloの紙 Folha (サンパウロの紙) とブラジルにおける聴衆のリーダーであるUOLのウェブサイトで紹介されました. データに基づく結論は,今,極端な温度に都市の適応の必要性に関する政治的議論の基盤として機能しています.

2024-s-0152.summary: The Post partnered with the climate nonprofit CarbonPlan to build [one of the most comprehensive models of extreme heat](https://carbonplan.org/research/extreme-heat-explainer?itid=lk_inline_enhanced-template) now and in the future. The data guided the reporting for “The Human Limit”, a Washington Post series exploring who is most at risk as a new wave of climate-fueled disease threatens humanity. It was central to “[Where dangerous heat is surging](https://www.washingtonpost.com/climate-environment/interactive/2023/extreme-heat-wet-bulb-globe-temperature/),” an article that showcases the analysis’ biggest findings and explains how rising temperatures will transform the way we work and live in the coming decades. The analysis also underpinned feature pieces reported from [Pakistan](https://www.washingtonpost.com/climate-environment/interactive/2023/pakistan-extreme-heat-health-impacts-death/), [India](https://www.washingtonpost.com/climate-environment/interactive/2023/india-deadly-extreme-heat-poverty/), [Yemen](https://www.washingtonpost.com/climate-environment/interactive/2023/yemen-extreme-heat-hunger-malnourishment/) and [Phoenix, Arizona](https://www.washingtonpost.com/climate-environment/interactive/2023/schizophrenia-extreme-heat-health-risk/).
2024-s-0152.impact: Our project is distinctive because we built and made accessible some of the world’s best modeling of where people in cities will face the most physiological heat risk, providing an essential tool to policymakers and others who wish to confront this problem or protect themselves. CarbonPlan [published](https://github.com/carbonplan/extreme-heat) the underlying data and the model code on their website, enabling the wider scientific community and policymakers to build on the findings. Following the publication of the stories, CarbonPlan met with the World Bank’s Global Facility for Disaster Reduction and Recovery, who are planning to use the data to support their work on climate resilient urban development.
2024-s-0152.tools: 3D modeling, AI/Machine learning, Sensor, Personalisation, Drone, D3.js, Three.js, QGIS, Node.js
2024-s-0152.authors: Authors of data analysis: Niko Kommenda, Oriana Chegwidden, Jeremy Freeman Story authors: Niko Kommenda, Shannon Osaka, Simon Ducroquet and Veronica Penney
2024-s-0152.summaryJa: ポストは気候変動非営利団体CarbonPlanと提携して,現在と将来 (https://carbonplan.org/research/extreme-heat-explainer?itid=lk_inline_enhanced-template) の上で,最も包括的な極端な熱モデルの一つを構築した.このデータは,気候変動による新たな病気が人類を脅かすため,最も危険にさらされている者を調査するワシントンポストシリーズである"The Human Limit"のレポートを導き出した. 重要なテーマは" [危険な暑さが上昇している場所] (https://www.washingtonpost.com/climate-environment/interactive/2023/extreme-heat-wet-bulb-glob-temperature/), 分析の最大の発見を紹介する記事"であり, 温度上昇が今後数十年に私たちの働き方や生活方法をどのように変容するかを説明する記事でした. 分析はまた, [パキスタン]https://www.washingtonpost.com/climate-environment/interactive/2023/pakistan-extreme-heat-health-impacts-death/), [インド]https://www.washingtonpost.com/climate-environment/interactive/2023/India/India-deadly-extreme-heat-poverty/), [イエメン]https://www.washingtonpost.com/climate-environment/interactive/2023/yemen-extreme-heat-hunger-malnutrition/) と [Phoenix, Arizona]https://www.washingtonpost.com/climate-environment/ ウイルス/インタラクティブ/2023/統合失調症-極端な熱-健康リスク/).
2024-s-0152.impactJa: 私たちのプロジェクトは都市に住む人々が最も生理的な熱リスクに直面する世界最高のモデルをいくつか構築し,利用できるようにし,政策立案者やこの問題に対処したり,自分を守りたい人たちに不可欠なツールを提供しているため,独特です. CarbonPlan [published]https://github.com/carbonplan/extreme-heat) は,そのウェブサイトの基礎データとモデルコードを掲載し,より広範な科学コミュニティと政策立案者たちにその発見を基盤に構築できるようにしました.この記事の発表後,CarbonPlanは,気候変動耐性都市開発に関する研究を支援するためにデータを活用する予定である世界銀行の災害削減と復興のためのグローバル施設と会談した.

2024-s-0153.summary: Cuando los medios occidentales no podían acceder a Gaza, en RTVE conseguimos tener ojos dentro de la Franja gracias a Jebreel, un periodista gazatí al que seguimos durante un mes. Jebreel documentó su vida en vídeo y complementamos su mirada con datos y gráficos para contar la historia de la guerra desde dentro.
2024-s-0153.impact: En la web de RTVE, el reportaje de Jebreel consiguió mantener a los usuarios en la página una media de casi dos minutos. Además, la historia tuvo repercusión en televisión y en radio, donde la periodista autora de la información, Ebbaba Hameida, pudo contar con todo detalle cómo había mantenido el contacto con el periodista gazatí y cómo seguía manteniéndolo aún después. El reportaje ha servido para poner cara e imágenes a una guerra que continúa.
2024-s-0153.tools: QGIS, Json, Adobe Creative Suite, CSV, OpenStreetMap
2024-s-0153.authors: Los autores del proyecto son Ebbaba Hameida, Jaime Gutiérrez, Estefanía de Antonio. En el proyecto también han participado otras personas del equipo de DatosRTVE e InfografíaRTVE.
2024-s-0153.summaryJa: 欧米メディアがガザにアクセスできなくなったとき RTVEではガザのジャーナリストのジェブリエルに注目し一ヶ月間追跡しましたジェブリエルは彼の生活をビデオで記録し内部から戦争の歴史を伝えるためにデータやグラフで彼の目線を補完しました
2024-s-0153.impactJa: 報道はテレビやラジオで影響を受け,報道の原作者ジャーナリストエババ・ハメイダが,ガザティジャーナリストとの連絡をどのように維持し,その後もどのように維持していたかを詳細に伝えることができました.

2024-s-0154.summary: Para ingressar em várias universidades públicas brasileiras, existem processos seletivos que reúnem as matérias do ensino médio. Para as provas de Literatura, é comum que cada universidade exija uma lista independente de obras literárias que serão abordadas. A reportagem catalogou todas as obras literárias exigidas desde os anos 1980 em cinco dos mais importantes vestibulares do país, produzindo recortes de gênero e raça dos autores e a média de idade das leituras exigidas em cada ano.
2024-s-0154.impact: A Universidade de São Paulo, maior universidade pública do Brasil e reconhecida como a melhor do país em diversos rankings, foi identificada pela reportagem como tendo o menor percentual de mulheres escritoras em suas listas de obras literárias. Na semana seguinte à publicação da matéria, a organização do vestibular da universidade divulgou as listas de leituras para os três anos seguintes, sendo todas as obras escritas por mulheres.
2024-s-0154.tools: Adobe Creative Suite, Google Sheets, R, RStudio
2024-s-0154.summaryJa: ブラジルでは,公立大学に入学するには,中学科を集める選択プロセスがあります.文学試験のために,各大学が,扱われる文学作品の独立したリストを要求することが一般的です. 報道は1980年代以降のすべての文学作品を全国5つの主要なホールでリストアップし,各年の読み取りの性別や人種を切り算し,平均年齢を記録しました
2024-s-0154.impactJa: ブラジル最大の公立大学で,数々のランキングで国内最高の大学として認められたサンパウロ大学は,報道によって文学作品のリストに女性作家が最も少ない割合を有していると特定された.この論文が発表された翌週,大学院の組織は,女性によって書かれたすべての作品を次の3年間の読書リストを公表した.

2024-s-0155.summary: In order to make sense of current and future fire regimes we must first understand what is fanning the flames of modern mega fires. Beyond its trigger, three critical variables fuel a mega fire: forest continuity, shrub density and weather conditions. These catalysts mean the difference between a fire burning out and one capable of generating enough momentum to surge across the line of control and into unknown territory. **_Fuelling a Mega Fire_** is intended to help build a new understanding of mega fires and the structural causes accommodating them.
2024-s-0155.impact: Fuelling a Mega Fire was published in both Spanish and English and has so far received 1532 views on the Sonda Internacional website. The feedback we have received from readers as well as scientists and firefighters across the Iberian Peninsula is that the project stands out as a contribution to public service journalism fulfilling a necessary function to reeducate readers on the new realities of the fire prone landscapes of Spain and Portugal. Beyond the current metrics we believe the story will continue to act as a resource into the future as the challenge of extreme wildfires in the Iberian Peninsula continues to worsen without significant and widespread changes in land management. The story will remain freely accessible online through the Sonda Internacional website.
2024-s-0155.authors: Authors: Lily Mayers, Mikel Konate, Paulo Nunes dos Santos. Additional videos and photos: Santi Palacios, Pablo Tosco. Design and illustration: Jorge Mileto, Text editing: Maribel Izcue, Data analysis and visualization: Javi Aparicio
2024-s-0155.summaryJa: 現在や将来の火災の仕組みを理解するには,まずは現代のメガ火災の火災を燃やしている理由を理解する必要があります. その引き起こす要素の他に,三つの重要な変数がメガ火災を燃やします. 森林継続性,灌木密度,気象条件. これらの催化剤は,火災が燃え尽きる火災と,制御線を越えて未知の領域に突入する十分な勢力を生み出すことができる火災の違いを意味します. **_Fuelling a Mega Fire_**は,メガ火災とその原因の構造を新認識する手助けをします.
2024-s-0155.impactJa: ファンダ・インターナショナルウェブサイトで1532件の視聴率を記録した.Iberia半島中の読者や科学者,消防士からのフィードバックは,このプロジェクトは,スペインとポルトガルの火災傾向の新現実について読者を再教育するための必要な機能を満たす公共サービスジャーナリズムへの貢献として見出されている. 現在の数値を超えて,この物語は,今後も,Iberia半島における極端な森林火災の課題が,土地管理における重大な変化なしに悪化し続けると信じています. この物語は,Sonda Internationalのウェブサイトを通じて,オンラインで自由にアクセス可能であり続けます.

2024-s-0156.summary: CNN found that Israel dropped hundreds of 2,000-pound bombs on Gaza in the first month of the offensive alone. These bombs are inherently indiscriminate because of their very large lethal fragmentation zone – also known as a kill zone or blast radius – that is roughly the size of 58 soccer fields. The US only used this bomb once in its years-long war against ISIS.
2024-s-0156.impact: Our findings, aided by AI-analysis of satellite imagery, helped to explain a major contributing factor the scale of damage and staggering death toll in Gaza over the course of this war. Our report was picked up as the top story on the pre-eminent DC-based defense digest Just Security and the lawyers representing South Africa at the ICJ this month drew on our findings in their case against the Israeli offensive.
2024-s-0156.authors: Tamara Qiblawi, Allegra Goodwin, Gianluca Mezzofiore, Nima Elbagir, Renée Rigdon, Alex Newman, Ian Berry, Barbara Arvanitidis, Mark Baron and Alex Platt
2024-s-0156.summaryJa: CNNはイスラエルが攻撃の最初の1ヶ月でガザに2,000ポンドの爆弾を投下したことが判明した.これらの爆弾は,非常に大きな致命的な断片地帯であるため,本質的に無差別である. 爆撃半径はおよそ58のサッカー場ほどの大きさである. 米国はISISに対する長年にわたる戦争でこの爆弾を一度のみ使用した.
2024-s-0156.impactJa: この戦争中にガザで起きた被害や死者数は重要な要因の一つに貢献しました私たちの報告は DCの著名な防衛雑誌Just Securityのトップ記事として取り上げられこの月,国際司法裁判所で南アフリカを代表する弁護士はイスラエル攻撃に対する我々の調査結果に基づいたものです

2024-s-0158.summary: A crise económica e o aumento das taxas de juro criaram dificuldades a muitos portugueses em 2023. Mas apesar de os indicadores económicos mostrarem isso, havia um desafio: como retratar essas histórias? Fomos às raízes do jornalismo de dados e da publicação do “Precision Journalism: A Reporter's Introduction to Social Science Methods” e decidimos que nada melhor do que criar essa base de dados de testemunhos que tomavam o pulso à economia. Uma amostra que nunca teve a intenção de ser estatisticamente representativa mas que, na nossa opinião, foi o rosto das múltiplas dificuldades que os portugueses enfrentaram em 2023.
2024-s-0158.impact: O impacto deste projecto foi enorme, sendo provavelmente dos projectos mais bem sucedidos em termos de impacto que o jornal já produziu. Conseguimos que mais de 400 pessoas (verificadas) conseguissem partilhar o que mudou na sua vida com a subida dos preços, mas também em que bens, etc. Criamos uma espécie de mural que combinava estatísticas e testemunhos para dar rosto a esta crise. E conseguimos, desses 400 testemunhos, extrair 6 grandes reportagens com casos que caracterizavam alguns desses problemas. O que mais nos surpreendeu foi também a capacidade que o jornalismo tem para mudar algumas dessas coisas. Um dos casos reportados, um pai que começou a fazer entregas na Uber Eats depois do trabalho para poder pagar as aulas de piano do filho, recebeu de outro leitor um piano para que este pudesse praticar. Outro, um estudante universitário que viu a sua renda subir de forma bastante expressiva, recebeu um contacto de um senhorio para lhe arrendar um quarto.
2024-s-0158.tools: Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, R, RStudio, Svelte
2024-s-0158.authors: Rui Barros, Joana Gonçalves, Carolina Pescada, Joana Bourgard, Pedro Rios, Sónia Matos
2024-s-0158.summaryJa: 経済危機と利息の上昇は2023年にポルトガルの多くの人々にとって困難をもたらしましたしかし経済指標がそれを示しているにもかかわらず課題はこうでした "これらの物語をどのように描くか?" 私たちはデータジャーナリズムと"プレシジョンジャーナリズム: ジャーナリストの社会科学方法への紹介"を出版し経済を鼓舞する証拠データベースを作るより良いものはないと決めました統計的に表現を意図した例ではありませんが私たちの考えではポルトガルの2023年の様々な困難に直面した例です
2024-s-0158.impactJa: このプロジェクトがもたらした影響は極めて大きいものでおそらくこの新聞がこれまでに作り上げた最も成功したプロジェクトです 400人以上の人々が価格上昇や物資上昇によって変化した生活や状況について共有できるようになりましたこの危機に立ち向かうために統計と証言を組み合わせた壁画を作りました 400人の証言から 6つの大きな報道を集めましたこれらの問題を表すケースですさらに驚いたのはジャーナリズムの能力がこれらの問題を変えられるということです報告されたケースの一つは仕事を終えた後 Uber Eatsで配達し始めた父親が他人の読者からピアノを練習できるようにするためにピアノを受け取ったのですもう"人は大学留学生で収入がかなり上昇したので部屋を貸して欲しいと土地主から連絡を受けました

2024-s-0159.summary: En 2017, l ’Association pour le développement de l’entrepreneuriat des personnes handicapées a indiqué dans un article que le taux de chômage chez les personnes handicapées au Cameroun est de plus de 80% sur au moins 1 000 000 en âge de travailler. Pourtant, l’article 38 de la loi n° 2010/002 du 13 avril 2010 portant protection et promotion des personnes handicapées indique que les personnes handicapées ayant une formation professionnelle ou scolaire doivent être dispensé d’âge lors des recrutements aux emplois publics et privés par rapport aux personnes valides, lorsque le poste est compatible avec leur état.
2024-s-0159.impact: La délégation régionale de l'emploi et de la formation professionnelle pour le Littoral a reconnu avoir négligé cet aspect, ainsi le l'agence régionale du Fonds national de l'emploi qui a confié qu'elle essaiera dans les prochaines années, de mettre l'accent comme pour l'aspect genre, sur les statistiques de l'emploi des personnes handicapées. Plusieurs médioas locaux ont repris ou fait mention de cet article bdans leurs éditions de journale. Le cas de radio Balafon et de Dash TV. L'article a amené des journalistes à s'interesser au traitement des personnes handicapées, le cas des élections sénatorailes de Mars 2023

2024-s-0161.summary: Esta es una narrativa que analiza las temperaturas que se alcanzaron en los meses de junio, julio y agosto cuando en España se superaron 552 récords de temperaturas, tanto diurnas como nocturnas. Un periodo sofocante que dejó anomalías de 1,5ºC en la práctica totalidad de los puntos meteorológicos que forman parte de la red de la Agencia Estatal de Meteorología (Aemet). Para explicarlo planteamos una pregunta al lector: "Y tú, ¿has sufrido más el calor este verano por el día o por la noche?" Los datos, extraídos de la Aemet, referendan las dos respuestas.
2024-s-0161.impact: Esta es una narrativa que surgió de la sección Antropía, un espacio que ofrece información diaria sobre modelos de desarrollo social justos y respetuosos con los recursos naturales. Se elabora desde la Agencia Colpisa para todos los diarios de Vocento. Con esta narrativa buscamos, además de contar la historia, innovar con los datos y el enfoque visual, lo que creo que fue inspirador en la redacción.
2024-s-0161.authors: José A. González (redacción) y Sara I. Belled (formato y visualización de datos)
2024-s-0161.summaryJa: これはスペインでは日と夜に552の温度記録が突破された6月,7月,8月に達成された温度を分析する物語です窒息期は,国家気象庁 (Aemet) のネットワークの一部であるほぼすべての気象点に1.5oCの異常を残しました解明のために読者に質問します "夏の暑さでは日中でも夜でも熱を強いられたの?" Aemetから抽出したデータは両方の答えを反映しています

2024-s-0163.summary: They call it Q-day. That is the day when a robust quantum computer will be able to crack the most common encryption method used to secure our digital data. Q-day will have massive implications for internet companies, banks and governments — as well as our own personal privacy. But how do quantum computers actually work? The FT’s visual storytelling team and innovation editor John Thornhill interviewed dozens of experts in order to explain how they upend the function and assumptions of classical computers. We step through sets of visuals to simplify and explain technical concepts, while written-through sections provide broader context.
2024-s-0163.impact: The project was widely shared and one of the best-read visual stories produced all year. This is a famously complex topic and we needed to make it accessible to a general audience. Our aim was to simplify things and abstract concepts with visual metaphors so that a non-technical reader could grasp the significance and implications, if not all the exact technical details. Based on the comments and feedback, the project achieved this aim of making the function and potential impacts (positive and concerning) understandable. One comment in particular stood out: “This may well be the best use of data visualisation to explain a complex concept I have ever seen. Not only do I feel I am closer to understanding what quantum computing actually is, but I learned a lot about traditional computing that I didn't realise I didn't know.”
2024-s-0163.tools: 3D modeling, D3.js, Three.js, Adobe Creative Suite, CSV, Python, SVG, React
2024-s-0163.authors: Sam Learner, Sam Joiner, Irene de la Torre Arenas, John Thornhill
2024-s-0163.summaryJa: デジタルデータをセキュリティーにするために使用されている最も一般的な暗号化方法を強力な量子コンピュータが破ることができる日です. Q日にはインターネット企業,銀行,政府,そして私たちの個人プライバシーにも大きな影響があります. しかし量子コンピュータは実際にどのように機能するのでしょうか? FT<unk>のビジュアル・ストーリーテリングチームとイノベーション編集者ジョン・ソーンヒルは,クラシックコンピュータの機能と仮定をどのように逆転させるかを説明するために数十人の専門家とインタビューしました.我々は,技術的概念を簡素化し説明するためにビジュアルセットを踏まえており,文字によるセクションはより広い文脈を提供します.
2024-s-0163.impactJa: このプロジェクトは広く共有され,全年で最もよく読まれている視覚的な物語の一つとなりました.これは有名な複雑なテーマで,一般大衆にアクセスできるようにする必要がありました.我々の目標は,視覚的な比喩で物事や抽象的な概念を簡素化することでした.技術的な読者は,正確な技術的な詳細を理解できなければ,意味や意味を理解することができます. プロジェクトでは,コメントとフィードバックに基づいて,機能と潜在的な影響 (ポジティブおよび懸念) を理解できるという目標を達成しました.特に"つのコメントが突出しました: <unk>これは私が今まで見た複雑な概念を説明するためにデータビジュアライゼーションを最もよく利用しているかもしれません. 量子コンピューティングが実際に何であるか理解するのに近づいていると感じているだけでなく,私は知らなかったことを認識していない伝統的なコンピューティングについて多くのことを学びました.<unk>

2024-s-0164.summary: Una reconstrucción al estilo 'true crime' de un incendio, con voces y grabaciones de teléfono móvil de los protagonistas. Los afectados por un incendio y los bomberos encargados de apagarlo cuentan cómo vivieron el día que el parque nacional de alrededor de su población quedó calcinada. El acceso a los datos que recopila el cuerpo de bomberos de Cataluña, referente en Europa, permite reconstruir exactamente qué se quemó, cómo tomaron las decisiones para extinguirlo y qué harán ahora para analizarlo y evitar otros fuegos similares.
2024-s-0164.impact: El proyecto ha tenido un notable impacto en cifra de visualizaciones (10.000), en el principal periódico de habla hispana del Mundo. En la localidad quemada, supuso un cambio inicial en el que las administraciones públicas renovaron su compromiso de aportar dinero para la recuperación del monte quemado.

2024-s-0165.summary: It’s estimated that as many as 1 in 5 women experience some form of mental health issues during pregnancy or in the first year after childbirth, known as the perinatal period. These vary greatly from non-psychotic conditions, such as depressive illness and anxiety, to less common conditions, such as postpartum psychosis. But a widespread lack of knowledge, deeply entrenched stigma and systemic gender and economic inequality mean that millions of people are estimated to go undiagnosed or untreated each year.
2024-s-0165.impact: This stunning audio-visual interactive aimed to address this stigma and engage people by sharing the stories of women across countries and socio-economic groups worldwide and highlight how they can truly affect anyone.

2024-s-0166.summary: A story on how ‘the five families’ wielded power in Former Speaker McCarthy’s majority in the U.S. House of Representatives. The “five families” represent a range of views, from the most moderate who are willing to work with Democrats to the ultraconservative. We collected and analyzed data to show the different GOP groups, how interacted between them and how that was reflected in U.S. policy.
2024-s-0166.impact: We released this data for the first time contextualizing how the groups or caucuses interacted between them. The story worked really well between readers and we attracted academics and other reporters that wanted to work with the data we collected and released. The data behind this project is publicly accessible at https://github.com/washingtonpost/data-republican-caucuses.

2024-s-0167.summary: Российские власти заявляют, что «частичная» мобилизация в России затронула всего 300 тысяч человек. Проверить эти утверждения практически невозможно, а оценка властей не вызывают доверия. «Медиазона» нашла способ независимо оценить число мобилизованных по данным о числе людей, которые ускоренно вступили в брак, показав повестку на фронт. Число «избыточных» (больше, чем обычно) браков мы сравнили с числом мужчин, которые состоят в отношениях — и таким образом выявили процент мужчин, которых отправили на фронт.

2024-s-0168.summary: En abril de 2023, la India superó a China como el país más poblado del mundo. El trabajo es un análisis del rápido crecimiento demográfico de la India, con una población muy joven, así como la rápida expansión de sus ciudades, y el contraste con el descenso poblacional y la ciudadanía envejecida de China.
2024-s-0168.impact: Aparte de ser una de las piezas relacionadas con la explosión demográfica de la India que ha tenido un mayor número de visualizaciones en nuestro periódico, pone en valor la importancia de esta superpotencia y su peso en el plano mundial en los próximos años. También destacar el acercamiento al público general de una visualización compleja como es la densidad de población y hacerla entendible.

2024-s-0169.summary: O ano de 2023 ficou marcado por recordes consecutivos de temperaturas, tanto no ar como nos oceanos - o ano acabou mesmo por ser o mais quente de sempre. Face a esta realidade, e tendo em conta os registos históricos verificados durante o verão no Atlântico Norte, decidimos criar uma ferramenta que permitisse saber a temperatura da água do mar em cada praia da costa portuguesa, ao mesmo tempo que monitorizávamos a temperatura média da água de toda a costa portuguesa.
2024-s-0169.impact: Esta_ news application_ teve um impacto imediato, com a sua actualização diária a atrair diariamente vários utilizadores recorrentes que passaram a consultar as previsões da temperatura da água do mar nas suas praias. A actualização diária dos registos permitiu ainda vigiar a evolução da temperatura, tendo sido possível extrair dados relevantes para outros trabalhos jornalísticos.

2024-s-0169.summaryJa: 2023年は空気と海洋の両方の連続的な温度記録で記録されました - 史上最も暑い年でした. この現実を踏まえ,北大西洋の夏に記録された歴史を考慮して,ポルトガル海岸の各海岸の海水の温度を把握できるツールを作ることにしました. 同時にポルトガル海岸全体の平均水温を監視しました.
2024-s-0169.impactJa: このニュースアプリケーションは,毎日更新され,毎日何度も何度も利用者が海域の海水の温度予測をチェックするようになった.日々の記録更新により,温度の変化を監視し,他の新聞の仕事のために関連データを抽出することが可能になった.

2024-s-0170.summary: The story tackled a deep and persistent challenge of discrimination and segregation subjected to or suffered by people with dreadlocked hairstyles, especially men in Uganda. It was published on two different days because it was a long form story. In the process, the story uncovered the forms of the inhumane act of stereotyping these individuals, the institutions where it happens, including government-led institutions as well as security organs in Uganda such as the Uganda Police Force.
2024-s-0170.impact: The story established the root or depth of the problem and then higlighted the plausible remedies to address the challenge. The story further uncovered the role, strengths and impact of undermining the laws or regulations. It as well highlighted the need to understand that, cultural differences exist between different groups and people. Due to this, the story also uncovered the plight that dreadlocked communities face on a daily, interms of accessing employment opportunities in reputable companies or organizations. Through this story, it was established that, the role of embracing various aspects of culture that unite and disregard all aspects of discrimination is essential in uniting different people.
2024-s-0170.tools: 360, Animation, 3D modeling, Personalisation, Three.js, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, RStudio
2024-s-0170.authors: Author - Arthur Arnold Wadero EDITORIAL Carolyn Thompson Ajibola Amzat Jeff Kelly Lowenstein DATA Sotiris Sideris Yuxi Wang Ayuka Kawakami Rakshitha Narasimhan Grace Fang DESIGN AND VISUALS Nic Bothma Jillian Dudziak Serena Stelitano Scott Lewis
2024-s-0170.summaryJa: この物語は,特にウガンダの男性で,不毛髪型を持つ人々,または苦しんでいる差別や隔離の深い持続的な課題を扱った.それは長い形式の物語であったため,二つの異なる日に出版された. この過程で,この物語は,これらの個人をステレオタイプする不人道的な行為の形態, 政府主導の機関を含む機関, ウガンダ警察のようなウガンダの安全保障機関を含む機関を明らかにしました.
2024-s-0170.impactJa: この物語は問題の根源や深さを確立し,その課題に対処するための妥当な救済策を強調した.この物語は法律や規制を損なう役割,強み,影響をさらに明らかにした.また,異なる集団と人々の間に文化的差異が存在することを理解する必要性を強調した. この物語は,評判の高い企業や組織で雇用機会にアクセスする際,日常的に,不自由なコミュニティが直面する苦悩を明らかにした.この物語を通じて,異なる人々を統合する文化のさまざまな側面を擁する役割が,差別のあらゆる側面を無視し,異なる人々を統合する上で不可欠であると確立された.

2024-s-0171.summary: O Governo português anunciou a 24 de Março de 2023 a isenção de IVA em bens alimentares essenciais, numa tentativa de responder aos efeitos da inflação e consequente agravamento do custo de vida. Decidiu-se criar um _tracker_ para acompanhar a evolução dos preços do cabaz de alimentos definido e comparar essa variação com os alimentos não abrangidos pela medida.
2024-s-0171.impact: O _tracker_ permitiu acompanhar de uma forma clara e holística a evolução desta medida de isenção do IVA. A sua actualização semanal ao longo de nove meses permitiu aos leitores consultar a variação dos preços de 41 produtos do cabaz IVA zero, comparando ainda a variação do valor total do cabaz com a variação dos produtos não englobados. A actualização regular permitiu também obter várias histórias de acompanhamento ao longo dos meses.
2024-s-0171.tools: D3.js, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, R, RStudio, Svelte
2024-s-0171.authors: José Volta e Pinto, Rui Barros
2024-s-0171.summaryJa: 葡萄牙政府は2023年3月24日に,インフレの影響と生計コストの悪化に対応するため,必須食品の税免を発表した. 食品の価格の変化を追跡し,その変化を対象外の食品と比較するために, _tracker_を作成することを決定した.
2024-s-0171.impactJa: _tracker_は,この税免措置の発展を明確に全般的に追跡できるようにしました.その9ヶ月間毎週更新は,読者に41の商品の価格変動を参照し,総額変動を,未収納品の変動と比較し,毎週更新は,数ヶ月間にわたっていくつかの追跡ストーリーを入手することが可能になりました.

2024-s-0172.summary: An immersive visit into the homes of three families living in Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine, six days after a Russian missile strike on their apartment block.
2024-s-0172.impact: The project sheds light on the impact of the war in Ukraine on ordinary civilians and their daily lives. By combining intimate photographic portraits, photogrammetry of the residents' apartments, and text based on interviews with the residents, the article immerses the reader in the experiences of families affected by Putin's incessant bombing.
2024-s-0172.tools: 3D modeling, Adobe Creative Suite, Photogrammetry (Polycam) Blender Video
2024-s-0172.authors: Adina Renner, Jonas Roth, Dominic Nahr, Alex Kräuchi, Franco Gervasi, Kaspar Manz
2024-s-0172.summaryJa: ウクライナの札<unk>市に住む3人の家族の家を訪ねましたロシアがアパートにミサイル攻撃を 6日後に
2024-s-0172.impactJa: このプロジェクトはウクライナ戦争が平民と日常生活への影響を明らかにします住民のアパートの写真やインタビューのテキストを組み合わせてプーチンの不時な爆撃の影響を受けた家族の体験に読者を浸透します

2024-s-0173.summary: llegal shipments to Pyongyang, which is developing a new generation of ballistic missiles and nuclear warheads, have been well documented. Less well known, however, are the individuals behind the shadowy networks that enable the regime of Kim Jong Un to finance its nuclear ambitions. A year-long investigation by the Financial Times and the Royal United Services Institute revealed for the first time how business figures in Asia have helped facilitate illicit deliveries of hundreds of thousands of barrels of oil to North Korea. Using groundbreaking visuals, it’s a story of gangsters, ghost ships and spies.
2024-s-0173.impact: In the wake of this investigation we have already seen a change in the activity of the ships and individuals referenced in the story. The project also documents, for the first time, the ways in which businesses help to prop up Kim Jong Un's nuclear regime. For this reason alone the investigation is an important piece of analysis — and helps frame how researchers, NGOs and nations should approach the subject of North Korean oil smuggling. Importantly for the FT, the piece was also hit with subscribers, with an article dwell time well above the FT average. The most-liked comment summed up the thoughts of many: “Fabulous reporting, and hats off to the graphics team. This is what journalism should look like — thank you.”
2024-s-0173.authors: Authors: Christian Davies, Primrose Riordan, Chan Ho-him, Steven Bernard, Dan Clark, Sam Joiner, and Caroline Nevitt. Additional development and design by Justine Williams and Irene de la Torre Arenas.
2024-s-0173.summaryJa: 弾道ミサイルと核弾頭の新しい世代を開発している平壌への輸送はよく記録されていますが,しかし,核兵器の野心を資金提供できるようにする陰影なネットワークの背後にある個人についてはあまり知られていない. 金融タイムズとロイヤルユナイテッド・サービス・インスティテュトが1年間かけて調査した結果ではアジアのビジネス人数が北朝鮮に数十万バレルの石油を違法に運ぶのを促したことが初めて明らかになりました画期的な映像を使ってギャングや幽霊船やスパイたちの物語です
2024-s-0173.impactJa: この調査の結果,この話に言及されている船舶や個人の活動の変化が既に目睹されています.このプロジェクトは,初めて,企業が金正恩の核政権を支えるのに役立つ方法についても記録しています.この理由だけで,調査は重要な分析の1つであり,研究者やNGOや国が北朝鮮の石油密輸の問題に取り組むべき方法を枠組みに組み込むのに役立ちます. FTにとって重要なことは,この作品は購読者にも影響を受け,記事の滞在時間は FT平均よりもはるかに高くなりました.最も人気のあるコメントは,多くの人々の考えをまとめました. <unk>素晴らしいレポート,グラフィックチームへの帽子. ジャーナリズムはこんな感じで見えます. <unk>ありがとうございました.<unk>

2024-s-0174.summary: The project was conceived during a time of political division and high expectations fueled by speculative polls regarding the Presidential elections scheduled for February 25, 2023. The project aimed to predict the election outcome objectively by providing factual and unbiased explanations of the factors that influenced past voting patterns in Nigeria, offering reliable statistical estimations of critical variables that would determine the election outcome, reducing potential misinformation from election pollsters and the impact of false narratives such as group grievances and riots that might arise after the elections. The project’s predictions matched the eventual election outcome with a 98% correlation.
2024-s-0174.impact: The first story in the project, published in Dataphyte's Data Dives Newsletter, had the highest number of reads in the year 2023 as well as when published on the website. Also, Premium Times, a well-known investigative journalism organization in Nigeria, reviewed traditional and new opinion polls that were inaccurate and singled out the Dataphyte story as the only one that provided precise and correct predictions without any equivocation. The project’s stories emphasized the importance of data and objectivity in moderating public discourse, particularly where leading opinions are influenced by bias and emotions, and in reducing the risk of misleading the public into group grievances by these divided opinions. The story was the first and only one to clearly state the pattern of the election victory: that regardless of the scenario, the eventual winner, President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, was the only candidate to secure the required 25% of votes in two-thirds of the 36 states and the federal capital. The project’s success was lauded by many, as it provided a reliable and objective tool for understanding the complex dynamics of Nigerian politics. This helped to reduce shock and surprise and ensured a less riotous aftermath of the presidential elections.
2024-s-0174.summaryJa: このプロジェクトは,政治分裂と2023年2月25日に予定されている大統領選挙に関する投機的な調査によって高期待がもたらされた時代に考案されました. このプロジェクトは,ナイジェリアの過去の投票パターンに影響を与えた要因について事実的かつ公正な説明を提供し,選挙結果を決定する重要な変数の信頼できる統計的な推定を提供し,選挙民意調査者から潜在的な誤った情報と選挙後に発生する集団の不満や暴動などの虚偽の物語の影響を減らすことを目的とした. プロジェクト<unk>の予測は 98%の関連性をもって最終的な選挙結果と一致しました
2024-s-0174.impactJa: プロジェクトの最初の記事は,データファイトのデータダイブズニュースレターで掲載され,ウェブサイトで公開されたときでも2023年に最も多くの読者数が集まった.また,ナイジェリアの知名調査ジャーナリズム組織であるプレミアムタイムズは,誤った伝統的な新しい世論調査をレビューし,ダタファイトの話を誤った予測なしに正確な予測を提供した唯一のものとして挙げました. プロジェクトでの話では,特に指導的な意見が偏見や感情の影響を受けるとき,公共の議論を調節し,この意見の分裂によって大衆をグループ不満に誤導するリスクを減らす上で,データと客観性の重要性を強調した. この物語は選挙勝利のパターンを明確に示す最初の話であり,最終的な勝利者,ボラ・アフメド・ティヌブ大統領が36州と連邦首都の3分の2で必要な25%の票を獲得した唯一の候補であった.このプロジェクトの成功は,ナイジェリア政治の複雑な動態を理解するための信頼性と客観的なツールを提供したため,多くの人々が賞賛した. これはショックと驚きを軽減し大統領選挙の後ほど騒乱を防ぐのに役立ちました

2024-s-0176.summary: Almost 42 million Americans – over one-eighth of the US population – are estimated to have lived within one mile of a mass shooting since 2014, according to an original CNN analysis of data from the Gun Violence Archive (GVA) and US Census Bureau.
2024-s-0176.impact: As the audience scrolls through the piece, they hear stories from mass shooting survivors, see a populating map with the locations of mass shootings and charts on the deadliness and local demographics of such shootings. The audience ends at a map where they can input their address and see the proximity of their location to mass shootings that have occurred since 2014 — a startling personalization to highlight a reality that so many Americans face regularly.
2024-s-0176.tools: QGIS, Adobe Creative Suite, Python, Datawrapper
2024-s-0176.authors: oReporter, Design and Data Editor: Amy O'Kruk oEditor: Anna Brand oDeveloper: Kenneth Uzquiano oAudio Producer: Matthew Gannon
2024-s-0176.summaryJa: 2014年以来,米国の人口の8分の1以上は,銃乱射事件から1マイル以内に暮らしていると推定されています.
2024-s-0176.impactJa: 観客が作品をスクロールするにつれて,彼らは大量銃撃の生存者の話を聞き,大量銃撃の場所と死亡率とそのような銃撃の地域人口統計に関する地図を集める地図を見る.観客は,自分の住所を入力し,2014年以降発生した大量銃撃との位置の近距離を見ることができます. 驚くべき個性化により,多くのアメリカ人が定期的に直面する現実を強調します.

2024-s-0177.summary: A reportagem visual mostra uma “cascata de homens brancos”, onde as linhas que os representam ocupam a altura quase total do gráfico, o que aponta de maneira inédita a sobrerrepresentação de homens brancos no Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) ao longo da história. Entre 170 ministros que haviam atuado no órgão até aquele momento, somente três eram negros – todos homens - e somente três eram mulheres - todas brancas.
2024-s-0177.impact: Ao mostrar que, desde sua criação, o STF teve suas cadeiras ocupadas 95% do tempo por homens brancos, o trabalho serviu de insumo e foi amplamente citado por organizações da sociedade civil na defesa de maior representatividade no STF, como o Movimento Mulheres Negras Decidem, que liderou a campanha #MinistraNegraJá Os dados foram citados por veículos de circulação nacional e regionais, nativos digitais e da mídia tradicional, como o Portal Catarinas, Brasil de Fato (PE), Redes da Maré, Valor Econômico, Núcleo Jornalismo e Portal Ig. O trabalho ganhou o Prêmio Cláudio Weber Abramo de Jornalismo de Dados 2023, na categoria “Visualização”.
2024-s-0177.tools: Google Sheets, CSV, Adobe Illustrator, Flourish
2024-s-0177.authors: Aline Gatto Boueri, Victória Sacagami, Marcella Semente
2024-s-0177.summaryJa: 視覚的な報道では,白人男性<unk>が描かれているのは,グラフのほぼ全身長を占めるので,歴史上初めて,連邦最高裁 (STF) の白人男性が過半数に代表されていることが示されています. 当時の170人の大臣のうち,黒人3人だけが男性であり,女性3人だけが白人でした.
2024-s-0177.impactJa: STFが設立されて以来,その座席は95%白人男性に占められていたことを示すことで,この研究は,Catarinas Portal, Brazil de Fato (PE), Redなどの国内および地域,デジタルネイティブ,伝統的なメディアの通信機関によって引用され, 作品は"データジャーナリズム・フレームワーク2023"クラウディオ・ウェバー賞を受賞しました.

2024-s-0178.summary: This is a solution journalism story about Ngong forest, an area that is crucial for biodiversity. Unfortunately, it has been under threat due to human activities. The consequences of this have been felt by the nearby communities, who are now experiencing the effects of climate change. As a result of deforestation and other human activities, the region has become extremely prone to drought, and during the rainy season, the area is plagued by floods. It's a sad situation, and it highlights the importance of taking care of our environment and the impact that our actions can have on the world.
2024-s-0178.impact: Ive been invited to train journalists on the use of data in storytelling. The story has also been widely shared by the journalists as a new way of multimedia storytelling.
2024-s-0178.tools: AR, Scraping, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets
2024-s-0178.summaryJa: 生物多様性にとって重要な地域である,ニョン森林に関する解決ジャーナリストの物語です.残念ながら,それは人間の活動によって脅かされている.この影響は,現在気候変動の影響を受けている近くの地域によって感じられています.森林伐採やその他の人間の活動の結果,この地域は干ばつに非常に容易になり,雨季では洪水が襲う. 悲しい状況です環境の配慮と行動が世界に与える影響の重要性を強調します
2024-s-0178.impactJa: メディアのストーリーテリングの新しい方法としてジャーナリストが広く共有しているストーリーテリングの活用についてジャーナリストを訓練するよう招待されました

2024-s-0179.summary: Projeto único no mundo, o “LupaMundi - Mapa das legislações sobre desinformação” apresenta, em um mapa interativo, as leis sobre desinformação do mundo todo. Elaborado pela Lupa, o mapa está disponível em português e inglês, o que o torna uma ferramenta que pode ser consultada por pessoas de diversas nacionalidades. Com a busca, o usuário pode usar filtros e comparar as leis dos países, o que possibilita uma análise aprofundada sobre o tema, fazendo com que seja uma referência especialmente para jornalistas, pesquisadores e estudiosos do fenômeno da desinformação.
2024-s-0179.impact: O LupaMundi foi lançado em novembro de 2023 e despertou grande interesse de jornalistas e pesquisadores de desinformação no Brasil e no exterior. As informações do LupaMundi estão à disposição de qualquer pessoa para que sejam usadas em reportagens, pesquisas acadêmicas e outros. Como resultado da relevância do projeto, a Lupa foi convidada a participar de uma série de eventos para apresentar o LupaMundi, como o Fórum Pamela Howard para Cobertura de Crises Globais, do International Center for Journalists (ICFJ), e uma reunião com checadores do mundo todo da International Fact-Checking Network (IFCN). O mapa também foi apresentado para acadêmicos brasileiros que estudam o fenômeno da desinformação em uma live organizada pela Lupa. A possibilidade de comparar a legislação sobre desinformação no mundo todo de forma simples e fácil chamou a atenção de diversos veículos especializados. O LupaMundi foi destaque nos seguintes veículos: Latam Journalism Review, do Knight Center de Jornalismo das Américas, International Center for Journalists (ICFJ), International Fact-Checking Network (IFCN), Portal dos Jornalistas, Farol Jornalismo, O Desinformante, Ajor e Agência Tatu. As matérias no site da Lupa tiveram mais de 10 mil visualizações. Os posts publicados nas redes sociais da Lupa tiveram alto engajamento com 60 mil interações.
2024-s-0179.authors: Natália Leal, Marcela Duarte, Flávia Campuzano, Nathália Afonso, Renan Cavalcante, Edda Ribeiro, Helena Bertho, Bruno Nomura, Ítalo Rômany, Álvaro Justen, Marcel Matias, Mariana Martins, Denise da Silveira e Luiz Carreirão.
2024-s-0179.summaryJa: 世界一一のプロジェクトである"ルパ・モンディ - 誤報法規の地図"は,互動的な地図で,世界中の誤報法について紹介しています.ルパが作成した地図は,ポルトガル語と英語で利用可能であり,様々な国籍の人々によって可視化できるツールです. 検索によって,ユーザーはフィルターを使用して国の法律を比較することができ,このテーマを深く分析し,特にジャーナリスト,研究者や誤報現象の研究者にとって参考になるようにします.
2024-s-0179.impactJa: ルパムンディは2023年11月に発売され,ブラジル国内外のジャーナリストや情報乱媒研究者の大きな関心を喚起した.ルパムンディの情報は,報道,学術研究などに使用されるため,誰にでも利用可能である. プロジェクトが重要であることを示すため,ルパは国際ジャーナリストセンター (ICFJ) のパメラ・ハワード・グローバル・危機報道フォーラムや国際事実チェックネットワーク (IFCN) の世界中のチェックヤーとの会合など,ルパムンディを紹介する一連のイベントに参加するよう招待された. 簡単に,世界中の誤報に関する法律を比較できる可能性は,様々な専門メディアの注意を引いた.ルパムンディは,アメリカナイトジャーナリズムセンターのLatam Journalism Review,International Center for Journalists (ICFJ),International Fact-Checking Network (IFCN),Journalists' Portal,Forol Journalism,O Desinformant,Ajor,Agência Tatuの記事で注目された. ルーパのウェブサイトの記事は1万回以上見られルーパのソーシャルメディアに投稿された記事は6万回以上のインタラクションで高い関わりを得ました

2024-s-0180.summary: O Ferrovia 2020 projetou um investimento próximo a três mil milhões de euros para a modernização e eletrificação da rede ferroviária portuguesa, mas as taxas de execução continuavam, em 2020, abaixo do estimado inicialmente. Quem ganhou mais com os contratos públicos? Qual o atraso destas obras face ao inicialmente previsto? Quantos milhões vão ficar por executar? Qual o custo-benefício das obras em curso? Estas são as perguntas de partida para um trabalho que quis analisar o investimento público realizado no sector da ferrovia no último quadro comunitário de apoio 2014-2020 (cuja execução podia ir até 2023).
2024-s-0180.impact: O projecto foi muito bem recebido porque tornou transparente informação que estava dispersa ou que nem sequer tinha sido divulgada de forma transparente. Como foi criado um conjunto de scripts que permite uma actualização diária do projecto, o portal tornou-se a plataforma onde qualquer cidadão pode consultar o estado da obra que, de alguma forma, mais impacto tem na sua vida. A plataforma também veio colocar a descoberto a falta de transparência no processo, uma vez que, por exemplo, tornou-se impossível dizer quanto é que o orçamento de alguns dos troços já derrapou - que era, inicialmente, um dos grandes objetivos do projecto.
2024-s-0180.tools: 3D modeling, Scraping, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, R, RStudio, Svelte
2024-s-0180.authors: Carlos Cipriano, Ruben Martins, Diogo Ferreira Nunes, Rui Barros
2024-s-0180.summaryJa: 鉄道2020はポルトガルの鉄道網の近代化と電化に約3億ユーロの投資を計画したが,実行料金は2020年に当初予想よりも低かった.公募で誰が最も多く利益を得たのか?当初予想されたと比べてこれらの工程が遅れているのか?何百万が実行されなくなるのか?現在進行中の工程のコスト・利益はどれぐらいですか? これは,最後の2014-2020年における欧州支援枠組み (その実施は2023年まで行われること) で,鉄道部門への公的投資を分析した研究への出発質問です.
2024-s-0180.impactJa: プロジェクトが好評を受けました広範囲に広がっていた情報や公開されていない情報も透明化されましたプロジェクトを毎日更新できるスクリプトが作られることでウェブサイトは市民が作品の現状を調べることができるプラットフォームになりましたプラットフォームはプロセスにおける透明性の欠如を明らかにしました例えば,その一部の予算が既にどれだけ落ちたかを伝えることはできません. これは当初,プロジェクトの大きな目標の一つでした.

2024-s-0181.summary: O blog iniciado em 2018, está inserido na categoria responsivo. O uso de ferramentas como recursos do google analitics, técnicas de seo para divulgação do site, são recursos usados na otimização do site. O blog é escrito em terceira pessoa de forma jornalística com técnicas e recursos de lead e nariz de cera. Não são usados recursos de inteligência artificial no uso da redação e artigos escritos. Sobre a aplicação de recurso de otimização são usados plataformas do google como analitics e google search. O uso de link interno em cada artigo escrito também é um recurso utilizado na otimização.
2024-s-0181.impact: O blog é responsivo, e iniciado em 2018. Têm formato de revista digital, com temas abrangentes da atualidades. Têm como princípio editorial aspectos científicos, sociais e culturais. Os assuntos abordados são escritos sobre artigos relevantes da sociedade tendo como destaque informações científicas, sociais e tecnológicas da contemporaneidade. As informações têm como fontes, agências de noticia, sites informativos das categorias, artigos científicos e livros publicados devidamente checados e com os devidos créditos jornalístico e editorial.
2024-s-0181.authors: Jocelma Holandino de Vasconcelos, autora, redatora, editora e SEO do projeto.
2024-s-0181.summaryJa: 2018年に開始されたブログは,応答性カテゴリーに含まれています.Google分析のリソース,サイト宣伝のためのセオ技術などのツールを使用することは,ウェブサイト最適化に使用されるリソースです.ブログは,リードとワーム鼻の技術やリソースで第三者によるジャーナリズム形式で書かれています.編集や書かれた記事の使用において人工知能のリソースは使用されません. 優化機能の適用について,Googleのプラットフォームである analiticsとGoogle検索が使用されています. 文章の内部リンクの使用は,最適化に使用される機能でもあります.
2024-s-0181.impactJa: ブログは 2018年に開始された. デジタル雑誌の形式で,包括的な話題を掲載しています. 編集原則として科学,社会,文化的な側面があります. 対象となるテーマは,現代科学,社会,技術情報を強調し,社会関連記事について書かれています. 情報は,情報源,ニュース機関,カテゴリー情報サイト,科学論文,そして,適切にチェックされた,適切な新聞や出版のクレジットで出版された本などです.

2024-s-0182.summary: Multinational corporations, out-of-state investors and billionaires are buying up gigantic chunks of Nebraska farmland, found a 2023 Flatwater Free Press data-driven series. FFP requested sales records, exhaustively cleaned, compiled and checked them with Nebraska's 93 counties, then chopped through a thicket of LLCs, revealing the buyers' hidden identities. Among the findings: Seven of Top 10 are headquartered outside Nebraska and spent a combined five-year total of $246 million. The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints and Ted Turner each own entire counties of ranchland. Bill Gates, Meta and Google are buying up pricey farmland -- and pricing out farmers.
2024-s-0182.impact: Stories in the 8-story series, "Who's Buying Nebraska?" were read by more Nebraskans than any other in FFP's history. The second story in the series, on the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints' Nebraska land purchases, was read by more than 260,000 people, or nearly 15% of the state's population. The stories were also republished by dozens of other Nebraska media outlets, from the biggest TV station to tiny weekly newspapers, ensuring that hundreds of thousands of other Nebrsakans saw them. The series has sparked renewed conversation about regulation of farmland buys, the usage of water underneath farmland and other issues related to rising land value. And it has challenged Nebraska's traditional perception that farmers own the land on which they grow crops and raise cattle. It's instead focused attention on a rural and little discussed part of income inequality, which is that more Bill Gates' own Nebraska land, while fewer and fewer middle-class farm families do.
2024-s-0182.tools: Adobe Creative Suite, Google Sheets, CSV, R, RStudio, OpenRefine and Posit Cloud
2024-s-0182.authors: Yanqi Xu, Destiny Herbers, Evelyn Mejia
2024-s-0182.summaryJa: 複数の国営企業,州外の投資家,億万長者がネブラスカ州の巨大な農地を購入している. 2023年のFlatwater Free Pressデータに基づくシリーズが見つかりました.FFPは販売記録を要求し,徹底的に清掃し,ネブラスカの93郡とそれらを収集し,確認し,その後,LLCの厚い塊を切り,購入者の隠れたアイデンティティを明らかにしました. 発見の7つ:トップ10の7つはネブラスカ州の外に本部を置いており 5年間の総額246万ドルを費やしています末日聖徒イエス・キリスト教会とテッド・ターナー教会はそれぞれ全郡の牧場を所有していますビル・ゲイツ,メタ,Googleは高価な農地を買収し農民を価格に絞っています

2024-s-0183.summary: 2023 was record shattering for anti-LGBTQ legislation, with particular scrutiny on gender-affirming health care access for transgender children and teenagers. Nineteen states have passed laws (as of publish date) restricting it. Since not all bans are the same, CNN analyzed Movement Advancement Project data on the laws to map and categorize what is happening and where.
2024-s-0183.impact: While nineteen states have passed laws restricting gender-affirming care, not all bans are the same, making the information difficult to digest. CNN has analyzed the data and mapped and categorized it in order to make the information easier to find and understand. With the rise in the number of bills introduced in state leislatures that aimed to restrict access to healthcare for transgender Americans, the team wants this piece to be a tool and service for readers to reference – whether it be searching for information that pertains to them or for those looking to take a deeper dive into the topic.
2024-s-0183.authors: Data analysis, graphics and reporting: Annette Choi and Will Mullery
2024-s-0183.summaryJa: 2023年はLGBTQ反対の法律で記録的な破綻を遂げました.特にトランスジェンダー・子供や青少年に対するジェンダー確認の健康ケアへのアクセスについて調査が行われました.19州が法律を通過し (公表日時点) に制限しました.すべての禁止は同じではないため,CNNは,何が起こっているか,どこで起こっているかを地図化して分類するために,法律に関するムーブメント・アドバンセンション・プロジェクトデータを分析しました.
2024-s-0183.impactJa: 19州がジェンダーに関するケアを制限する法律を制定しているが,すべての禁止は同じではないため,情報を消化するのが困難である.CNNは情報を分析し,情報を簡単に見つけ,理解できるように地図化,分類した. 州議会で導入された法案の数が増えておりトランスジェンダーアメリカ人の医療へのアクセスを制限することを目的としたためこの作品は読者の参考になるためのツールとサービスになりたかったのです対象となる情報を探しているかどうかテーマを深く調べたい人でもありません

2024-s-0184.summary: A reportagem visual traz cinco gráficos para entender o racismo estrutural no Brasil a partir da representação das desigualdades nas áreas de educação, trabalho, violência, saúde e política. O projeto conta com uma linha do tempo, que mostra que ⅔ da história brasileira transcorreram sob regime escravocrata, e marcos temporais - como leis e políticas públicas de reparação e inclusão - para mostrar a persistência do racismo 135 anos após o fim da escravidão e o tempo transcorrido entre a instauração do regime e as primeiras ações do Estado para reparar as desigualdades que ele criou.
2024-s-0184.impact: A reportagem visual foi publicada no dia 20 de novembro, data na qual o Brasil comemora o Dia da Consciência Negra, e serviu de referência para o debate público sobre desigualdades raciais ao graficar o racismo no Brasil. O trabalho foi citado como referência na newsletter Nos Eixos, do Jornal Nexo, uma das principais publicações mensais sobre visualização de dados no Brasil.
2024-s-0184.tools: Google Sheets, CSV, R, Adobe Illustrator, Scrollama
2024-s-0184.authors: Victória Sacagami, Marilia Ferrari, Vitória Régia da Silva, Aline Gatto Boueri, Diego Nunes da Rocha
2024-s-0184.summaryJa: 視覚的な報道は教育,労働,暴力,健康,政治における不平等の表現からブラジルにおける構造的な人種差別を理解するための5つのグラフを提示していますプロジェクトには,ブラジルの歴史の2/3が奴隷制政権下で過ごされていると示す時間軸があり, 補償と包摂に関する法律や公共政策など, 奴隷制が終結してから135年後の人種差別が持続し, 制度が確立され,政府が最初にもたらした不平等を補償する措置が実施された間までの時間を示しています.
2024-s-0184.impactJa: 視覚的な報道は,ブラジルが黒人の意識の日を祝う11月20日に発表された.このレポートは,ブラジルにおける人種差別をグラフ化する際に人種差別に関する公共議論の参考となった.この研究は,ブラジルにおける主要なデータ閲覧に関する月刊刊刊の"Nexo Jornal"のニュースレター"Nos Eixos"に引用された.

2024-s-0185.summary: Russian opposition leader Alexei Navalny has been imprisoned for three years now. And he spent nearly 300 days of this term in SHIZO, the punishment isolation cell, which is the most severe form of legal punishment for inmates in Russian prisons. A concrete sack devoid of sunlight and fresh air, it cloaks prisoners in a regime of stringent prohibitions. To shed light on this form of torment, we have compiled a guide covering all of Navalny’s SHIZO terms. We’ve also created a simulator that offers readers a vivid insight into Navalny’s SHIZO cell environment—available on the web and via VR.
2024-s-0185.impact: Multiple stints in solitary confinement are internationally recognized as torture. In Russia, more and more political prisoners find themselves subjected to this treatment. We created an immersive experience which allows users to become witnesses of this torture—on the example of the most famous and influential political prisoner in modern Russia. The project reached hundreds of thousands of our followers and earned praise from colleagues in the media. Released in the summer of 2023, it’s constantly updated, as Alexei Navalny is punished with SHIZO over and over again.
2024-s-0185.tools: VR, 3D modeling, AI/Machine learning, D3.js, Three.js, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets
2024-s-0185.summaryJa: ロシアの野党指導者アレキッシー・ナバルニーは3年間刑務所に収監されています. そして,この期間のほぼ300日を SHIZOで過ごしました. これはロシア刑務所の囚人のための最も厳しい法的処罰です. 太陽光や清潔な空気の無いコンクリート袋で,囚人は厳しい禁令の体制に閉じ込められています. この拷問の形態を明るくするために,我々は Navalnyの SHIZOのすべての用語をカバーするガイドをまとめました. We<unk>ve also created a simulator that offers readers a vivid insight into Navalny<unk>s SHIZO cell environment<unk>available on the web and via VR.
2024-s-0185.impactJa: 独房での多回の滞在は国際的に拷問として認められていますロシアでは政治犯が多発的にこの処置を受けています現代のロシアの最も有名な政治犯の例を踏まえ,この拷問の目撃者になるためのインセンティブ体験を作成しましたこのプロジェクトは何百万人ものフォロワーに達し,メディアの同僚からの賞賛を得ました 2023年の夏にリリースされ,アレキシー・ナバレーが再び SHIZOと罰を受けられるように,常に更新されています.

2024-s-0186.summary: As security has tightened around rail and road crossings to the United Kingdom, the Channel between the UK and France has become a more common route for migrants desperate for a better life. It is a perilous journey. CNN analyzed how one deadly incident on December 14, 2022 unfolded, drawing on flight and ship-tracking data, official records from authorities, a distress call and interviews at the scene. The UK government owns AI technology said to be capable of swiftly detecting these boats and even deploying life rafts. But it was a passing fishing crew that saved nearly everyone on board.
2024-s-0186.impact: The UK government has invested in high-tech surveillance for the English Channel. But as the number of small boats arriving on UK shores continues to rise, it’s not clear whether this expensive AI technology is effective either in detecting the boats or in helping save the lives of those on board when they sink. When a small boat packed with migrants capsized last December, leaving four dead, it was a fishing crew that came to the rescue. This piece explores one facet of a global trend in using AI technology to digitize border security. The mapping starts out with a snapshot of the frequency and type of UK channel boat crossings. That same map transitions to show the depth of UK surveillance. And then delves into one investigation of a perilous Channel journey that resulted in loss of life. Additionally, this piece shines a light on a topic that has high public interest.
2024-s-0186.tools: QGIS, Adobe Creative Suite, Python, Deck GL, Figma
2024-s-0186.authors: oReporters: Katie Polglase, Livvy Doherty oContributing reporters: Julie Zink, Martin Bourke oVisual editor: Sarah-Grace Mankarious oDevelopers: Byron Manley, David Blood oData reporter: Lou Robinson oPhoto editor: Sarah Tilotta oEditors: Laura Smith-Spark, Eliza Mackintosh, Mark Oliver
2024-s-0186.summaryJa: 鉄道・道路通路の安全が強化されたため,イギリスとフランス間の運河はより良い生活を望む移民にとってより一般的なルートとなっています.これは危険な旅です.CNNは2022年12月14日に起きた致命的な事件の様子を分析し,飛行と船追跡データ,当局からの公式記録,救急電話,現場でのインタビューを参考にしました. イギリス政府は人工知能技術を所有しており迅速にこれらの船を検出し救助船を部署する能力があると言われていますが通過する漁船隊が船上の人びとのほとんどを救いました
2024-s-0186.impactJa: イギリス政府はイギリス海峡のハイテク監視に投資した.しかし,英国の海岸に到着する小さなボートの数は増加し続けていますが,この高価なAI技術はボートを検出する上で有効か,沈む時に船に乗っている人々の命を救うのに役立つかどうか不明です.移民に包まれた小さなボートは昨年12月に倒れ,4人の死者を残したときに,漁船隊が救助に来た. この作品は,国境警備をデジタル化するためにAI技術を使用する世界的な傾向の一面を探索します.地図作成は,英国の運河船越しの頻度と種類の瞬時に始まります.同じ地図は,英国の監視の深さを示す移行です.そして,生命の喪失をもたらした危険な運河旅行の調査を深めていきます.さらに,この作品は,公衆の関心が高い話題に光を当てます.

2024-s-0187.summary: Этот проект представляет наиболее подробные сведения о наемниках частной военной компании "Вагнер", которые участвовали в боях под украинском городом Бахмут в 2022 году и начале 2023 года и которых похоронили на одном из городских кладбищ — крупнейшем захоронении наемников в восточной части России. Проект рассказывает о личных данных похороненных, а также регионах, где они жили перед вербовкой на войну, а также описывает практику захоронения погибших бойцов властями Новосибирской области и руководством ЧВК "Вагнер".
2024-s-0187.impact: Проект был опубликован в период, когда власти Новосибирска [столкнулись](https://www.kommersant.ru/doc/6312703https://) с нехваткой мест на городских общественных кладбищах. Материал показал, что на одном из крупнейших кладбищ города, Гусинобродском, сектор на примерно 370 захоронений был отдан под тела погибших бойцов ЧВК "Вагнер", что, очевидно, повлияло на общий дефицит мест на территории муниципалитета. Также этот проект показал, что в более чем десятке случаев родственники захороненных бойцов не знали об их месте погребения — один из интерактивных элементов материала позволяет найти имя своего родственника в случае его пропажи.
2024-s-0187.summaryJa: このプロジェクトは,ウクライナのバフムート市周辺の戦闘に参加した"バグナー"民間軍事会社の傭兵について,最も詳細な情報を提供し,2022年初頭,ロシア東部最大の傭兵埋葬の都市墓地の一つに埋葬された. プロジェクトでは,葬られた人の個人情報,そして戦争に徴兵される前に住んでいた地域について説明し,また,ノボシベリア地方当局と"ワグナー"中毒局の指導による死者葬儀の実践を記述する.
2024-s-0187.impactJa: プロジェクトが発表されたのは,都市公共墓地での場所不足が起きた時でした. 資料によると,都市最大の墓地の一つであるグシノブロドスクの370の墓地に約370の墓地が"Ваグナー"CVD戦士の遺体に譲られたことが示され,明らかに,市内での席の総不足に影響を与えた. このプロジェクトでは10件以上で葬られた兵士の親戚が葬られた場所を知らなかったことが示されていますインタラクティブな素材の1つで遺族が失踪した場合の親戚の名前を発見することができます

2024-s-0188.summary: A passagem para o ensino superior é um momento muito importante para milhares de alunos todos os anos. Mas também é um momento em que muitas famílias fazem um esforço económico enorme para conseguir que os seus filhos possam estudar no curso e na universidade que desejam. Com o aumento do custo da habitação em Portugal, quisemos criar uma ferramenta que possibilite a todos estes estudantes calcular uma estimativa desses custos.
2024-s-0188.impact: Num ano em que a dificuldade sentida pelos estudantes para encontrar alojamento a preços acessíveis voltou a ser um grande tema na agenda noticiosa do país, este trabalho deu aos novos universitários (e não só) uma forma rápida e simples de estimar o orçamento mensal necessário para conseguir ir estudar para uma nova cidade. Esta ferramenta permitiu aos jovens não só ganhar uma noção do esforço económico necessário para a nova etapa académica, mas também ajustar o orçamento e a procura às suas capacidades e necessidades. Possibilitou ainda procurar formas de economizar dinheiro ao comparar várias simulações.
2024-s-0188.tools: Personalisation, Scraping, D3.js, Json, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, R, RStudio, Svelte
2024-s-0188.authors: Rui Barros e José Volta e Pinto
2024-s-0188.summaryJa: 高等教育への移行は毎年何千人もの学生にとってとても重要な時期ですしかし多くの家庭が子供が望むコースや大学に学ぶために膨大な経済的努力をしている時期でもあります住居コストが上昇しているポルトガルではこれらの学生全員にそのコストを推定できるようにするツールを作りたいと思いました
2024-s-0188.impactJa: 学生が安価な住居を見つけるのに苦労していることでまた全国ニュースで話題になった年この研究は新卒 (だけでなく) 新卒に新しい都市へ学べるために必要な年間予算を迅速かつシンプルに計算する方法を与えてくれましたこのツールによって,若者は新しい学期に必要な経済的努力を理解できるだけでなく,予算や需要を能力とニーズに合わせて調整できるようになり,様々なシミュレーションを比較することでお金を節約する方法を探る事が可能になりました.

2024-s-0189.summary: This interactive puts the audience in the driver’s seat from the jump, using scrolly telling to walk users through a graphic that they will later use to explore housing affordability in their areas of interest. With housing affordability at its lowest level in the United States since 1996, this piece explores the index from Goldman Sachs in a consumer-friendly and digestible way.
2024-s-0189.impact: With housing affordability at its lowest level in the United States since 1996, this piece explores the index from Goldman Sachs in a consumer-friendly and digestible way. At the end, the audience can use their new knowledge of the index to check out affordability in areas across the US.
2024-s-0189.tools: Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, ArcGIS
2024-s-0189.authors: oReporting and data analysis: Janie Boschma and Renée Rigdon oDevelopment: Byron Manley oIllustration: Alberto Mier oEditors: Anna Brand and Lucy Bayly
2024-s-0189.summaryJa: このインタラクティブは,視聴者を運転席に飛び降りて,スローリー・ストーリーを使って,ユーザーが興味のある地域における住宅価格の利用率を探索するために使用するグラフを歩みていく.この作品は,1996年以降,米国で最も低い水準の住宅価格で,ゴールドマンサックスからの指数を消費者に便利で消化可能な方法で探査します.
2024-s-0189.impactJa: 住宅の手頃な価格が1996年以降米国で最も低い水準にあるこの作品はゴールドマンサックスによる指数を消費者に便利で消化可能な方法で探求する.最終的に,視聴者は指数に関する新しい知識を使用して,米国全域の地域での手頃な価格を確認することができます.

2024-s-0190.summary: As the cost of what’s in our grocery store cart grows, the products themselves are shrinking. This is what we know now as shrinkflation. We have identified dozens of products whose format has declined over the years. Our main project is the first and only database of shrinkflation in Canada. This crowdsourcing project is part of a vast file on shrinkflation, broken down into almost a dozen additional articles to allow readers to better understand the phenomenon and grasp its extent across the country.
2024-s-0190.impact: Our crowdsourcing project was a success: we received more than 350 emails from readers, submitting us examples, sharing observations on the phenomenon or even sending us suggestions for themes to push our file further away. More than 600 examples of products were also submitted via an online form. The file was so far-reaching that some of it was even translated into English by CBC. Other media also picked it up. It also benefited from great visibility on radio and television for a digital piece. Our file also made it possible, with its complementary articles, to expose other issues associated with shrinkflation: foods which become taxable in a smaller size and overpackaging, or misleading packaging, sometimes also associated with shrinkflation. It also revealed a new aspect of the phenomenon: skimpflation, when companies reduce the quality of their products, rather than the size, but also to save costs. A few months after the deployment of all of our articles, the Canadian government even announced that it would strengthen the capacity for action of the Office of Consumer Affairs, with a Working Group on grocery stores responsible in particular for ''highlighting practices harmful to consumers'', such as ''shrinkflation'' and ''skimpflation''.

2024-s-0191.summary: _You Are What You Watch_ is a book written by Pulitzer-prize winning data journalist Walt Hickey that takes a data-driven dive into how pop culture affects everything, and has a meaningful and measurable impact on the people who watch it. Based on innovative pop culture data analysis techniques by Hickey and containing over 100 charts and data visualizations from illustrator Heather Jones, the book argues that pop culture can change viewer's physiology and psychology, can produce all sorts of societal and individual changes in viewers, and can have ramifications across the world.
2024-s-0191.impact: The book, released in October 2023, was a top-selling item in television, film, and pop culture books upon release, and gained positive reviews from Publisher's Weekly and Vox and excerpts in Polygon and Business Insider. The book also gained starred reviews from Library Journal and Book Page. Beyond the positive reception for the book, it's inspired conversation about the intersection of pop culture coverage and data journalism, and much of the data collected and created for the book is being published for use in academic and journalistic settings.

2024-s-0191.authors: Walt Hickey, author Heather Jones, illustrator

Hickeyによる革新的なポップカルチャーデータ分析技術に基づいて,イラストレーター Heather Jonesからの100以上のチャートとデータビジュアライゼーションを含む本では,ポップカルチャーが視聴者の生理学と心理学を変え,視聴者の社会や個人の変化をあらゆる形で生み出せ,そして世界中に影響を与える可能性があると主張しています.

2024-s-0194.summary: The project consists of a social media post, with 8 images that illustrate in infographics the data from the publication PNAD Contínua - other forms of work 2022, from IBGE. By demonstrating data on the performance of unpaid work in Brazil, the research provides an overview of the time dedicated to carrying out care activities, household chores, voluntary work and production for one's own consumption. The data highlighted in the post point out some of the main differences in dedication to these jobs by gender, color or race, age group and region of the country.
2024-s-0194.impact: The issue of "invisible work", which is unpaid and is often not even seen by those who do not perform it, is increasingly part of the public agenda, especially regarding domestic chores and personal care, which tend to fall more on the shoulders of women than of men. This post gives visibility to data from the main IBGE survey on work and income (PNAD Contínua), which elucidates the issue of unpaid work, based on the time dedicated to carrying out these activities by people aged 14 or over in the country. Among the social networks on which IBGE published the post, the greatest reach was on Instagram (14,500 accounts reached and 1,760 interactions on the first day - 08/23/23). With the ENEM (National Secondary Education Examination), in November, the subject of unpaid work gained even more relevance in the public debate, as it was the topic requested in the essay of the test, including the citation of a previous edition of PNAD Contínua in the reference materials for preparing the writing. From this new highlight, our post on Instagram started to resonate again, having currently (01/17/24) a reach of 24,600 accounts and 4,125 interactions.

2024-s-0197.summary: The TV program "Ongehoord Nieuws" (by Omroep ON!) has been airing on public television since the beginning of 2022. Even before the first broadcast, there was a lot of discussion about how this new broadcasting organization would shape its journalistic programming. And after about 80 episodes, it became clear that all the concerns beforehand were justified: "Ongehoord Nieuws" systematically spreads false and biased information, and in some cases, unfounded and harmful conspiracy theories. We have investigated this through data analysis of all subtitle files, facial analysis, and interviews with former employees.
2024-s-0197.impact: Metrics: the investigation was well read: nearly 23k readers, and over 44k visitors who stayed on the page for 3 minutes on average which is quite long compared to our other publications. The story was news in many other nationwide media such as newspapers, both in the Netherlands and in Flanders. It was well received in particular by fellow journalists who praised the publication for its level of detail. Readers felt that they finally had an overview of Ongehoord Nieuws that surpassed the anecdotal criticism that was written about the organization up till then.

2024-s-0199.summary: O ano de 2023 foi marcado por inúmeros recordes climáticos. Tantos que, a certa altura, noticiar um novo recorde passou a ser apenas mais uma nota de rodapé na agenda mediática. A propósito da COP28, quisemos mostrar aos nossos leitores efectivamente como o mundo tem mudado num período tão curto de tempo. Para isso, desafiámos os leitores a introduzir a sua data de nascimento e a descobrir como o mundo mudou desde que por cá estão.
2024-s-0199.impact: O trabalho é mais um exemplo da diferença entre dizer que as alterações climáticas estão aí e mostrar que as alterações climáticas estão aí. Oferecendo um simples mecanismo de personalização, vários leitores - especialmente mais novos - mostraram-se espantados com a forma como, num curto espaço de tempo, alguns indicadores evoluíram de forma tão acelerada, quase sempre na negativa. Não optando por uma linguagem alarmista sobre as alterações climáticas, é, também, na nossa opinião, um exemplo de como o scrollytelling e a personalização de narrativas por via dos dados pode ter uma força muito grande para comunicar temas complexos como este.

2024-s-0200.summary: Why do Russians support the war against Ukraine and what role does Russian propaganda play in this? This was the central question of the data-driven project that analysed over 3 million articles by Russian state news agency RIA Novosti. The research focused on contextual paragraphs, known as “boilerplates”, that the Russian state media uses to frame world events in a specific light, namely by creating an image of Ukraine as the enemy. By using data-based storytelling, we show how propaganda has been preparing Russians for the war since 2014 — and the methods it used to adapt to the changing reality.
2024-s-0200.impact: The project was successful for both media outlets involved. In terms of clicks, together we reached over 30,000 people in the first three weeks (in equal measure for the German and Russian versions, we only recently published the English version). We have received a lot of positive feedback from the journalistic and scientific community, both for the text and its content as well as for its structure. Our rather risky use of Graph, a form of visualisation that is rarely used in journalism, paid off too. “Graphics display an appreciation for the scale of the propaganda machine,” as one of our readers put it. The reviews are already in from our readers: “Impressive research, finely prepared”, “absolutely superbly done”, “incredibly good design“, “an excellent example of data journalism”. What is more, we even got feedback from RIA Novosti itself: the head of RT, a RIA-affiliated propaganda outlet, Margarita Simonyan, shared our research on her social media, adding “We're on the right track, team!”. Well, we seem to have hit a nerve. We will shortly be investigating whether our publication also had an influence on the work of RIA Novosti.

2024-s-0200.summaryJa: ロシアがウクライナに対する戦争をなぜ支持するのか? ロシアのプロパガンダがこの中でどのような役割を果たしているのか? これは,ロシア国家報道機関RIA Novostiが300万以上の記事を分析したデータ主導プロジェクトの中心的な質問でした. この研究は,ウクライナが敵であるイメージを作り出すことで, ロシアの国家メディアが世界イベントを特定の光で枠組みするために使用する"ボイラープレート"として知られる文脈上の段落に焦点を当てました. データベースのストーリーテリングを使って 2014年以降宣伝がロシアを戦争に備えている方法や変化する現実に適応するために使った方法を展示します
2024-s-0200.impactJa: プロジェクトには参加したメディアが成功しましたクリックの数目では,3週間以内に3万人以上の人を集めました (ドイツ語とロシア語版では同じ程度ですが英語版は最近出版しました) 文本や内容や構造の両方からジャーナリズムと科学界から多くのポジティブなフィードバックを得ましたグラフのリスクの高い利用はジャーナリズムではほとんど使えませんグラフは宣伝機の規模を評価していますレビューは既に読者の意見です印象的な研究,精巧な準備, 絶対的に素晴らしいデザイン, 信じられないほど良いデザイン, データのジャーナリズムの優れた例です RIA Novostiの情報源であるRTの責任者マルガリータ・シモンヤンはソーシャルメディアで調査をシェアしチーム! チーム! チームを正常に走らせていると報告しました

2024-s-0201.summary: In September 2023, LAist, APM Research Lab, and The California Newsroom co-published the article California Nursing Homes Are Becoming ‘De Facto Mental Health Centers’ after a months-long investigation. The article found the state may be in violation of federal law, revealing the number of residents with serious mental illness (SMI) in California nursing homes and demonstrating the dangers to residents with SMI and the broader impact on health care quality and access.
2024-s-0201.impact: Within a week of publication, our investigation in California drew more than 30,000 pageviews, and an associated Instagram post reached more than 400,000 people (about half the population of Delaware). Both are well above the interest levels typically generated by stories or posts by either LAist, APM Research Lab, or The California Newsroom. Additional impact includes: The office of Assembly Member Jim Wood, Chair of the 2nd Assembly’s Health Committee in California, reported that they have read the story with interest and are asking questions of the oversight committee. Toby Ewing, executive director of the state’s Mental Health Services Oversight and Accountability Commission, told us about our data findings: "You've done more work on this probably than the state of California has done,” and that the state should be tracking this information. Disability rights advocates said the story shed important light on how the mental health care system has failed Californians and informed us that the story was spreading in their network. The San Diego public radio station KPBS is interested in building on our work; we met with them to explain more about what we found and have shared our data with them.
2024-s-0201.tools: Coding in R studio and the mapping platform
2024-s-0201.authors: **LAist** Elly Yu, Investigative Reporter Megan Garvey, Executive Editor Brian Frank, Editor, Digital and Special Projects Dan Carino, Senior Designer (illustrations) Samanta Helou Hernandez, Visual Journalist (photos) Kristine Malicse, Social Media Producer David Rodriguez, Partnership Producer **APM Research Lab** Elisabeth Gawthrop, Data Journalist Craig Helmstetter, Managing Partner **The California Newsroom** Mike Kessler, Investigations Editor Adriene Hill, Managing Editor Emily Zentner, Investigative Data Journalist **Additional Assistance** Sherri Hildebrandt, Copy Editor
2024-s-0201.summaryJa: 2023年9月,LAist,APM研究ラボ,およびカリフォルニアニュースルームは,数カ月間の調査の後,カリフォルニア看護施設が"事実上の精神保健センター"に変わっている"という記事を共同で発表した.この記事は,州が連邦法違反している可能性があることが判明し,カリフォルニアの高齢者ホームにおける深刻な精神疾患 (SMI) のある住民の数を明らかにし,SMIを有する住民に対する危険性および医療品質とアクセスへの広範な影響を示した.
2024-s-0201.impactJa: 公開後1週間以内にカリフォルニア州での調査は3万件以上のページビューを集め,関連したインスタグラム投稿は400,000人を超える人に (デラウェア州の人口の約半分) 届きました.どちらもLAist,APM研究ラボ,またはカリフォルニアニュースルームの記事や投稿によって通常生成される関心レベルよりもはるかに高い. 加えて影響は次のとおりです 2 番目の議会の健康委員会議長ジム・ウッドの事務所は,この記事を興味を持って読み,監督委員会に質問していると報告しました. 州精神衛生サービス監督と説明責任委員会の執行長トビー・エウイングは,データ調査結果についてこう語った. "カリフォルニア州よりも多くの研究が行われた可能性があり,州はこの情報を追跡すべきだ.障害者権利擁護者は,この話は精神衛生保健システムがカリフォルニアの人々をどのように失敗させたかを重要な光を投げると伝え,その物語が彼らのネットワークで広がっていると告知しました. サンディエゴの公営ラジオ局KPBSは私たちの活動を発展させたいと考えています. 私たちは発見した内容について詳しく説明するために彼らと会って,データも共有しました.

2024-s-0202.summary: During the two years of the full-scale invasion, Russia has managed to harvest more than 10 million tons of wheat from the occupied territories. This is roughly equal to the annual output of an entire country, such a as Romania. TEXTY tells how the aggressor country steals grain and to whom Russia sells it. We used data from agriculture business and combined it with the information from open sources. It formed the basis for AI models training. Satelite images helped us to determine the areas of fields of different crops and find out how many crops were stolen by Russia.
2024-s-0202.impact: The project got sensational effect in Ukraine, due to two factors: (1) the investigation was done by Ukrainian media with its own methodologybased on satelite imagery, (2) figures on stolen grain are supported by visualisation that clearly shows which fields were occupied and how the frontline makes tillage impossible. Several Ukrainian mainstream media made news on the project (at least 16), as well international community was interested in project (at least 13 in English and Spanish detected). Significant impact done on **agriculture community** in Ukraine: many assosiations and business journals made publications. Key project results [were published](https://reliefweb.int/report/ukraine/local-economist-ukraine-country-office-monthly-economic-bulletin-research-assessment-and-monitoring-november-2023) in the **UN World Food Program** Monthly Economic Bulletin. The project got significant audience engagement in **social media** - about 140,000 mainly in Facebook and Twitter. Also **professional community** noted the publication: GIJNetwork named among best projects of Nov,23; Ukrainian StratcomCener made publication in Twitter, other journalists marked and reposted the project.
2024-s-0202.tools: AI/Machine learning, Scraping, QGIS, Adobe Creative Suite, Python, ai2html, Satellite imagery
2024-s-0202.summaryJa: 侵攻の2年間にロシアは占領地から1000万トンの多量の小麦を収穫した.これはルーマニアのような全国の年間生産量に相当する.TEXTYは侵略国がどのように穀物を盗むか,ロシアが誰に売るか教えてくれる.我々は農業ビジネスからのデータを利用し,オープンソースからの情報と組み合わせた.AIモデルトレーニングの基礎を形成した. 衛星画像は異なる作物の畑の面積を特定しロシアがどれだけの作物を盗んだかを調べました
2024-s-0202.impactJa: このプロジェクトは,ウクライナでセンサショナルな効果を得た.その理由は2つである. (1) 調査は衛星画像に基づく独自の方法論でウクライナメディアによって行われた. (2) 盗まれた穀物の数字は,どの畑が占拠されたかを明確に示す視覚化によってサポートされている. ウクライナのいくつかの主流メディアはプロジェクトについてニュース (少なくとも16),および国際社会がプロジェクトに興味を持っていた (少なくとも13件は英語とスペイン語で検出された). プロジェクト結果は (公開された) ** ** ** プロジェクトには ** ソーシャル・メディア** で重要な視聴者関与が獲得されました - 約140,000 人が主にFacebookとTwitterで. また **プロフェッショナルコミュニティ**は,公示を注視した: GIJNetworkはNov,23のベストプロジェクトの中で名付けられた.

2024-s-0203.summary: A reportagem produzida pela equipe do Estadão investigou os impactos do calor extremo na cidade de São Paulo, naquele que até então foi o dia mais quente do ano de 2023. A reportagem visitou pontos de grande fluxo de pessoas na Avenida Paulista - a principal da cidade - e nas imediações para medir a temperatura ambiente e a umidade relativa do ar.
2024-s-0203.impact: A reportagem teve um impacto significativo na conscientização pública sobre os impactos do calor extremo no nosso dia a dia. Os dados coletados pela reportagem mostraram de forma clara e objetiva como o calor pode afetar a vida das pessoas, especialmente em áreas urbanas e densamente populosas. Os dados coletados pela própria equipe mostraram que o calor extremo está se tornando mais frequente em São Paulo, uma tendência que está sendo observada em todo o mundo. Um outro aspecto de destaque é o fato dos dados principais da matéria terem sido produzidos pelos próprios jornalistas, permitindo mostrar o impacto direto do calor em diversos locais, visto que os dados oficiais não conseguem demonstrar com esta minúcia.
2024-s-0203.authors: Lucas Thaynan, Bruno Ponceano e Marcos Müller
2024-s-0203.summaryJa: 州立大学スタッフが作成したレポートは,2023年の最も暑い日に及ぶサンパウロ市における極端な熱の影響を調査した.このレポートは,市内主要地であるパウリストアベニューの大きな人流点と周辺の地域を訪れ,室温と相対的な気温を測定した.
2024-s-0203.impactJa: このレポートは我々の日常における極端な暑さの影響に対する公衆の意識に大きな影響を与えましたこのレポートで収集されたデータは,特に都市部や人口密集した地域における人々の生活に,暑がどのように影響を与えるかを明確に客観的に示しました. この研究チームはサンパウロで極端な暑が頻発していることを示しています. これは世界中で観察されている傾向です. 重要な点の一つはメディアが本人のデータで直接的に熱の影響を示すことができるという重要なデータです公式データでは微細なデータでは証明できません

2024-s-0204.summary: O projeto **Rota +Segura** é uma iniciativa jornalística baseada em dados de Segurança Pública do Estado de São Paulo, no Brasil. Desenvolvida por meio das tecnologias da ferramenta Mapbox, a reportagem permite que os leitores tracem rotas com menor incidência de roubos e furtos de veículos na capital paulista. A análise abrange o perfil do crime ao longo de 2022, considerando fatores como local do crime, perfil do roubo e região. Ao organizar dados fragmentados, a reportagem oferece uma visão detalhada da criminalidade, proporcionando uma compreensão direta do impacto no cotidiano dos leitores.
2024-s-0204.impact: Por proporcionar uma visualização acessível e simples das ocorrências de roubo e furto de veículos em São Paulo, a reportagem desenha o caminho do roubo de veículos em São Paulo. Além de fornecer métricas e insights sobre o crime, a reportagem influenciou diretamente a conscientização pública sobre a segurança no trânsito da cidade. O público agora pode tomar decisões informadas ao planejar seus deslocamentos, contribuindo para a melhor compreensão da dinâmica dos crimes. A originalidade da abordagem, utilizando um mapa interativo, ampliou o alcance da reportagem, tornando-a mais envolvente para os leitores e gerando um alto volume de acessos. O projeto também inspirou a comunidade que trabalha com dados a considerar soluções inovadoras para questões de segurança, destacando o papel do jornalismo na aplicação prática de dados para o benefício coletivo. A reportagem ganhou menção honrosa na categoria Visualização do Prêmio Cláudio Weber Abramo de Jornalismo de Dados - a maior premiação da área no Brasil.
2024-s-0204.tools: Personalisation, Scraping, Json, Google Sheets, OpenStreetMap, Python, Mapbox

2024-s-0204.summaryJa: プロジェクト **Rota +Segura**は,ブラジル州サンパウロ州の公衆安全のデータに基づくジャーナリズムのイニシアチブです.Mapboxツール技術によって開発された,レポートは読者にパウリスト首都における自動車盗難や盗難の少ない経路を描くことを可能にします.分析は,犯罪の場所,盗難のプロファイル,地域などの要因を考慮して2022年にわたる犯罪のプロフィールをカバーします. 断片的なデータを整理することで報道は犯罪を詳細に把握し読者の日常生活への影響を直接理解します
2024-s-0204.impactJa: 交通安全に関する市民の意識を直接影響し,市民が移動を計画する際に知情な意思決定をすることができるようになり,犯罪の動態をよりよく理解する手助けをします. インタラクティブな地図を用いたこのアプローチの独創性は報道の範囲を拡大し,読者への関与を高め,アクセス量を増やしましたこのプロジェクトはまた,データに関するコミュニティにセキュリティ問題への革新的な解決策を検討するよう刺激し, データの実践的な応用にジャーナリズムの役割を強調しました報道は,ブラジル最大のデータジャーナリズム部門であるクラウディオ・ウェバー・ブラブラーム・ジャーナリズム賞の視界賞で名誉に言及されました.

2024-s-0205.summary: In September 2022, seven months into the full-scale invasion of Ukraine, Vladimir Putin announced a “partial” mobilization in Russia. This decree not only summoned hundreds of thousands of men to war, but also led to amendments in the Criminal Code. Anticipating a large number of refusals, the State Duma immediately tightened most of the articles of the Criminal Code concerning crimes related to military service. We gathered and studied thousands of court cases, in order to learn how servicemen and mobilized soldiers fled the front lines and how they were punished for this.
2024-s-0205.impact: The project shed light on the drastic state of the Russian army in the second year of the war with Ukraine. It also allowed us to see some of the strategies Russian authorities and military command use in order to punish soldiers and threaten them into fighting the war. This, in turn, helped us formulate the most efficient tactics to avoid military service or receive the minimal punishment possible if a person has already been drafted. The project reached hundreds of thousands of our followers and was widely quoted by our colleagues, both in international and Russian independent media. This is an ongoing project, we monitor the court cases constantly and release updates on the statistics.
2024-s-0205.tools: D3.js, Json, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, Python
2024-s-0205.summaryJa: 2022年9月,ウクライナを全面的に侵略して7ヶ月後,プーチン大統領はロシアに"部分的な動員"を発表した.この令令は,何百万人もの男性を戦争に招き込むだけでなく,刑法改正にも繋がった.大量に拒否を予期し,国土はすぐに,軍事サービスに関連する犯罪に関する刑法条の大半を厳しくした. 軍人や動員された兵士が如何に戦線から逃れ,そしてそのために罰を受けたかを学ぶために何千もの裁判所の事例を集め,研究しました
2024-s-0205.impactJa: このプロジェクトではウクライナとの戦争2年目のロシア軍の激的な状況について明らかにしましたまた,ロシア当局と軍事司令部が兵士を罰し,戦争に脅かすために使う戦略をいくつか見ることができました. これは,軍隊を避けるために最も効率的な戦術を策定するのに役立ちました. プロジェクトには何百万人ものフォロワーがいて国際メディアやロシア独立メディアでも引用されていますこれは継続的なプロジェクトです私たちは裁判所の訴訟を絶えず監視し統計の更新を公開しています
