2024-s-0393.summary: This project tells and shows how Russian propaganda works on social networks in Kyrgyzstan. The material is based on the content of pro-Russian Facebook pages and Telegram channels. Based on the analysis, we were able to find out that their content is aimed at strengthening Russia’s influence on Kyrgyzstan. Also, we were able to find out that propagandists use various propaganda technologies, such as provocation, threat of war and others. We also found that Russia is against the rapprochement of Kyrgyzstan with Western countries. Propagandists also discredit the activities of independent media and non-governmental organizations.
2024-s-0393.impact: The project showed the audience how propaganda works and helped reveal the mechanisms of Russian propaganda. In addition, our readers were able to find out that Russian propaganda operates not only through television, radio and controlled media, but also through social media. The main effect can be said that the audience now carefully checks the information. In addition, other journalists learned what narratives Russian propaganda operates with. They also republished our project in their media platforms. Separately, we can mention the experts who use our project in their reports and publications.
2024-s-0393.authors: Cholponbek Sabyrbekov, Chynargul Jumabekova, Erkaym Asankanova, Guliza Urustambek
2024-s-0393.summaryJa: このプロジェクトは,ロシアによるソーシャルメディアの仕組みを説明し,示す.この資料は,ロシア支持的なFacebookページやテレグラムチャンネルの内容に基づいています.分析に基づいて,我々は,そのコンテンツが,ロシアがキルギズスタンに対する影響力を強化することを目的としていることを発見することができました.また,我々は,プロパガンダ家が挑発,戦争脅威など様々なプロパガンダ技術を使用していることを発見することができました. ロシアは,キルギススタンと西洋諸国との近接に反対していることも発見しました. 宣伝者もまた,独立したメディアや非政府組織の活動を誹謗中傷しています.
2024-s-0393.impactJa: プロジェクトでは,プロパガンダがどのように機能するか,そしてロシアのプロパガンダのメカニズムを明らかにするのに役立つことが示されました. さらに,私たちの読者は,ロシアのプロパガンダがテレビやラジオ,制御されたメディアだけでなく,ソーシャルメディアを通じても動作することを知ることができました.主な効果は,視聴者が情報を慎重にチェックしていると言えます. また,彼らは我々のプロジェクトをメディアプラットフォームで再公開しました. 別に,我々のプロジェクトをレポートや出版物で利用する専門家を挙げることができます.

2024-s-0394.summary: "Spain at Flood Risk" is a groundbreaking journalistic project uncovering a critical issue: over a million homes in Spain are situated in flood-prone areas. This investigation meticulously cross-referenced flood risk zones with the footprints of more than 12 million buildings across the country, revealing that at least 4.3% of Spanish homes face the imminent threat of river or sea flooding, with potential escalation due to climate change and increased torrential rains. The project exposes how the lack of regulations has facilitated urban development of thousands of homes in flood-prone regions nationwide.
2024-s-0394.impact: This journalistic project has made a significant impact by providing unprecedented access to a comprehensive map that details the vulnerability to flooding for every house and building in Spain. The primary goal was to offer this information as a public service, empowering public administrations, citizens, and the private sector. For example, potential homebuyers can now assess flood risks associated with a property, and city councils can make informed decisions about urban expansion based on flood-prone areas. The collaborative effort of the core investigative team and regional editions resulted in locally relevant stories that explored the causes and explained how some regions in Spain are living with the constant threat of floods and rising seas. The multifaceted approach, including a podcast episode, not only engaged the audience but also contributed to a broader understanding of the implications of flood risks. The impact is measurable through the project's wide-reaching viewership, with all publications of the project attracting over 275,000 users and securing a prominent position on the elDiario.es front page for three consecutive days. This initiative has not only informed and empowered individuals but has also set a benchmark for data journalism excellence in the field.
2024-s-0394.tools: Scraping, D3.js, QGIS, JQuery, Json, CSV, R, RStudio, OpenStreetMap
2024-s-0394.authors: Pau Rodríguez, Victòria Oliveres, Raúl Sánchez, Erena Calvo, Alba Camazón, Ana Ordaz, David Velasco, Nando Ochando, Clara Rodríguez
2024-s-0394.summaryJa: "スペインは洪水リスク"は,重要な問題を明らかにする groundbreaking ジャーナリズムのプロジェクトです. スペインの100万以上の家は洪水リスク地帯に位置しています. この調査は,気候変化と多大な暴風雨による潜在的拡大による,少なくとも4.3%のスペインの住宅が,川や海水の迫った脅威に直面していることを明らかにしています. プロジェクトでは規制の欠如が全国全土で洪水にさらされている地域の何千もの住宅の都市開発を促進した方法を明らかにしました
2024-s-0394.impactJa: このジャーナリズムのプロジェクトはスペインのあらゆる家や建物の洪水への脆弱性を詳細に説明する総合的な地図への前例のないアクセスを提供することで重要な影響を与えました例えば,潜在的な住宅購入者は現在物件に関連した洪水リスクを評価し,市議会は洪水発生傾向のある地域に基づいて都市拡大に関する知的な決定を下すことができます. 核心調査チームと地域版の共同努力により,原因を調査し,スペインのいくつかの地域が洪水と上昇する海の不滅な脅威とどのように生活しているかを説明した本地関連ストーリーが生まれました. 複数の側面のアプローチ,podcastエピソードを含む,視聴者を巻き込むだけでなく,洪水リスクの影響をより広く理解するのに貢献しました. 影響はプロジェクトの広範囲の視聴率を通じて測定可能であり,プロジェクトのすべての出版物で 275,000人以上のユーザーに魅了され, elDiario.es フォートページに3日連続で顕著な位置を確保しました. この取り組みは個人を情報化・エンパワーメントに貢献するだけでなくデータのジャーナリズムにおける卓越性の基準を確立しました

2024-s-0395.summary: How many people earn more and less than you? This innovative journalistic experiment uses data from 13 million tax declarations in an interactive calculator that allows hundreds of thousands of readers to discover their place on Spain’s salary scale, challenging preconceived notions. We analyzed reader responses, exposing the gap between perceived and actual income distribution. Our findings reveal a tendency for individuals to place themselves within the average, sparking a widespread public debate in income inequalities in Spain.
2024-s-0395.impact: The project wielded a powerful impact on public discourse, sparking a widespread debate on income inequality in Spain. With hundreds of thousands of readers using the salary calculator, the initiative became a viral sensation, prompting extensive discussions on social media. Thousands shared calculator screenshots, amplifying its reach organically. The personalized content allowed readers of all ages and regions across Spain to discover their actual salary positions, often yielding surprising revelations. Garnering over a half million visits, it emerged as one of elDiario.es's most-read articles of the year and a significant driver of new subscriptions. The interactive narrative that explains how a lot of readers are not aware that many people are paid very little using readers' responses illustrates the gap between perception and reality, improving the understanding of income distribution. These innovative strategies, including TikTok formats, contributed to the project's impact, expanding its influence. The journalistic experiment also wields significant influence on public opinion, as evidenced by academic studies illustrating how individuals shift their perspectives on public policies related to income redistribution, and contributes to shaping a more informed and nuanced debate of economic and social dynamics.
2024-s-0395.tools: Personalisation, D3.js, Canvas, JQuery, CSV, R, RStudio, Node.js
2024-s-0395.authors: Raúl Sánchez, Victòria Oliveres, Ainhoa Díez
2024-s-0395.summaryJa: この革新的なジャーナリズムの実験ではインタラクティブな計算機で 13百万件の税申告のデータを利用し何十万人もの読者がスペインの給料スケールで自分の位置を発見し先入観的な考えに挑戦しました私たちの発見は平均的な立場に置く傾向を示しスペインにおける所得格差に関する広大な公共議論を招いた
2024-s-0395.impactJa: このプロジェクトは公共の議論に強力な影響を及ぼし,スペインにおける所得格差に関する広範な議論を招いた. 給与計算機を使用する何百万人もの読者がいると,この取り組みはソーシャルメディアで広範な議論を促し,ウイルスに流出した. 何千人もの人々が計算機スクリーンショットを共有し,有機的にその範囲を拡大しました. パーソナライズされたコンテンツはスペイン全土のあらゆる年齢や地域の人々を現在の給料のポジションを発見させ,驚くような開示をもたらしました. 半百万件以上の訪問を得て,それは elDiario.esの年度で最も読まれた記事の一つであり,新しいサブスクリプションの重要なドライバーとして浮上しました. インタラクティブ・ナレーションで,多くの読者が読者の回答を利用してほとんど給料が支払われていないことを説明する. これは,知覚と現実の間のギャップを明らかにし,所得分布の理解を向上させています. TikTok形式を含むこの革新的な戦略は,プロジェクトの影響に貢献し,その影響力を拡大しました. ジャーナリズムの実験はまた,世論に大きな影響を与える. 経済的・社会的動力学に関するより知的な議論を形作るのに貢献している.

2024-s-0396.summary: This investigation presents increase the number of fires in most Egyptian governorates between 2011 and 2020, due to the increase in solid waste, which is not transported or disposed of properly for lack of enough garbage collection trucks, or enough fire engines that would be ready to intervene. This causes damage not only to the health of inhabitants living close to those garbage dump sites, but also creates a health hazard for all living creatures, and increases environmental pollution.
2024-s-0396.impact: After its publication, this investigation had an impact on Egyptian society. The Ministry of Local Affairs and Public Utilities issued a decision to implement a new mechanism to collect garbage and waste from public dumps in a much faster manner, to avoid or reduce the chances of it catching fire in the Egyptian streets. The Egyptian Parliament also issued a decision to refer a number of local leaders to investigate the mistakes that were committed and caused an increase in the number of fires inside Greater Cairo
2024-s-0396.tools: Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, R, OpenStreetMap
2024-s-0396.authors: An individual work I did on my own
2024-s-0396.summaryJa: この調査では2011年から2020年の間に,多くのエジプトの自治体で火災の数が増加し,十分なゴミ収集トラック,または介入準備ができている十分な消防機関が不足して,適切に輸送または廃棄されていない固い廃棄物の増加によるものを示しています. これはゴミ捨て場近くに住む住民の健康に被害を与えるだけでなく生物の健康に危険を及ぼすだけでなく環境汚染も増加します
2024-s-0396.impactJa: 地方事務局は,エジプトの街で火災を防ぐために,公共のゴミや廃棄物をはるかに速く収集する新しいメカニズムを導入する決定を下した. エジプト議会は,多くの地方指導者たちを派遣し,大カイロ内での火災の増加を引き起こした過ちを調査する決定を下した.

2024-s-0397.summary: “The Wheel of Inequality” is a journalistic investigation that exposes the intricate mechanisms that compose the cycle of inequality in Spain. This perpetual circle, echoing across generations, systematically limits the opportunities of families with fewer resources. Through dynamic data visualization and human-centric storytelling, our project explores the deep connections between one’s birthplaces, educational journey and socio-economic outcomes. Blending rigorous data analysis and traditional journalistic reporting, we delve into a complex web of challenges faced by those who were born in poor neighborhoods. From childhood to the labor market, we dived into the obstacles hindering upward social mobility.
2024-s-0397.impact: This journalistic project has made a significant impact by weaving a complex phenomenon into a cohesive narrative that explains all the factors that cut the opportunities of those born in poorest neighborhoods. It became one of the most read journalistic investigations of the year, attracting over 230,000 users and being among the top articles of the year with higher engagement times. Endorsed by thousands of positive comments and recognized by stakeholders, including members of the Spanish Congress and experts in social and educational inequality, the project started a widespread debate on meritocracy. It reveals the breakdowns in the social elevator and emphasizes how one’s initial conditions significantly influence the probability of ascending the social ladder. The use of clear and interactive data visualizations, shared by thousands, were combined with personal stories to humanize the statistics. Also, it offers access to a detailed street-level mapping of education inequality and income that allow readers to explore disparities in their own communities. An interactive calculator showed readers how their probabilities of reaching their educational level could have changed with a different family background.
2024-s-0397.tools: Personalisation, D3.js, Canvas, JQuery, Google Sheets, CSV, R, RStudio
2024-s-0397.authors: Raúl Sánchez, Victòria Oliveres, Ainhoa Díez
2024-s-0397.summaryJa: <unk>The Wheel of Inequality<unk>は,スペインにおける不平等のサイクルを構成する複雑な仕組みを暴露するジャーナリズムの調査です.この永久的な循環は,世代を超えて響き,より少ない資源を持つ家族の機会を体系的に制限します. ダイナミックなデータビジュアライゼーションと人間中心的なストーリーテリングを通じて,私たちのプロジェクトは,人の出生地,教育経路,社会経済的な成果との深いつながりを探求します. 厳格なデータ分析と伝統的なジャーナリズムのレポートを組み合わせ貧しい地域に住む人々が直面する複雑な課題の網に潜りました子どもの頃から労働市場まで社会的な移動を阻む障害に潜りました
2024-s-0397.impactJa: このジャーナリズムのプロジェクトは複雑な現象を統合した物語に織り込み貧しい近隣で生まれた人々の機会を割った要因をすべて説明することで重要な影響を与えましたこのプロジェクトは 230,000人以上のユーザーを引き寄せ高いエンゲージメント時間を持つ年度トップ記事の1つとなりましたスペイン議会のメンバーや社会教育不平等の専門家を含む多くの利益関係者によって認められ,メリトクラシーに関する広範な議論を始めました社会エレベーターの崩壊を明らかにし,最初の条件が社会梯子を上昇する確率に大きく影響する方法を強調しました統計を人間化するために,明確なインタラクティブなデータ可視化を使用し,数千人が共有しました. また,読者が独自のコミュニティにおける格差を調査できるようにする street-level mapping of education inequality and incomeへのアクセスを提供します. インタラクティブな計算機は,異なる家庭背景で,彼らの教育レベルに到達する確率がどのように変化したか読者に示しました.

2024-s-0398.summary: This series exposes the exploitation of legitimate migrant worker recruitment schemes, resulting in workers being bought and sold through human trafficking channels. Companies were shown to have used false documents to apply for quotas to import hundreds of migrant workers. By exploiting loopholes, the traffickers were able to bring in hundreds of workers, who end up jobless and starving in Malaysia. This series is unique because it shows a paper trail used by the traffickers and is able to trace in detail how the scheme works, and each level of pay off.
2024-s-0398.impact: The main article attracted more than 40,000 views in at least two languages, with engagement of at least two minutes. This far eclipses the average Malaysiakini article where readership is usually less than 5,000 per article. The reporting prompted parliamentary debates, and subsequent investigations from the Human Resources Ministry. This was amid outcry from stakeholders and pressure groups. Following the series, the Human Resources Ministry was also sacked. While we cannot claim full credit for the minister losing job, the evidence of poor management of migrant worker recruitment placed incredible pressure on him in the last months of his tenure. Police are also currently investigating the fraud, after companies whose names were fraudulently used in the scheme were alerted of this by Malaysiakini, and lodged police complaints. There is also a Labour Court case pending involving the workers involved. Malaysiakini is closely following the outcome.
2024-s-0398.tools: Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, Google Drive, Google Translate, Google reverse image, Yandex reverse image search, Adobe Acrobat, Whisper AI transcription, Google Meet, WhatsApp, Google Docs
2024-s-0398.summaryJa: このシリーズは,合法的な移民労働者募集の利用を暴露し,労働者が人身売買の通路で買取され売られていることを示した.企業が偽文書を使用して何百人もの移民労働者を輸入する配当を申請したことが示された. このシリーズは,麻薬密売者によって使用された紙の痕跡を示し,その仕組みや各レベルの報酬を詳細に追跡できるため,ユニークです.
2024-s-0398.impactJa: このレポートは,議会の討論,および Human Resources Ministryからの調査を促した. これは,利益関係者および圧力グループからの抗議のなかであった. シリーズの後, Human Resources Ministryも解雇された. 職を失った大臣の完全信用を主張できないが,移民労働者の採用管理が不十分だったという証拠は,彼の任期最後の数ヶ月で彼に信じられないほどの圧力を及ぼした. 詐欺事件の調査も現在進行中である.この計画で不正に名前が使われている企業がマレーシアキニによって警報され,警察に訴えた. ナイジェリアのマレーシアキニは結果を追跡しています.

2024-s-0399.summary: Through on the ground reporting and diligent tracing of disparate data, this project uncovers what appears to be a trend of baby snatching involving the most marginalised community in a state in Malaysia - the stateless indigenous people. By tracking the stories of at least four women, the project shows how this community is targeted for baby snatching and how their status puts them in a precarious condition when it comes to access to healthcare. It also shines a spotlight on the issue of statelessness, and through gamification, distils the complex bureaucracy and legal framework stopping indigenous people from obtaining citizenship.
2024-s-0399.impact: The series generated around 150,000 views. The article brings forth a really damning issue, which has gone unreported or hidden from the larger population. Since the publication of the article, it was confirmed by the relevant agencies that at least one of the children was taken away without consent from the mother. She was reunited with the child, but not permanently because the adoption was already finalised. Since the series was published, the issue has been debated in parliament as well as attracted attention from international human rights organisations who have engaged Malaysiakini as part of their move to further investigations and conduct advocacy on the matter. Malaysiakini was also approached by another media house to produce a documentary on the issue and is currently collaborating on this project. We’re also doing further reporting based on subsequent tip offs on the same issue, from insiders who read the report.
2024-s-0399.tools: Adobe Creative Suite, Google Sheets, Node.js
2024-s-0399.authors: S Vinothaa, Aidila Razak, Ooi Choon Nam, Affan Amrish, Basil Foo, Aedi Asri Abdullah, Low Choon Chyuan, Tan Hong Kai and Lee Weng Keat.
2024-s-0399.summaryJa: 報告を現場で行い,不平等なデータの密切な追跡を通じて,このプロジェクトは,マレーシアの州で最も疎外されたコミュニティーである無国籍の先住民を巻き込むような赤ちゃんの誘拐の傾向であると思われるものを明らかにします.少なくとも4人の女性の物語を追跡することで,このコミュニティが赤ちゃんの誘拐にどのように標的になっているか,そして彼らの地位が,医療へのアクセスを危ない状態に置いているかを示します. また,無国籍の問題にも注目し,ゲーム化を通じて,先住民が国籍を取得するのを阻止する複雑な官僚主義と法的枠組みを消化します.
2024-s-0399.impactJa: 記事では,本当に重大な問題が発生し,その件は報告されず,より大きな人口から隠されている.記事の公開以来,関係機関によって確認されたのは,少なくとも1人の子どもたちが母親の同意なしに連れ去られたこと. シリーズが公開されて以来,この問題は議会で議論され,また,この問題についてさらなる調査と擁護を行うための動きの一環として,マレーシアキニを巻き込んだ国際人権団体からの注意を集めました. We<unk>は,同問題に関する後回のヒントを参考に,報告書を読んだインサイダーからのさらなる報告も行っています.

2024-s-0400.summary: This project took a look at which panchayats (villages) in Kerala, a state in southern India, are hottest on average, and which ones have heated up most in the last 10 years. Because there aren't that many weather stations recording temperatures, satellite data was extensively used. Instruments named MODIS aboard two NASA satellites detect the radiation emitted by a surface, and from those readings, they estimate surface temperatures for every square kilometre of earth. The temperature for each square km within the territory of the panchayat is then taken and averaged to arrive at figures for the panchayat itself.
2024-s-0400.impact: To be honest, the project didn't really have that much of an impact. The [twitter thread](https://twitter.com/shijith/status/1628993778555170817) about the project got a little viral but that's about it. Other journalists did take notice of it, and the hope is that they'll be encouraged to switch to a code-only workflow and so make their findings more reproducible.

2024-s-0401.summary: This report explored how the implementation of the Union government's scheme to rescue and rehabilitate bonded labourers in India is not a priority for state governments. While in 2016 the Union government had said that it aimed to rescue 18.4 million bonded labourers by 2030, at the present annual average rate, it is estimated to achieve only 2% of the target. Many bonded labourers do not get their entitlements--financial and nonfinancial--due to weak enforcement of the scheme and delays in issuing release certificates which are needed to ascertain their bondage.
2024-s-0401.impact: Following my queries to the Chhattisgarh government on the lack of rehabilitation support for the workers rescued from Kushinagar in Uttar Pradesh, the state's labour department wrote to the Kushinagar's District Collector requesting them to share details so that rehabilitation procedures can be initiated. The case is ongoing and remains unresolved. I have forwarded the letter to an NGO that is working on the case. This story was republished on other media websites like Scroll and India Development Report.
2024-s-0401.summaryJa: この報告書では,インドにおける拘束された労働者を救出し,再建するための中央政府の計画が実施されるのは,州政府にとって優先事項ではないことを調査した.2016年に中央政府は,2030年までに1840万人の拘束された労働者を救えるという目標を掲げたが,現在の年平均率で目標の2%しか達成できないと推定されている. 多くの労働者が,制度の強制執行が弱くて,奴隷制の証明書発行が遅いため, 経済的・非経済的権利を得られない.
2024-s-0401.impactJa: シュチスガード政府に私が提問したユッサー・プラデシュのクシナガールから救出された労働者のリハビリテーション支援の欠如について,州の労働省はクシナガールの地区総裁に手紙を書いて,リハビリテーション手続きを開始するために詳細を共有するよう要請した.この事件は進行中であり,まだ解決されていない.私はこの事件に取り組んでいるNGOに手紙を送信した. この記事はスロールやインド開発報告書などのメディアウェブサイトで再刊行されました

2024-s-0402.summary: This eport is from the western coastal belt of Gujarat. During ground reports, I noticed small fishermen were very troubled. On investigating, I found out that sea fish were moving away from the shores. So is this an impact of climate change? My full report focused on this issue. As temperatures rise further, farmers will face more difficulties ahead. In the second report, we discussed the causes and challenges.
2024-s-0402.impact: After this report of mine, many journalists went to the coasts of Gujarat and tried to understand the problem of small fishermen. Before this, most of the news used to talk only about fishermen. But this news also attracted the attention of small fishermen
2024-s-0402.summaryJa: このエポートは,グジャラトの西海岸帯から来ました. 地上の報告では,小さな漁師が非常に不安を感じた.調査したときに,海上魚が海岸から離れていたことを知った.それで,これが気候変動の影響なのか?私の報告は,この問題に焦点を当てました.気温がさらに上昇するにつれて,農民はさらに困難に直面するでしょう.第2報告書では,原因と課題について議論しました.
2024-s-0402.impactJa: 私のこの報告の後,多くのジャーナリストがグジャラトの海岸に行き,小さな漁師の問題を理解しようとしました.それ以前,ほとんどのニュースでは漁師のみについて話していました.しかしこのニュースは小さな漁師の注意も引き寄せました.

2024-s-0403.summary: Including 30 journalists from 16 newsrooms, the “Forever Pollution Project” is a unique and innovative cross-border and cross-field investigation which provided an unprecedented evaluation of the contamination of Europe by “forever chemicals” and a public interest tool in the form of a free, online, interactive map. Also known as PFAS, these hazardous compounds do not degrade in the environment and will accompany humanity for thousands of years. Using ground-breaking methodology and innovative “expert-reviewed journalism”, the investigation revealed 20,000 contaminated sites, 21,500 sites presumed to be contaminated, and 230 known PFAS users across the continent.
2024-s-0403.impact: The Forever Pollution Project showed that “expert-reviewed journalism” can contribute not just to the information of the public, but also to scientific research and regulatory efforts. The project has catapulted PFAS into the news and public debate in many European countries. Pollution is, most of the time, as pervasive as it is invisible. With our map, we materialised the magnitude of PFAS contamination across the continent. From print to TV, radio and online, including big multimedia, scrollytelling projects, the team published over 80 stories in 12 countries. Our dataset, available in open source, has been used by dozens of journalists to investigate local sources of pollution and generate new knowledge. Major regulatory and scientific circles have solicited us to present our methodology in order to use it as a basis to investigate or remediate pollution, including the United Nations Environment Program (UNEP) and the European Commission, the Belgian Presidency of the EU in 2024. Valentina Bertato, a EU Commission official, publicly praised our project as “a huge achievement” and said the EU chemical strategy for sustainability, published in 2020, would have made “an even more compelling case of action on chemicals” had our data been available at the time.
2024-s-0403.tools: Scraping, D3.js, Canvas, Json, Adobe Creative Suite, Google Sheets, CSV, OpenStreetMap, Python, Node.js, MapTiler, Maplibre GL JS, Deck GL, Highcharts, Google Earth, Figma
2024-s-0403.authors: Stéphane Horel, Raphaëlle Aubert, Gary Dagorn, Luc Martinon, Stéphane Mandard, Thomas Steffen, Tim Luimes, Gianluca Liva, Elisabetta Zavoli, Sarah Pilz, Daniel Drepper, Catharina Felke, Johannes Edelhoff, Lea Busch, Sarah Wippermann, Ralf Wiegand, Nadja Tausche, Manuel Bewarder, Andrea Hoferichter, Eurydice Bersi, Ana Tudela, Antonio Delgado, Zuzana Vlasatá, Tiina Lundell, Rachel Salvidge, Leana Hosea, Ģederts Ģelzis, Maj-Britt Horlacher, Felicitas Flohr, Brigitte Alfter
2024-s-0403.summaryJa: 16つの新聞室から30人のジャーナリストを対象とした"Forever Pollution Project"は,ヨーロッパを"forever chemicals"によって汚染する例のない評価を提供したユニークな革新的な国境を越えた調査であり,無料のオンラインインタラクティブな地図の形で公益のツールである.またPFASとして知られるこれらの有害物質は環境に劣化せず,数千年間人類を伴い続ける. 革新的な方法論と革新的な専門家によるジャーナリズムを使って調査は20,000の汚染された場所,21,500の汚染された場所と大陸中の 230人の知られた PFASユーザを明らかにしました
2024-s-0403.impactJa: フォーエバー・ポロレーション・プロジェクト (Forever Pollution Project) は,専門家によるレビューによるジャーナリズムが,公衆の情報だけでなく,科学的研究や規制の取り組みにも貢献できることを示した.このプロジェクトは,PFAASを多くのヨーロッパ諸国におけるニュースや公共議論に転載させた.汚染は,ほとんどに見えないほど広範囲に広がっている.我々の地図で,大陸全体でPFAAS汚染の規模を現有化しました. 印刷からテレビ,ラジオ,オンライン,包括大型マルチメディア,スクロール・テッリングプロジェクトまで,チームは12カ国で80以上の記事を公開しましたオープンソースで利用可能なデータセットは,地元の汚染源を調査し,新しい知識を生み出すために数十人のジャーナリストによって利用されています. 規制や科学の主要な輪は,国連環境計画 (UNEP) と欧州委員会,ベルギー議長国連2024年を含む汚染調査や修復の基礎として利用するための方法論を提示するよう要請してきました. 化学品に関するEUの戦略は,その時点で我々のデータが利用可能であったら,さらに説得力のある化学品に関する行動案になっていただろうと,欧州委員会官員であるバレンティナ・ベルタトは公に我々のプロジェクトを"巨大な成果"と称した.

2024-s-0404.summary: Принято считать, что власть в Кыргызстане сменяема: за последнюю четверть века в стране уже правит шестой президент и сменилось более 30 правительств. Клооп усредненный портрет кыргызского чиновника высшего ранга. Но, как выяснил «Клооп», все эти годы в министерствах и ведомствах работают одни и те же люди. Многие из них ничем, кроме госслужбы, давно не занимались. У некоторых либо вообще нет практического опыта в отрасли, которую они возглавляют, либо он очень давний.
2024-s-0404.impact: Проект вызвал много комментариев от читатателей.
2024-s-0404.authors: Екатерина Резникова, Арууке Солтоной, Виктор Мухин, Евгения Дьякова, Лализа Уматова
2024-s-0404.summaryJa: クラオップは,高級のキルギズ公務員の平均的な肖像画である.しかし,クロオップは,この年,すべての米と省で同じ人々が働いていることを発見した.それらの多くは,政府以外の何にも長年取り組まなかった.
2024-s-0404.impactJa: このプロジェクトは読者のコメントを多く集めました

2024-s-0405.summary: The IRS possesses a vast resource that offers unique insight into stock trading: Every stock sale a person makes is reported to the agency. But the IRS doesn’t share that information with the Securities and Exchange Commission, which polices trading. ProPublica obtained records for a portion of the country’s wealthiest taxpayers, and performed an unprecedented analysis, revealing how top executives and investors make themselves wealthier through dubious means. The series “shows how pervasive insider trading is in our markets, exposes the myth that markets are fair,” said a leading insider trading academic, and “illustrates an appalling lack of enforcement.”
2024-s-0405.impact: In two of the stories, we revealed how dozens of high-level corporate executives have traded shares of their competitors and partners with exquisite timing. One focused on how the practice is prevalent in biotech and other healthcare enterprises. Experts called the practice an abuse that should be pursued by prosecutors and regulators. By making millions through trading on nonpublic information, executives could contribute to the perception that the stock market is rigged to benefit the privileged. The former chair of the SEC said that corporate officials shouldn’t be betting on competing companies at all. In another story, ProPublica analyzed a different stock-trading strategy of the ultrawealthy, which helps them save big on taxes. The reporting uncovered how billionaires like Steve Ballmer and Mark Zuckerberg were able to sidestep a century-old law that bars selling a stock to generate a tax loss and then immediately re-buying it. The article, which showed that wealth managers had devised a suite of products for just this purpose, had an immediate impact: Goldman Sachs said it would halt transactions like the ones described by ProPublica. Ballmer said he would amend his tax returns.
2024-s-0405.authors: Robert Faturechi, Ellis Simani, Paul Kiel, Jeff Ernsthausen, Mariam Elba, Lucas Waldron
2024-s-0405.summaryJa: 株式取引に関するユニークな洞察を提供する膨大なリソースが IRS にあります.個人が行うすべての株式売却は,機関に報告されます.しかし,IRSは取引を規制する証券取引委員会にその情報を共有しません.ProPublicaは,国の最も裕福な納税者の一部に関する記録を取得し,前例のない分析を行い,トップ幹部と投資家たちが疑わしい手段によってどのように裕福になるかを明らかにしました. シリーズでは市場におけるインサイダー取引がどれほど普及しているかを示し,市場が公平であるという神話を暴露し, リーダーなインサイダー取引学者が語った.
2024-s-0405.impactJa: バイオテクノロジーや他の医療機関でこの慣行がどのように普及しているかを中心に"つの報告が掲載されました.専門家たちはこの慣行を検察官や規制当局が追究すべき虐待と称した. 株式市場は特権者にとって有利なものであるという認識に貢献できる.SECの元議長は,企業関係者は競合企業に対して賭けるべきではないと述べた.別の記事では,ProPublicaは超裕福な人々の異なる株式取引戦略を分析し,税金を大きく節約するのに役立ちます. 報告書は,スティーブ・ボールマーやマーク・ザッカーバーグのような億万長者が,税金を失うために株を売ることを禁止する,そして直ちに再購入することを禁じた,一世紀前の法律を回避する方法について明らかにした.富管理者が,まさにこの目的のために製品セットを設計したことを示す記事は,すぐに影響を与えた.ゴールドマン・サックスは,ProPublicaが記述したような取引を停止すると述べた.

2024-s-0406.summary: The investigation documented the increasing trend of resorting to unilateral or half-matched stem cell transplantation procedures in Egypt, despite their low success rates and significant risks, including the potential for death and the emotional toll on families who lose their children, along with the involvement in substantial financial costs. Al-Araby website documented the inefficacy of this operation through 8 cases of patients who underwent it, with 7 cases died, while two others suffered severe complications preventing them from resuming their normal lives.
2024-s-0406.impact: The investigation has garnered strong reactions from the Arab and global public. Various news websites have republished and circulated it following the success and controversy it generated. The public and the families of patients in Egypt have called for an end to the loss of lives and the cessation of such operations, demanding accountability for those responsible.
2024-s-0406.tools: Personalisation, Scraping, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, the pictures Infograph the documents Audio recordings
2024-s-0406.authors: I am Suhad hassan elkhodary, the author and sole preparer of the investigation. But I would like to thank my colleague Ansar Abu Fara, who supervised the completion of the investigation over the course of months, so that it could be published on paper and electronically after much effort and hardship, and Professor Muhammad Azzam, head of the Investigations Department, who was enthusiastic about the project from the beginning.
2024-s-0406.summaryJa: 調査は,エジプトでは,低成功率と重大なリスクにもかかわらず,単面または半匹配の幹細胞移植手法を採用する傾向が増加し,その中には,子供を失った家庭における死亡の可能性と感情的負担,そして実質的な財政コストへの関与が含まれている. Al-Arabyのウェブサイトは,この手術の無効性を記録した. 8人の患者で手術を受け,7人が死亡し,他の2人が通常の生活を復元するのを妨げ,深刻な合併症に苦しんだ.
2024-s-0406.impactJa: 捜査はアラブとグローバル公衆から強い反応を集めました.様々なニュースウェブサイトは,それがもたらした成功と論争を伴い,それを再発行し,配布した.エジプトの公衆と患者の家族は,生命の損失を終わらせ,そのような操作を停止するよう呼びかけ,責任者に対する説明責任を要求した.

2024-s-0407.summary: In 2023, building on previous investigations into antiquities trafficking, ICIJ reporters and media partners published a series of stories about the Metropolitan Museum of Art. The Met was holding, then, at least 1,109 pieces that were previously owned by people who had been either indicted or convicted of antiquities crimes; 309 of those pieces were on display at the time. Additionally, fewer than half of the 1,109 relics had records describing how they left their country of origin. The Met is North America’s largest museum.
2024-s-0407.impact: Just days after ICIJ published its largest Met investigation in March, Manhattan prosecutors seized more than a dozen pieces linked to an Indian trafficking ring that ICIJ’s story had cited extensively. Later in the year, the Met returned several antiquities to their countries of origin, including 16 Khmer pieces that had been owned by a notorious art trafficker whom ICIJ had started writing about in 2021. The Met’s press release published at the time of the repatriation in December 2023 said those relics were the last Khmer pieces the Met held that were tied to Latchford. Additionally, just weeks after the publication of ICIJ’s March story, the Met pledged to hire a four-person team — led by a new “manager of provenance” — to root out suspect works among the Met’s many treasures, with a view to returning them to the countries from which they were looted. The Met also announced it would convene a panel of 18 art experts and curators to examine its policies and practices. The move signaled a profound change in how the museum approached the numerous claims of looting and trafficking in its collection.
2024-s-0407.authors: Spencer Woodman, Malia Politzer, Leo Sisti, Namrata Sharma, Shyamlal Yadav, Emilia Diaz-Struck, Karrie Kehoe, Jelena Cosic, Agustin Armendariz, Delphine Reuter.
2024-s-0407.summaryJa: 2023年に,古代品取引に関する以前の調査を基礎として,ICIJの記者およびメディアパートナーがメトロポリタン美術館に関する一連の記事を公開した.METは,以前,古代品犯罪で起訴されたまたは有罪判決を受けた人々所有していた少なくとも1,109件を保有していた.その当時,それらの作品のうち309件が展示されていた. さらに,1109 件の遺物の半分も少なくあり,その遺物は祖国を出て行った様子を記述しています.
2024-s-0407.impactJa: ICIJが3月に最大の調査を発表してから数日後,マンハッタン検察はICIJの物語が広く引用したインド人取引網に関連した十余件以上の作品を押収した.その年の後,METは2021年にICIJが書き始めた有名な芸術取引人の所有物であった16件を含むいくつかの古物品を原産国へ返還した. 2023年12月に帰国時に発表されたメトロの報道稿では,これらの遺跡はメトロがラッチフォードに縛られた最後のクメールの遺物であると述べました.さらに,ICIJ3月の物語が発表された数週間後,メトロは4人のチームを雇うことを約束しました. また,美術館は18人の芸術専門家やキュレーターのパネルを招集し,その政策と実践を調査すると発表した.この動きは,博物館がコレクションの大量に略奪と取引の主張を扱う方法に大きな変化を示した.

2024-s-0408.summary: Deforestation Inc. is a collaborative investigation that revealed how a lightly regulated sustainability industry overlooks forest destruction and human rights violations when granting environmental certifications. ICIJ found that over the last 25 years at least 340 companies in the forest-products industry were cited by government agencies and environmental groups for a wide range of destructive practices after auditors had already certified their operations and products as sustainable. Those companies were later accused of overharvesting old growth forests and other illegal logging practices, bribing forestry officials, importing wood products in violation of trade restrictions, and performing sloppy checks on suppliers.
2024-s-0408.impact: The investigation not only re-energized the global debate about greenwashing and deforestation, but it has alerted readers all around the world to the urgency of the crisis. And with that awareness came swift new measures to combat these practices. Following the project’s publication, EU lawmakers drafted new rules that would force companies to substantiate the “green claims” they use to market to European consumers. In the U.S., the Justice Department announced a new interagency task force to bolster efforts to identify, investigate and prosecute trafficking in timber linked to environmental and other crimes. In Canada, lawmakers called for an investigation into one of North America’s largest pulp and paper manufacturers, Paper Excellence. ICIJ and partners had uncovered hidden links between Paper Excellence and Asia Pulp & Paper, a Chinese-Indonesian forestry company that has long been accused of deforestation and human rights abuses.
2024-s-0408.tools: Scraping, D3.js, Json, Google Sheets, CSV, PostgreSQL, Python, Pandas library, Datashare (ElasticSearch, Tesseract OCR, Apache Tika), Discourse
2024-s-0408.authors: The investigation involved a total of 44 media partners in 28 countries. A list of all ICIJ team members and media partners is available here: https://www.icij.org/investigations/deforestation-inc/about-deforestation-inc-investigation/
2024-s-0408.summaryJa: 森林破壊と人権侵害を軽く規制されている持続可能性産業が環境認証を出す際には如何に無視しているかを明らかにした共同調査です ICIJは過去25年間で,少なくとも森林製品産業の340社が,政府機関や環境団体によって,すでに監査者が彼らの事業と製品を持続可能であると認定した後,幅広い破壊的な慣行のために引用されたことを発見しました. これらの企業は後に古い森林伐採や違法伐採の他の慣行を過度に伐採し,林業当局者に賄賂を賄うこと,貿易制限を違反して木製製品を輸入し,サプライヤーに怠慢なチェックを遂行したと非難された.
2024-s-0408.impactJa: この調査は,緑洗浄と森林伐採に関する世界的な議論を活性化させるだけでなく,危機の緊急性について世界中の読者を警告した.そして,この認識とともに,これらの慣行との闘いのための新たな措置が迅速に導入された.プロジェクトが公表された後,EU立法者は,企業に欧州消費者に市場を販売するために使っている"緑の主張"を根拠に強める新しい規則を策定した. 米国では,司法省が新しい機関間作業部部署を発表した.この組織は環境とその他の犯罪に関連した木材取引を特定,調査,起訴するための取り組みを強化する.カナダでは,立法者は北米最大のパルパと紙製造業者の一つであるペーパーエクセレンスについて調査を要請した. ICIJとパートナーが,長年にわたり森林伐採と人権侵害を非難されてきた中国とインドネシアの林業企業である,Paper ExcellenceとAsia Pulp & Paperの隠れたつながりを明らかにした.

2024-s-0409.summary: Cyprus Confidential details how Cyprus has helped finance Putin’s war on Ukraine, allowing his inner circle to shelter billions from the threat of European and U.S. sanctions. ICIJ’s analysis of more than 3.6 million files found nearly 800 companies and trusts registered in secrecy jurisdictions owned or controlled by Russians who were sanctioned by Western countries either after Russia’s annexation of Crimea in 2014 or Russia’s invasion of Ukraine. For more than a decade, an astonishing flood of Russian money has poured into Cyprus. Cyprus Confidential exposes this sprawling, secretive financial system.
2024-s-0409.impact: Immediately after Cyprus Confidential’s publication, 24 specialists from the FBI and FinCEN (the Treasury Dept.’s Financial Crimes Enforcement Network) were flown into Cyprus to assist with a government probe, which Cyprus President Nikos Christodoulides pledged to launch in response to the ICIJ project. “Everything that has come to light will be investigated,” Christodoulides said. “The reputation of our country, the credibility of our country, you understand, is crucial.” Cypriot officials and the country’s attorney general met at the presidential palace to discuss improving oversight of sanctions laws and improving future investigative work for sanctions cases. Meanwhile, EU lawmakers met in a parliamentary session called in direct response to Cyprus Confidential. They forcefully criticized Cyprus for its lax enforcement of sanctions against Russia and demanded loopholes in anti-money laundering systems be closed. And anti-corruption advocates at Transparency International released a statement urging Cypriot authorities to take decisive measures to weed out bad practices in the country’s financial services sector. In the six weeks since it was published, Cyprus Confidential has been written about in more than 4,000 news articles appearing in media outlets that reach hundreds of millions of people in dozens of countries.
2024-s-0409.tools: AI/Machine learning, Scraping, D3.js, Json, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, PostgreSQL, Python, Pandas library, Datashare (ElasticSearch, Tesseract OCR, Apache Tika), Discourse and ArgosTranslate.
2024-s-0409.authors: Journalists from the International Consortium of Investigative Journalists, Paper Trail Media, and 67 other media partners. In total, more than 270 journalists in 54 countries and one territory. A full list of journalists and media partners can be seen here: https://www.icij.org/investigations/cyprus-confidential/about-cyprus-confidential-investigation/
2024-s-0409.summaryJa: ICIJの360万以上のファイルの分析により,ロシアが2014年にクリミア併合やロシアがウクライナを侵略した後,ロシアが制裁を受けたロシア人によって所有または支配されている秘密の管轄権で登録されている800社近くが発見された. 10年以上も前から驚くべき量のロシアのお金が塞浦路スに流入しています塞浦路ス・コンフィデリアルはこの広範囲で秘密の金融システムを暴露しています
2024-s-0409.impactJa: サイバー・コンフィデリアル<unk>の発表直後,FBIとFINCEN (財務省金融犯罪執行ネットワーク) の24人の専門家が政府調査に協力するためにキプロスへ送られた.キプロス大統領はICIJプロジェクトに応じて開始すると約束した. <unk> 国の評判,国の信頼性は,あなた方が理解しているように,極めて重要です.<unk> キュプロス当局者と国の司法長官は,制裁法の監督を改善し,制裁案件の将来の調査を改善するために大統領府で会合した. サイバー政府はロシアに対する制裁を緩やかに執行しているため,強烈に批判し,マネーロンダリング対策システムの漏洞を閉鎖するよう要求した.そして,透明国際機関の反腐敗擁護者は,サイバー当局に対し,国の金融サービス部門における悪行を排除するために決定的な措置をとることを強く要求した声明を発表した. 出版後6週間でサイプス・コンフィデシャルは数十の国の何百万人もの人に届くメディアに掲載された 4,000以上のニュース記事で書かれています

2024-s-0410.summary: In partnership with two non-governmental organizations, the French newspaper Le Monde has exposed the key players (banks, corporations, states) backing projects called “carbon bombs”. These encompass 422 giant sites dedicated to the extraction of oil, gas and / or coal, which were cataloged in 2022 by a team of researchers. These massive fossil fuel deposits alone jeopardize humanity’s chances of limiting global warming to 1.5°C. An international media consortium has also published the results of this multifaceted investigation.
2024-s-0410.impact: This project was mentioned by dozens of French and international media outlets. It has circulated widely on social networks and within civil society, especially through influencers, activist blogs and associations. They called out the banks and operators we identified, especially the French companies BNP Paribas and TotalEnergies, using our revelations to strengthen a broader consumer movement advocating for holding accountable those involved in carbon bombs. NGOs such as Reclaim Finance have also leveraged this project to reinforce their call for transparency regarding data on actors implicated in carbon bombs. Our project’s data has also been used to support French Green Party MPs’ [request for a parliamentary inquiry](https://www.senat.fr/leg/exposes-des-motifs/ppr23-144-expose.html) into TotalEnergies' activities.
2024-s-0410.tools: AI/Machine learning, Scraping, D3.js, Canvas, Json, Adobe Creative Suite, Google Sheets, CSV, OpenStreetMap, Python, Node.js, Svelte, Protomaps, Maplibre GL JS, Deck GL, GSpread, Cursor
2024-s-0410.authors: Raphaëlle Aubert, Elsa Delmas, Léa Sanchez, Maxime Ferrer, Maxime Vaudano, Claire Gillet, Thomas Steffen, Grégoire Allix, Lou Welgryn, Oriane Wegner, Théo Alves Da Costa
2024-s-0410.summaryJa: フランス紙Le Mondeは2つの非政府組織と協力して銀行,企業,州が"炭素爆弾"と呼ばれるプロジェクトを支援する主要なプレーヤーを暴露しましたこれらのプロジェクトには石油,ガス,石炭の採掘に専念した422つの巨大サイトが含まれています. 研究者チームが2022年にカタログを付けました. これらの大規模な化石燃料貯蔵量は,地球温暖化を1.5°Cに制限する可能性を危害します. 国際メディアコンソーシアムもこの多面的な調査の結果を公表しました
2024-s-0410.impactJa: このプロジェクトはフランスと国際メディアの数十社が言及しましたソーシャルメディアや市民社会の中で特にインフレンサーや活動家のブログや団体を通じて広く広まりました彼らは我々が特定した銀行や事業者を呼び出し特にフランスの企業であるBNP ParibasとTotalEnergiesを呼び出し,我々の啓示を使って炭素爆弾に関与する人々を責任に追いつくためのより広範な消費運動を強化しましたプロジェクトのデータもフランス緑党議員を支援するために使用されました [議会調査の要請] (https://www.senat.fr/leg/exposes-des-motifs/ppr23-144-expose.html) into TotalEnergies' activities.

2024-s-0411.summary: During the 2022 Iran's Women, Life ,Freedom uprising, a series of mysterious gas poisonings, predominantly occurring in girl schools, garnered attention. Faced with a lack of credible information and amidst the Iranian government's attempts to conceal the incidents, this initiative undertook the task of daily data collection. Over the course of six months, the project compiled data on 409 schools with confirmed poisoning incidents.
2024-s-0411.impact: The information collected through this project has been widely referenced and utilized by reputable journalists, featuring in numerous reports. Notably, it was cited in an article published by The Nature Magazine and subsequently echoed in newspapers across Greece, Italy, and Spain. Several peer-reviewed scientific journals also acknowledged and incorporated the data and information collected by this initiative. Additionally, Persian-language news outlets such as Radio Farda published a couple of articles providing descriptions and analyses of the data collected through this project. The project ensured daily data updates at the school-level, offering a comprehensive dashboard for data visualization. This dashboard garnered significant attention on social media, becoming a valuable tool for tracking the situation in Iran during that period. The project website hosts a comprehensive list of all news reports and scientific papers grounded in the data collected.

2024-s-0411.impactJa: このプロジェクトを通じて収集された情報は,多くの報道で紹介され,評判の高いジャーナリストによって広く引用され,利用されています.特に,それはThe Nature Magazineが発行した記事で引用され,その後ギリシャ,イタリア,スペインの新聞に回響しました.いくつかのピアレビューの科学雑誌も,このイニシアチブによって収集されたデータと情報を認識し,組み込みました. また,ファルダラジオなどのペルシア語報道機関も,このプロジェクトを通じて収集されたデータの説明と分析を提供する記事をいくつか掲載しました.このプロジェクトは,学校レベルで毎日データ更新を保証し,データビジュアライゼーションのための包括的なダッシュボードを提供しました.このダッシュボードは,その期間中にイランの状況を追跡するための貴重なツールとなり,ソーシャルメディアで重要な注目を集めた. プロジェクトウェブサイトには,収集されたデータに基づくすべてのニュースレポートと科学論文の総合リストが掲載されています.

2024-s-0413.summary: The investigation attempts to reveal the extent of the impact of malnutrition on Egyptian children under the age of five, the number of injured, the map of the spread in the governorates of the Arab Republic of Egypt, how inflation has affected the dietary pattern of Egyptians, the extent of its impact on children and newborns, and whether government health initiatives have contributed to reducing the rates of malnutrition in children. And what preventive methods should be followed to maintain the health of children.
2024-s-0413.impact: There was a strong interaction from the public with the investigation, especially as it monitors the nutritional status among children, which is what many Egyptians suffer from, and they are trying to find solutions to malnutrition among their children, demanding that the Egyptian government have a treatment for children that contributes to reducing infection rates. In addition, a doctor specializing in malnutrition diseases relied on the results of the investigation, in order to work on it in a study on the map of the prevalence of malnutrition in the Arab Republic of Egypt, with a research team at Yale University.

2024-s-0414.summary: There are thousands of small and large glaciers in our country. This water is also used to generate electricity. But in 70 years we have lost 16% of glaciers. In this project, our team tried to show the impact of melting glaciers and global warming on the energy system of Kyrgyzstan. The country's energy system is most dependent on hydroelectric power plants, which depend on the volume of water to operate. We were able to reveal that melting glaciers negatively affects energy production.
2024-s-0414.impact: Our project helped our readers find out the reasons for the problems in the energy sector in the country. The public, in the comments under the publication, began to share their ideas for preserving glaciers and reasonable energy consumption. In addition, we managed to interest that part of the audience that had previously remained passive. Now more people are interested in the problem of the energy system and the preservation of glaciers. To this we can add the fact that after the publication of our project, this topic began to be addressed more by responsible persons in the form of officials. And the president began to pay more attention to this problem and made a speech about strengthening measures to preserve glaciers at the One Planet Polar Summit in Paris.
2024-s-0414.authors: Cholponbek Sabyrbekov, Chynargul Jumabekova, Erkayim Asankanova, Guliza Urustambek

2024-s-0415.summary: “Smoke, Screened” is an investigative series by NPR's The California Newsroom, MuckRock and the Guardian on the large environmental impact of a little-noticed deregulatory tool found in the Clean Air Act. The provision in the Clean Air Act has allowed the Environmental Protection Agency to strike pollution from clean air tallies in more than 70 counties, enabling local regulators to claim the air was cleaner than it really was for more than 21 million Americans. The loophole allows regulators to forgive pollution, and avoid costly cleanup work, caused by “natural” or “uncontrollable” events, including wildfires.
2024-s-0415.impact: Within a month of our series publication, we collaborated with a freelance journalist for the Chicago Tribune who used our data and documents to find that dozens of states in the Midwest and beyond were discussing the possibility of banding together to file the largest exceptional events application ever. In response to our findings, Democratic congresswoman Rashida Tlaib, who represents Detroit, said that excluding data to say that the air is clean is a “disservice to the public and the community.” And in California, Michael Benjamin, the chief of the state’s air-quality planning and science division, told us that the state will continue to use exceptional events rule in the face of increasing wildfires because it may be the only thing that allows parts of the state to meet EPA standards. In response to our investigation, the EPA acknowledged the changing landscape of wildfire pollution and sources inside the agency said officials are planning to convene several regional and state air agencies with a group of atmospheric scientists in early 2024 to discuss major changes to the exceptional events rule.

2024-s-0416.summary: "Atomic Fallout" is an ongoing collaboration between The Missouri Independent, MuckRock and The Associated Press involving thousands of pages of previously-unreleased government records obtained through the Freedom of Information Act. They show radioactive waste from the Manhattan Project was known to pose a threat to people living in North St. Louis County as early as 1949. But federal officials repeatedly wrote off potential health risks off as "slight," "minimal" or "low-level."
2024-s-0416.impact: The reaction from federal and Missouri state lawmakers to "Atomic Fallout" was swift. Within days, Sen. Josh Hawley, R-Missouri, and Rep. Cori Bush, D-Missouri, pledged action, calling the investigation “devastating” and decrying the federal government’s “negligence." The U.S. Senate, with bipartisan support, narrowly voted in late July to expand a program that compensates Americans who become ill because of exposure to radiation from the country’s development and testing of nuclear weapons and the buildup to the Cold War. Senators attached the legislation to the annual defense bill; it was ultimately stripped out of the final version of the legislation after the Congressional Budget Office estimated it would cost $147 billion over a decade. Still, legislators and affected families in seven Western states are vowing to reintroduce legislation to extend and expand the federal radiation compensation program in 2024 and a flurry of pre-filed bills in Missouri would increase state funding for a victims’ compensation fund, citing our reporting. And the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers announced in January that it would install signs along the waterway warning people of the risks — more than 70 years after workers first realized barrels of radioactive waste were left nearby.

2024-s-0416.impactJa: 連邦議会とミズーリ州議会の"原子炉崩壊"に対する反応は迅速であった.数日以内に,ミズーリ州共和党の上院議員ジョシュ・ホーリーとミズーリ州民主党の議員コリー・ブッシュは,調査を"破壊的"と非難し,連邦政府の"怠慢"を非難した. 議会は7月下旬に両党支持で,国の核開発や核実験,冷戦の拡大により放射線にさらされたアメリカ人に病気になった米国人を補償するプログラムを拡大する投票を行いました.上院議員は,年間国防法案に立法を添付した.議会予算局が10年間で147億ドルを費用がかかると推定した後,最終的に法案の最終版から取り除かれた. それでも西部の7州の立法者や影響を受けた家族は 2024年に連邦放射線補償プログラムを延長し拡大する法案を再導入すると誓いますミズーリ州では被害者の補償基金への州資金を増やすことが予想されています陸軍エンジニア団は水路沿いに危険を警告するサインを設置すると 1月発表しました労働者が最初に放射性廃棄物の樽が近くに残されたことを認識してから 70年以上にわたり

2024-s-0418.summary: Migration between Search & Reality is a data-driven visual exploration that seeks to address a crucial question concerning the gap between the real experiences of global migrants and their aspirations, reflected in their Google search preferences. The pursuit of a magical comparison between data from the tangible reality and the virtual realm is of paramount importance. This data visualization project reveals intriguing trends for various countries, offering interactive visuals to delve into insights for selected nations among the 173 included on the list.
2024-s-0418.impact: Migration between Search & Reality is a data-driven visual exploration that is trying to quantify how big is the gap between the reality of the world's migrants and their dreams, interests, and desires that could be measured by their search interests. It is an attempt to draw a whole unified picture of the migration issue all over the world to have a better understanding of it and its related problems, such as migrants who get missed or die while they are trying to cross borders in an illegal way. The project is looking at the issue from both sides of it; countries of origin and countries of destination. The significant inquiry of this project revolves around the disparity between the actual experiences of global migrants and their aspirations, as mirrored in their Google search preferences. Achieving a magical comparison between data from the tangible reality and the virtual realm holds great importance not only on the strategic political aspects but on the humanitarian aspects as well.
2024-s-0418.authors: Team Concept, data collection, analysis, story, illustration, design & development **Mohamad Waked ~ Alhadaqa** Advisors **Alberto Cairo & Simon Rogers**
2024-s-0418.summaryJa: 検索と現実間の移住は,世界の移民の実際の経験と彼らの願望の間のギャップに関する重要な問題を解決しようとするデータ主導の視覚的探査です.Google検索の好みに反映される.物体現実と仮想世界のデータとの間の魔法の比較の追求は極めて重要です. このデータビジュアライゼーションプロジェクトでは 173カ国から選ばれた国々の洞察を深めるためのインタラクティブなビジュアルを提供することで様々な国の興味深い傾向が明らかになっています
2024-s-0418.impactJa: 移民の世界と彼らの夢や興味や欲望の間のギャップはどれほど大きいかを測定しようと試みているデータに基づく視覚的探求です移民問題やその問題や違法に国境を越えようとしている移民が逃れ,死亡など,よりよく理解するために,世界全体における移民問題についての統一的なイメージを描く試みです. このプロジェクトは,その問題について,出産国と目的地国の両方から検討しています. このプロジェクトの重要な調査は,Google検索の好みで反映されている世界の移民の実際の経験と彼らの願望の間の不平等を中心に展開しています. 実体現実と仮想世界のデータとのマジックな比較を達成することは,戦略的政治的側面だけでなく,人道的側面にも大きな重要性があります.

2024-s-0422.summary: Klimazentrale Stuttgart demonstrates the ramifications of climate change in Southwest Germany. It uses a large set of processed historical and live data to present **highly visual and automated insights** on a hyperlocal level (ZIP-code areas). The reports are updated daily. We use the data for regular **deep-dive analyses, live formats and to enrich all our reporting on weather and climate change**. Klimazentrale creates impact on a local level by raising awareness for climate change and fuelling discussions about **adaptation measures**, e.g. a "heat bus" that helps homeless people during heatwaves. Furthermore, Klimazentrale **has inspired numerous news outlets** to similar projects.
2024-s-0422.impact: Due to the enormous interest in all sorts of weather and climate reporting, particularly during numerous phases of weather anomalies, Klimazentrale content **has reached hundreds of thousands of our readers online**. Additionally, it has been **published on a weekly basis in our print titles (circulation 200.000)** and helped to raise awareness for climate change in local contexts. Our coverage has **fuelled local debates on climate mitigation and adaptation**. The project is cited on Social Media and in political discussions. The mayor’s office has, as a result, **initiated a “heat bus”** that serves the poor and homeless during heatwaves throughout the city. Klimazentrale has been **awarded with Theodor Wolff prize**, the most important award of the German newspaper industry. We have presented and discussed our project at several **journalism conferences, panels and talks** all over Germany. Subsequently, Klimazentrale has **inspired at least five other outlets to publish very similar projects**, among them Süddeutsche Zeitung and Berliner Morgenpost. On a technical basis, Klimazentrale has **pushed news automation** in our editorial team to new heights and we can use this expertise for other projects. Because of its **non-finite nature**, the project keeps informing and improving our coverage, until today and into the future.
2024-s-0422.authors: Simon Koenigsdorff, Dr. Jan Georg Plavec

2024-s-0422.impactJa: 気候センターコンテンツは,様々な種類の気象と気候報告に,特に多くの気候異常の段階において,オンラインで何百万人もの読者に達しています. さらに,それは,私たちの印刷タイトル (circulation 200,000) で週刊に掲載され,地元の環境で気候変動に関する意識を高めることに役立ちました. プロジェクトはソーシャルメディアや政治議論で引用されています. その結果,市長事務所は,都市全体で熱波中に貧しい人々やホームレスに奉仕する"熱バス"を開始しました. クリマゼントラルはドイツ新聞業界の最も重要な賞であるTheodor Wolff賞を受賞しました. 私たちはドイツ各地でいくつかの"ジャーナリズム会議,パネル,トーク"でプロジェクトを紹介し,議論しました. 後に,KlimaZentraleは,Süddeutsche ZeitungとBerliner Morgenpostなど,非常に似たプロジェクトを出版するために少なくとも5つの他の आउटलेटを**インスピレーションしました.技術的な基盤で,KlimaZentraleは,私たちの編集チームに **ニュースの自動化を** pushed to new heights and we can use this expertise for other projects. Because of its **non-finite nature**, the project keeps informing and improving our coverage, until today and into the future.

2024-s-0423.summary: Rhetoric around acute sexism in India’s Bollywood cinema – the world’s most prolific film industry that sells more than 2 billion tickets annually around the globe – has long been prevalent. Nikkei Asia embarked on an ambitious data-forward project to examine the problems, quantify the progress, and identify the shifts that can generate inclusion. It was the first gender-based dataset of its kind ever done on Bollywood, critical for a film-crazy country with one of the lowest female labor participation rates globally. Declining over the past two decades, it stands comparable with Pakistan and Somalia at 23% (the World Bank).
2024-s-0423.impact: Gender representation is crucial in India, ranked 135 among 146 countries in the Global Gender Gap Index 2022. Our analysis showed that change is afoot in this star-obsessed country of 1.4 billion people where many idolize, and even mimic, their favorite actors. It brought statistics to the forefront and showed that change over the last two decades has been slow, but significant. Findings included: *1 in 4 movies are now women-led, compared to 1 in 10. *The percentage of women older than 35 in lead roles is now at 33%, up from 3%. *Women-led movies get 1/5 of total capital but perform at par or better (ROI) than the rest. *The majority of female, often leading, characters, are still portrayed without an occupation. In addition to arduous manual data work, we interviewed India's biggest female superstar, and a female producer who went on to win a historic Oscar. We featured several other high-profile change agents, and these hard-to-get interviews helped us craft a compelling, well-rounded narrative that sparked extensive dialogue on LinkedIn. We were told by Bollywood insiders that it was shared widely with financiers, producers, distributors and studio heads -- some of whom vowed to fund more equitable projects.
2024-s-0423.authors: Surbhi Bhatia, Jui Chakravorty, Kiran Sharma, Sayan Chakraborty, MinJung Kim, Michael Tsang.
2024-s-0423.summaryJa: インドのボリウッド映画界で,世界でも年収20億枚以上のチケットが販売されている映画業界で,急性主義をめぐる言論は,長い間流行してきました.ニッケイアジアは,問題を調査し,進展を量化し,包摂を生み出す変化を特定するために,野心的なデータ推進プロジェクトを始めました. 女性の労働参加率が世界で最低である映画狂気な国にとって重要なこと.過去20年間で減少したこの数字は,パキスタンとソマリア (世界銀行) と比類できる23%である.
2024-s-0423.impactJa: グローバルジェンダーギャップインデックス 2022 年の146 国のうち135 位を占めるインドではジェンダー代表性は極めて重要です.我々の分析によると,この14億人の人口の星 obsessed 国の変化が進行中です.多くの方が彼らの好きな俳優を偶像化し,たとえ模倣する.この統計は,前線に来て,過去20年間で変化が遅い,しかし,顕著であることを示しました. *女性主演の35%が35%に増えました. *女性主演の映画では総資本の5分の1が収められ,他の作品よりも同等または優れている. *女性主演の大半は,仕事に就いていないまま描かれています. 辛苦な手動的なデータ作業に加えて,インド最大の女性スーパースターと歴史的なオスカー賞を受賞した女性プロデューサーとインタビューしました. 重要な変化の代理人にも参加しましたこの難得なインタビューはリンカーンの広範囲な対話を促した説得力のある丸い物語を作るのに役立ちましたボリウッドの内部関係者からは資金提供者やプロデューサーやディストリビューターやスタジオのリーダーに広く共有されたと伝えられました

2024-s-0424.summary: After three years and five months of long administrative litigation, the materials on the prosecution’s budget were obtained and verified, and as a result, we were able to reveal that the prosecution’s budget is being executed opaquely without principles and that the prosecution, is supposed to protect the law, has been misusing the national budget for personal purposes, etc. in violation of laws and regulations defeating the purpose of the budget planning for special activity expenses.
2024-s-0424.impact: During the five months from Jul to Dec 2023, the Joint Investigation Group of six media companies led by the KCIF (Newstapa) held five joint press conferences and released more than 150 whistle-blowing reports. After the initial verification of the prosecution’s budget, the leading opposition Democratic Party set up a task force to monitor the prosecution’s special activity expenses. The prosecution admitted for the first time that they had abused and misused their budget and took measures to return the misused budget to the national treasury. In addition, the National Assembly has reduced the prosecution’s 2024 budget for special activity expenses by 10% to KRW 7.2 billion, and several bills have been proposed to increase the transparency of the prosecution’s execution of special activity expenses. A typical example is the amendment of the National Finance Act, which requires all information on the prosecution’s special activity expenses used in the investigation or trial to be reported to the National Assembly three years after the reason for non-disclosure of the information disappears, such as the end of the investigation.
2024-s-0424.tools: Scraping, D3.js, QGIS, Json, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, RStudio, PostgreSQL, OpenStreetMap, Python, Node.js

2024-s-0424.summaryJa: 3年5ヶ月間長続きした行政訴訟の後検察官の予算に関する資料は入手され検証されその結果,検察官の予算が原則なしに不透明に実行されていて,法律を守るために,国家予算を個人目的で悪用していることが明らかになりました. 特別活動支出のための予算計画の目的を倒す法律と規制の違反です
2024-s-0424.impactJa: 2023年7月から12月までの5ヶ月間に,KCIF (Newstapa) 率いる6つのメディア会社の共同調査グループが5つの共同記者会見を開催し,150件以上の情報発信報告を公開した.検察の予算の初期検証後,主要な反対民主党は検察の特殊活動支出を監視するタスクフォースを設置した. 検察は,初めて,彼らが予算を濫用し,悪用したことを認め,悪用された予算を国家財務省に返還するための措置をとった.さらに,国民議会は特別活動支出のための2024年の検察予算を10%に削減し,KRW7.2億ドルに及び,特別活動支出の執行の透明性を高めるためにいくつかの法案が提案された. 典型的な例は,National Finance Actの修正である.この法案は,調査または裁判で使用された検察の特殊活動費用に関するすべての情報について,調査終了など,情報未開示の理由が消えた3年後に,国民議会に報告されるよう要求している.

2024-s-0425.summary: As the amount of personal data held by governments and companies continues to grow, so does the personal and systemic cost of not securing this information. In the wake of several significant breaches in Australia, ABC News Story Lab investigated their impact. ‘See your identity pieced together from stolen data’ took this often abstract issue – your data being leaked online – and made it terrifyingly personal. ‘This is the most detailed portrait yet of data breaches in Australia’ grew out of a single administrative data request, and developed into an investigation into the soundness of Australia’s data breach notification scheme.
2024-s-0425.impact: ‘See your identity pieced together from stolen data’ saw significant audience interest, with more than 720,000 page views. Audience feedback was positive, with many readers noting how confronting they found it: "An impressive, if terrifying piece of data journalism by the ABC’s Story Lab." "Ever wondered what data is out there about you and when those breaches occurred? Well, ABC and @troyhunt designed this mosaic representation to show the fractures in our digital security. What a brilliant (and disturbing) example of visual storytelling."
2024-s-0425.authors: Julian Fell (reporting, development), Matt Liddy (editing), Ben Spraggon (design) and Georgina Piper (design).
2024-s-0425.summaryJa: 政府の個人データや企業によって保有されている個人データの量も増え続けているため,この情報を保護しないことに対する個人・システムコストも増加しています.オーストラリアでいくつかの重大な侵害事件の後,ABCニュース・ストーリーラボはその影響を調査しました. <unk>これはオーストラリアにおけるデータ侵害に関する最も詳細な肖像画です単一の行政データ要求から発展し,オーストラリアのデータ侵害通知制度の健全性に関する調査へと発展しました
2024-s-0425.impactJa: 盗まれたデータからあなたのアイデンティティをまとめたことを見る<unk> 720,000 ページビュー以上の視聴者の関心が顕著でした.視聴者のフィードバックはポジティブでした.多くの読者は,それがどれほど対抗的なものであったかを指摘しました. "ABCのストーリーラボによる印象的で恐ろしいデータジャーナリズム" "あなたについてのデータとそれらの侵害が起こったときについて,疑問に思ったことはありますか? 視覚的な物語を語る素晴らしい (そして不安を感じる) 例です"

2024-s-0426.summary: This story had a single goal – put the $243 billion price tag of Australia’s stage 3 tax cuts into perspective. It’s easy for one’s eyes to glaze over at such a big number, so we took on the challenge of depicting it visually. We used visual size (and lots of scrolling) to compare it to other costs, while maintaining a conversational tone throughout. By starting with smaller costs that were familiar to readers, and then building up to comparable expenses in the national budget, we aimed to give readers a better sense of the scale of money being talked about.
2024-s-0426.impact: The story had an impressive impact, with more than 575,000 page views. Here is a sample of the audience feedback: "You and your team are a shining example of modern journalism acting for human rights and equity, holding our politicians to account, in ways which are so exciting and undoubtedly effective. I am sure this article (and the others you do) will make a big difference to millions of people’s lives." "What an amazing summary by the ABC. This clever grid graph shows the cost of stage 3 tax cuts that benefit higher income earners in comparison to the cost to #RaiseTheRate build infrastructure etc."
2024-s-0426.authors: Julian Fell, Ben Spraggon, Tim Leslie, Cristen Tilley, Matt Liddy
2024-s-0426.summaryJa: この物語は,単一の目標でした. オーストラリアの3段階の税削減の2億430億ドルを視野に出す.このような大きな数字で目が輝くのは簡単です. そこで,視覚的に描く挑戦を挑みました.視覚的なサイズ (およびスクロールの多く) を使って,他のコストと比較し,会話のトーンを維持しました. 読み手にとって馴染みのあるコストを小さくし,国予算に比べられる費用を積み上げることで,私たちは読者に話題の資金の規模をよりよく理解させることを目指しました.
2024-s-0426.impactJa: この記事には57万5千ページ以上の視聴者が参加した印象的な影響がありました.視聴者のフィードバックの一例はこちらです. "あなたとあなたのチームは,人権と公平のために行動する現代ジャーナリズムの輝かしい例であり,政治家たちを,とてもエキサイティングで,間違いなく効果的な方法で説明します.この記事 (そしてあなたがしている他の記事) は,何百万人もの人々の生活に大きな変化をもたらすでしょう. " ABCの驚くべき概要です. この賢いグリッドグラフは, #RaiseTheRateインフラ構築等のコストと比較して,収入が高い人にとって利益となる第3段階の税削減のコストを示しています".

2024-s-0427.summary: An investigation into individuals who purchased passports from the Commonwealth of Dominica.

2024-s-0428.summary: O site AbortonoBrasil.Info é o primeiro no país que reúne todas as informações e dados relevantes sobre aborto em um só lugar. A plataforma traz materiais atualizados de forma acessível e transparente sobre tratamentos de saúde, estatísticas, contextos relacionados ao aborto no país e muito mais. O site é direcionado a jornalistas e produtores de conteúdo. Acreditamos que a sociedade precisa ser informada com conteúdos embasados em evidência para fortalecer a democracia inclusiva, os direitos humanos, precisamente os direitos sexuais e reprodutivos das mulheres e meninas.
2024-s-0428.impact: Além das boas métricas, engajamento nas redes sociais (3 republicações de conteúdos, 9 matérias sobre aborto na imprensa, 2 menções em newsletters; entrevistas abordando o tema: Fio Cruz e Canal TVT, IJNET e podcast Senta Direito Garota), tivemos feedbacks diretos de jornalistas, pesquisadores e da sociedade em geral: "Um divisor de águas sobre a disponibilidade de dados/informações sobre aborto no Brasil"; Recebemos emails de jornalistas agradecendo nosso esforço em desenvolver o projeto, assim como feedback positivo de especialistas da saúde, pesquisadoras e profissionais multidisciplinares. As mensagens reinteram que essa plataforma é bastante completa com dados oficiais de saúde, sobre aborto legal, recomendações mundiais de aborto seguro, atendimentos, número de mortes, perfil das pessoas que abortam, jurídico, legislações e acessos aos direitos reprodutivos na América Latina, além de pesquisas, guias, projetos, artigos, fontes especializadas e organizações que tratam do com dados de acesso direto, facil e atualizada. O impacto é direto na promoção do acesso à informação sobre justiça reprodutiva no Brasil, sendo muito útil para jornalistas que cobrem o tema de justiça reprodutiva. Os/as jornalistas junto a sociedade tem o AbortoNoBrasil.Info como uma ferramenta jornalística, que se contrapõe à superficialidade e as campanhas de desinformação vistas frequentemente sobre aborto.
